postings.title: Accounts Payable Accountant
postings.description:
About the Role

Imagine this. You join a fast-moving finance team where accuracy, speed, and good judgement really matter. As our Accounts Payable Accountant, you will take ownership of a high volume of supplier invoices, work extensively with purchase orders, resolve discrepancies, and make sure transactions move smoothly through our systems. This is a hands-on role for someone who already knows their way around accounts payable and is ready to contribute from day one.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You’ll Do

- Process and book a high volume of supplier invoices accurately and on time

- Work extensively with purchase orders, checking invoices against POs and identifying and resolving discrepancies

- Review invoice details, approvals, supporting documentation, and accounting information before posting

- Handle questions, clarifications, and follow-ups related to supplier invoices and payments

- Investigate invoice discrepancies and work with internal teams and suppliers to get issues resolved quickly

- Work daily with Microsoft Dynamics and ExFlow to process and manage invoices

- Maintain accurate vendor and accounting records and ensure transactions are properly documented

- Support the wider finance team during periods of high workload and help keep accounts payable processes moving efficiently

- Contribute to improving accounts payable processes and identifying practical ways to make daily workflows more efficient

- Support month-end activities and other accounting tasks related to accounts payable when required

Requirements

What You’ll Need

- Around 4 to 6 years of relevant professional experience in accounting, accounts payable, vendor accounting, or a similar finance role

- Practical experience processing and booking supplier invoices in a high-volume environment

- Strong experience working with purchase orders and PO-based invoice processes

- Hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics is required

- Experience with ExFlow is highly valued

- Accounting education or professional training in accounting or finance

- Previous professional accounting experience within a company in Switzerland

- Good understanding of Swiss accounting practices and day-to-day finance processes

- Strong attention to detail and confidence working with large volumes of financial data and documentation

- Fluent English is required

- German or French is a strong plus

- Higher education or a university degree is not required

- Previous aerospace or defense experience is not required

Who You Are

You are comfortable in a busy finance environment where there is always something that needs to get done. You know how to work independently, stay organized when invoice volumes increase, and spot when something does not add up. You are not afraid to ask questions, chase missing information, or dig into a discrepancy until it is resolved. You bring solid accounting experience, a practical mindset, and the reliability to take ownership of your work while collaborating closely with the wider team.

postings.title: Administration Assistant
postings.description:
About The Role

Imagine this. You are the person who keeps our offices and production facilities running smoothly, making sure our teams have everything they need to focus on what matters most. As an Administrative Assistant at Destinus, you will play an essential role in maintaining an organized, welcoming, and efficient workplace at our Payerne location.

From managing office supplies and preparing meeting spaces to coordinating daily operational needs, you will be a key part of creating an environment where people can do their best work. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys variety, takes initiative, and knows that even the smallest details make a big difference.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You Will Do

- Manage office inventory, ensuring sufficient stock of snacks, fruits, beverages, office supplies, and company merchandise.
- Keep ground and upper floor kitchens clean, organized, and ready for daily use.
- Prepare, organize, and maintain meeting rooms, including setups for external visitors and special meetings.
- Ensure common areas and corridors remain clear and well-maintained, coordinating repairs and maintenance with external service providers such as Equans.
- Manage postal collections and drop-offs, including pickup notifications, outgoing letters, and parcels.
- Update, manage, and track office desk availability.
- Monitor and maintain the staff refrigerator.
- Coordinate recycling processes, including bottles and aluminium.
- Manage and maintain the stock of marketing materials.
- Welcome visitors and provide general assistance to ensure a positive experience.
- Support the assembly and setup of office furniture when required.
- Assist the Office Management team with ad hoc administrative and operational tasks.

Requirements

Working Schedule & Presence

- Full-time position, Monday to Friday (100%).
- Monday to Thursday, preferred start time of 7.30 AM to ensure kitchens and common areas are ready before employees arrive.
- Friday, flexible start time, typically around 8.00 AM.
- Physically check the secondary office 2 to 3 times per week to ensure everything is organized and running smoothly.

What You Will Need

- Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks efficiently.
- Fluency in English and French, both written and spoken. Knowledge of an additional European language such as German, Italian, or Spanish is a strong plus.
- A high sense of responsibility and accountability.
- Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and take initiative.
- A structured, detail-oriented approach to daily activities.
- A service-oriented, hands-on mindset with a willingness to support others.
- Good communication and interpersonal skills.
- Basic knowledge of MS Office or Google Workspace.
- Previous experience in an administrative or office support role is a plus, but not essential. Internal training will be provided.

postings.title: Analog Electronics Engineer
postings.description:
Imagine this. You are designing the electronics that transform microscopic physical phenomena into precise navigation data. As an Analog Electronics Engineer, you will play a critical role in the development of a proprietary Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) targeting navigation-grade performance. This is not a conventional electronics role. You will work at the limits of analog design, creating ultra-low-noise circuitry capable of extracting signals measured in nanoamperes while managing complex interactions between sensing and drive electronics. Your work will directly influence the performance, accuracy, and reliability of next-generation aerospace systems.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You'll Do

- Design, simulate, and develop ultra-low-noise analog front-end electronics, including charge-sensitive amplifiers and transimpedance amplifiers optimized for capacitive sensing applications
- Create advanced PCB architectures focused on shielding, isolation, impedance control, and parasitic capacitance suppression to achieve exceptional signal integrity
- Develop solutions to eliminate capacitive crosstalk between high-voltage drive circuits and ultra-sensitive sensing channels using techniques such as active guard rings and advanced grounding strategies
- Select, integrate, and validate high-resolution Analog-to-Digital Converters and high-speed Digital-to-Analog Converters for precision measurement systems
- Design and implement clock generation and distribution architectures with extremely low drift, jitter, and phase noise characteristics
- Collaborate closely with mechanical, sensor, and FPGA engineers to optimize system-level performance and ensure seamless integration across disciplines
- Build, test, debug, and characterize prototype hardware using laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, and signal generators
- Analyze system performance, identify noise sources, and continuously improve circuit designs to meet demanding navigation-grade requirements

Requirements

What You'll Need

- Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree in Electrical Engineering, Physics, or a related field with strong focus on precision instrumentation and low-noise electronics
- At least 5 years of experience designing ultra-low-noise and low-signal-level analog electronics
- Strong understanding of thermal EMF management, leakage currents, grounding strategies, shielding techniques, and precision measurement systems
- Expertise in multi-layer PCB design and layout with demonstrated experience in impedance control, shielding, and parasitic effect mitigation
- Deep knowledge of precision operational amplifiers, instrumentation amplifiers, low-noise voltage regulators, and high-performance data converters
- Hands-on experience with SPICE-based simulation tools and analog circuit modeling
- Strong laboratory debugging and validation skills

Nice to have

- Experience developing electronics for MEMS sensors, inertial sensors, atomic clocks, or scientific instrumentation
- Experience working on aerospace, defense, or harsh-environment electronic systems
- Familiarity with digital communication interfaces such as SPI and parallel buses
- Understanding of FPGA and microcontroller integration in mixed-signal systems

Who You Are

You are someone who thrives when working at the edge of what is technically possible. You enjoy solving complex physical problems where success depends on attention to detail, deep technical expertise, and relentless curiosity. You are comfortable working across disciplines, collaborating with physicists, mechanical engineers, and FPGA developers to solve challenging system-level problems. When others see noise, drift, and interference as obstacles, you see engineering challenges waiting to be solved. You take ownership of your work, approach problems methodically, and are motivated by building technology that pushes aerospace navigation performance to new levels.

postings.title: Assembly & Integration Technician
postings.description:
About the Role

The Destinus engineering team is seeking an Assembly & Integration Technician to carry out the final assembly, integration, and packing of solid rocket motors at our Lucerne facility. This is a hands-on production role at the end of the manufacturing chain, where propellant grains, mechanical components, and initiators come together into a finished, certified product ready for delivery.

The ideal candidate is a skilled and careful mechanical technician who is equally at home reading an assembly drawing and using precision hand tools. They follow procedures exactly, document their work thoroughly, and understand that in an energetic product environment there is no room for improvisation.

What You’ll Do

- Assemble and integrate solid rocket motor components following assembly procedures, drawings, and work instructions in detail

- Carry out mechanical fitting, torquing, sealing, and bonding operations as part of the final motor assembly process

- Perform pre- and post-assembly inspections, verify component identities, lot numbers, and conformance before and after each assembly step

- Complete assembly records and documentation accurately and in full for every unit produced, maintain traceability of all components and sub-assemblies

- Pack finished rocket motors and energetic sub-assemblies for internal transfer or external delivery in accordance with applicable transport regulations (ADR/SDR) and packing procedures

- Handle and store energetic components (propellant grains, initiators) in compliance with applicable safety protocols and site procedures

- Support incoming inspection of mechanical parts and sub-assemblies; flag non-conformances and quarantine suspect items

- Maintain a clean, organised, and safe assembly area at all times, contribute to continuous improvement of assembly processes and procedures

Requirements

What You’ll Need

- Completed vocational training as a Polymechaniker/in, Produktionsmechaniker/in, or equivalent or comparable hands-on experience

- Several years of hands-on experience in precision mechanical assembly, ideally in a regulated or safety-critical environment such as aerospace, defence, medical devices, or weapons/ammunition manufacturing

- Confident with precision hand tools and measuring instruments; experience with torque tools, adhesives, sealants, and mechanical fitting operations

- Able to read and work from assembly drawings, exploded views, and written work instructions with a high degree of accuracy

- Meticulous documentation habits working with assembly records and full component traceability

- Experience handling or assembling products containing energetic, pyrotechnic, or otherwise hazardous materials is a strong advantage

- Careful, disciplined, and procedure-driven, someone who does not cut corners and takes personal accountability for the quality of every unit leaving the facility

- Fluent in German or English

Who You Are

You are hands-on, precise, and take pride in getting every detail right. You work methodically, follow procedures without cutting corners, and understand the responsibility that comes with assembling safety-critical products. You stay focused under pressure, take ownership of the quality of your work, and enjoy solving practical challenges alongside the team. Reliability, discipline, and high standards are simply how you operate.

postings.title: Assembly & Test Technician
postings.description:
About the role:

As an Assembly & Test Technician, you will be responsible for assembling and testing prototypes and small production batches of our UAV systems. Working closely with the hardware and software team, you will ensure that each product is built, wired and tested to the highest quality standards before validation and deployment.

This role combining mechanical assembly, electrical wiring, soldering and functional testing.

You will also prepare and maintain assembly and test documentation, including Bills of Materials (BOMs), work instructions and test procedures to support efficient and repeatable production.

In addition, you will help organize the office by managing components, tools and inventory, ensuring that materials are available and the workspace remains efficient and well structured. Your work will be an important role in supporting prototype development as well as low-volume production.

What You'll Do

- Work with the systems hardware and software team to continuously improve the performance and reliability.
- Collaborate closely with hardware and software teams during initial testing phases, ensuring all components and systems operate as expected from the start
- Support full system-level integration and testing, helping bring together mechanical, electronic and software elements into a cohesive and functional setup
- Contribute to cabling activities, ensuring clean, reliable and well-structured connections across the entire test environment
- Conduct mechanical assembly, drilling, cabling and functional testing of prototypes and equipment.
- Provide inventory and stock management for R&D team, ensuring the availability of components and materials.
- Develop and maintain Bills of Materials (BOMs), assembly and test procedures.

Who You Are

You enjoy working with electronics and hands-on technical tasks.

You are comfortable assembling, wiring, soldering and testing electronic systems and you like solving practical problems.

You work carefully and pay attention to detail to ensure reliable and high-quality results.

You enjoy working in a lab environment and collaborating with hardware and software teams to build, test, and improve new products.

You are comfortable using common lab equipment to troubleshoot and validate electronic systems.

You are also organised and understand the importance of keeping accurate documentation, managing components, and maintaining a clean and efficient workspace.

Requirements

- CFC in Electronics, Electrical, Automation or an equivalent technical background that gives you a solid foundation in electronic systems

- Comfortable performing mechanical work, including drilling, assembly and electrical wiring/cabling.
- Skilled in soldering and electronic assembly
- Confidence using lab equipment such as oscilloscopes and signal generators to analyse, validate and debug signals
- English communication skills at CEFR level B2, both written and spoken, allowing you to collaborate effectively in an international team.

postings.title: Automation Engineer
postings.description:
Imagine standing at the very intersection where innovation meets reality. On one side, our engineers are designing cutting-edge UAV systems; on the other, production teams are assembling machines that will define the future of defense. We are looking for an Automation Engineer to join our Production/Testing Team, with a strong focus on automating test activities for electronic systems and laboratory setups. This role involves close collaboration with R&D and Production teams, while being an integral part of the Testing Team, contributing to the development of both software and hardware solutions aimed at improving test efficiency, repeatability, and reliability.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You’ll Do

- Design, develop, and maintain automation solutions for test activities.

- Write scripts and software applications to control test rigs, measurement instruments, and data acquisition systems.
- Develop and maintain software interfaces, including web-based interfaces, for test control and monitoring.
- Contribute to the definition of test system architectures (hardware + software).
- Support debugging and troubleshooting of electronic systems under test.
- Create and maintain technical documentation for test tools and procedures.

Requirements

What You’ll Need

- Strong programming and automation skills
- Proficiency in Python (primary language)
- Knowledge of additional programming languages (e.g. C/C++, JavaScript, etc.) is a plus
- Hands-on, problem-solving mindset
- Ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams (software and hardware)
- Experience with PCB design, testing, or debugging
- Web development experience for building test user interfaces
- Familiarity with laboratory instrumentation (oscilloscopes, power supplies, DAQ systems, sensors)
- CAD design experience
- 3D printing for prototyping fixtures, enclosures, or test accessories
- Experience working with complex hardware test environments

Who You Are

You are a hands-on engineer who feels at home where hardware meets software, comfortable moving between lab setups, electronic systems, and automation code without friction. You naturally understand how complex systems behave, allowing you to translate test needs into robust automated solutions that improve efficiency, repeatability, and reliability. You enjoy collaborating closely with R&D and Production teams, speaking the same technical language and keeping a strong focus on real-world constraints. Quality matters to you, especially in high-stakes environments, and you take ownership of building test systems that engineers can trust.

postings.title: Avionics & Electrical Engineer
postings.description:
Imagine this, you own the electronics at the heart of an exo-atmospheric interceptor, from the flight computer and power system to the electrical architecture connecting every critical subsystem.

Bliksem Exo is a four-nation European consortium developing an anti-ballistic missile system at operational pace. Destinus is the programme prime and responsible for the exo-atmospheric interceptor, engineered for affordability and production at scale.

In this role, you will define the avionics architecture, design or procure the hardware, integrate it into the vehicle, and prove it through testing. You will work closely with GNC, propulsion, and mechanical engineering to build an electrical system that performs reliably under demanding flight and storage conditions.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You'll Do

- Own the avionics architecture, including the flight computer, power system, and overall electrical architecture within mass, volume, and power constraints
- Design or procure flight electronics and integrate sensing, navigation, propulsion, and control hardware into a complete electrical system
- Specify and integrate the electronics supporting the vehicle's navigation systems
- Size and manage the power system and define electrical interfaces between vehicle subsystems, ground systems, and launch equipment
- Plan and execute avionics integration, interface, environmental, and qualification testing, analysing results against requirements
- Work across GNC, mechanical, propulsion, and software teams to resolve interfaces and drive vehicle-level integration

Who You Are

- You are a hands-on engineer who takes ownership from architecture through integration and test
- You understand how individual electronic systems come together at vehicle level
- You are rigorous about interfaces, reliability, and verification
- You thrive in a small technical team where decisions move quickly and engineering ownership matters

Requirements

- BSc, MSc, or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field
- 10+ years of experience designing and integrating avionics or flight electronics for missiles, spacecraft, aircraft, or comparable systems
- Hands-on experience with flight computers and power-system hardware from design or procurement through integration and testing
- Practical experience integrating sensors, actuators, electronics, and other subsystems into a complete vehicle
- Strong understanding of electrical interfaces and mass, volume, and power budgets
- Nice to Have

- Experience with embedded software or close integration between flight hardware and software
- Experience with environmental and EMC qualification
- Experience designing electronics for long-term storage or canister-life requirements

postings.title: B2B Systems & Component Sales Manager
postings.description:
About the Role

As Components & Systems Sales Manager, you own the commercial success of our components and systems portfolio. You define the go-to-market approach, build and manage the pipeline, and win contracts with OEMs, system integrators, defense primes and government customers. Working closely with Commercial Head, Business Development, Sales Engineering and Bid Management, you translate customer requirements into competitive technical-commercial offers and negotiate deals that deliver long-term value. It is a senior sales, quota-carrying and highly visible, role for someone who combines technical understanding with commercial drive and who thrives in a fast-moving, mission-driven environment.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You’ll Do

Strategy & Portfolio Growth

- Develop and execute the sales strategy and annual targets for our components and systems portfolio, including a clear view of target segments, customers and regions

- Identify new customers and engage existing customer’s for our components and systems, and translate market insight into product and pricing input

- Own revenue, margin and forecast accuracy for your portfolio, and report performance to Head of Commercial Product – B2B Systems & Components.

Business Development & Sales execution

- Build and manage a healthy pipeline of opportunities with OEMs, integrators, defense primes and government agencies

- Develop long-term relationships with key accounts and act as the B2B commercial counterpart for customer stakeholders

- Represent Destinus at trade shows, conferences and customer meetings, and turn events into qualified opportunities

Offers, Negotiation & Contracting

- Lead the technical-commercial offer process from requirement to proposal, working with Sales Engineering on scope, specifications and feasibility

- Prepare pricing, quotations and tender responses, balancing competitiveness with margin and risk with Bid Management

- Negotiate contracts and commercial terms, together with Legal and Finance, and close deals within agreed guidelines

- Ensure compliance with export control, sanctions and defense procurement regulations in every transaction

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Delivery

- Act as the voice of the customer towards Product, Engineering, Supply Chain and Programs, feeding requirements and roadmap priorities back into the organisation

- Work with Programs and Operations to ensure smooth handover, on-time delivery and customer satisfaction after contract award

- Keep the CRM and pipeline reporting accurate, and give regular forecasts and updates to the Commercial leadership

Team & Ways of Working

- Coordinate with Business Development, Commercial team to keep sales activity aligned and well prepared

- Where applicable, coach and guide junior sales colleagues and contribute to building the commercial team as Destinus grows

Requirements

What You’ll Need

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in engineering, business or a related field, or equivalent experience

- 6–10 years of experience in B2B technical sales, business development or account management, preferably in defense, aerospace, electronics or advanced manufacturing

- Proven track record of selling complex components, subsystems or systems and closing multi-stakeholder deals with long sales cycles

- Solid technical understanding, with the ability to discuss specifications and requirements credibly with engineers and customers

- Strong negotiation, commercial and contracting skills, including pricing and margin management

- Hands-on experience with a CRM platform and structured pipeline management and forecasting

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, comfortable at both engineering and executive level

- Fluent in English; a second European language is an advantage

- Willingness to travel regularly to customers and events

- Eligibility to obtain or hold a security clearance in an EU member state

Who You Are

You are a commercially sharp, technically curious sales leader who takes ownership of results. You build trust with customers and colleagues alike, understand what makes a technical solution valuable, and know how to turn that value into a winning proposal. You are structured in how you manage your pipeline, calm in complex negotiations, and persistent when sales cycles are long. You collaborate naturally across Engineering, Product and Programs, and you take pride in delivering on what you promise to customers. postings.title: B2B Systems & Component Sales Manager
postings.description:
About the Role

As Components & Systems Sales Manager, you own the commercial success of our components and systems portfolio. You define the go-to-market approach, build and manage the pipeline, and win contracts with OEMs, system integrators, defense primes and government customers. Working closely with Commercial Head, Business Development, Sales Engineering and Bid Management, you translate customer requirements into competitive technical-commercial offers and negotiate deals that deliver long-term value. It is a senior sales, quota-carrying and highly visible, role for someone who combines technical understanding with commercial drive and who thrives in a fast-moving, mission-driven environment.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You’ll Do

Strategy & Portfolio Growth

- Develop and execute the sales strategy and annual targets for our components and systems portfolio, including a clear view of target segments, customers and regions

- Identify new customers and engage existing customer’s for our components and systems, and translate market insight into product and pricing input

- Own revenue, margin and forecast accuracy for your portfolio, and report performance to Head of Commercial Product – B2B Systems & Components.

Business Development & Sales execution

- Build and manage a healthy pipeline of opportunities with OEMs, integrators, defense primes and government agencies

- Develop long-term relationships with key accounts and act as the B2B commercial counterpart for customer stakeholders

- Represent Destinus at trade shows, conferences and customer meetings, and turn events into qualified opportunities

Offers, Negotiation & Contracting

- Lead the technical-commercial offer process from requirement to proposal, working with Sales Engineering on scope, specifications and feasibility

- Prepare pricing, quotations and tender responses, balancing competitiveness with margin and risk with Bid Management

- Negotiate contracts and commercial terms, together with Legal and Finance, and close deals within agreed guidelines

- Ensure compliance with export control, sanctions and defense procurement regulations in every transaction

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Delivery

- Act as the voice of the customer towards Product, Engineering, Supply Chain and Programs, feeding requirements and roadmap priorities back into the organisation

- Work with Programs and Operations to ensure smooth handover, on-time delivery and customer satisfaction after contract award

- Keep the CRM and pipeline reporting accurate, and give regular forecasts and updates to the Commercial leadership

Team & Ways of Working

- Coordinate with Business Development, Commercial team to keep sales activity aligned and well prepared

- Where applicable, coach and guide junior sales colleagues and contribute to building the commercial team as Destinus grows

Requirements

What You’ll Need

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in engineering, business or a related field, or equivalent experience

- 6–10 years of experience in B2B technical sales, business development or account management, preferably in defense, aerospace, electronics or advanced manufacturing

- Proven track record of selling complex components, subsystems or systems and closing multi-stakeholder deals with long sales cycles

- Solid technical understanding, with the ability to discuss specifications and requirements credibly with engineers and customers

- Strong negotiation, commercial and contracting skills, including pricing and margin management

- Hands-on experience with a CRM platform and structured pipeline management and forecasting

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, comfortable at both engineering and executive level

- Fluent in English; a second European language is an advantage

- Willingness to travel regularly to customers and events

- Eligibility to obtain or hold a security clearance in an EU member state

Who You Are

You are a commercially sharp, technically curious sales leader who takes ownership of results. You build trust with customers and colleagues alike, understand what makes a technical solution valuable, and know how to turn that value into a winning proposal. You are structured in how you manage your pipeline, calm in complex negotiations, and persistent when sales cycles are long. You collaborate naturally across Engineering, Product and Programs, and you take pride in delivering on what you promise to customers. Above all, you are motivated by the mission—helping Destinus compete and win in the global defense market.

postings.title: Commercial Intelligence Analyst
postings.description:
About the Role

Imagine this. You are turning market signals, competitor moves, and commercial data into intelligence that directly shapes how Destinus grows. As our Commercial Intelligence Analyst, you will build the structure behind our commercial intelligence, creating clear reporting frameworks, tracking performance, and giving our teams the insights they need to make faster and smarter decisions.

As a Commercial Intelligence Analyst you will work closely with our commercial teams and stakeholders across the organization, combining market intelligence, data analysis, and business understanding in a fast-moving international environment.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You’ll Do

- Build and maintain a structured commercial intelligence process that captures relevant market developments, customer signals, and competitor activity.
- Develop detailed competitor analyses across our product lines and keep them current as the market evolves.
- Turn market data into actionable insights, identifying emerging opportunities, competitive threats, and trends that can influence our commercial strategy.
- Create a collaborative intelligence framework that enables commercial teams to contribute insights and share knowledge across markets and geographies.
- Prepare recurring market intelligence reports for leadership and key stakeholders.
- Build and maintain KPI dashboards to track commercial performance against team and individual targets.
- Establish clear reporting cycles and ensure commercial data is accurate, consistent, and easy to use.
- Deliver ad hoc commercial analyses to support management decisions and strategic priorities.
- Support strategic initiatives including market entry assessments, partnerships, and M&A related projects.
- Work closely with commercial and other cross-functional teams to ensure intelligence and reporting are aligned with business priorities.
- Continuously improve tools, processes, and reporting frameworks as Destinus scales.

Requirements

What You’ll Need

- Master’s degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Engineering, Data Analytics, or another relevant field.
- At least 2 years of relevant professional experience in commercial strategy, business intelligence, consulting, market intelligence, or a similar analytical role.
- Strong analytical skills with the ability to turn complex information into clear conclusions and recommendations.
- Experience with market research, competitor analysis, and commercial performance analysis.
- Ability to design and implement structured processes for collecting, organizing, and sharing intelligence.
- Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills.
- Experience building KPI dashboards and management reporting.
- Experience with BI tools, SQL, and CRM systems is a strong plus.
- Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively across teams, functions and geographies.

Who You Are

You are curious, analytical, and naturally driven to understand what is happening behind the numbers. You bring structure to complexity, challenge assumptions, and turn scattered information into insights people can actually use. You are comfortable taking ownership, working independently, and collaborating across teams in a fast-paced environment where priorities evolve quickly.

Security screening is an integral component of the selection process, ensuring that candidates meet the organization's security standards and safeguarding against potential risks.

postings.title: Commercial Planning Manager
postings.description:
As Commercial Planning Manager, you will be the orchestrator who ensures Destinus’ commercial ambitions can be fast tracked and realised. You will drive the coordination of the activities that win and deliver business. Crucially, you will be the linking pin to a.o. our Business Development, Programme Management, Legal and Operational teams. You are a critical spider in the web to ensure the lead up to a commercial deal is validated, streamlined, and successful. This is a high-impact, cross-functional role for someone who brings order to fast-moving environments, is accurate and understands the rigour and trade-compliance discipline required when selling into government and defense customers.

What You’ll Do

Commercial Planning

- Maintain a rolling commercial calendar of bids, milestones, demonstrations and deliveries, proactively flagging conflicts, capacity constraints and resourcing risks

- Serve as the link between various teams within the organisation, ensuring commitments made during the sales process are handed over cleanly into delivery

- Align commercial plans with programme schedules, milestones and resource plans, surfacing risks and dependencies in both directions

Export Licensing & Trade-Compliance Administration

- Own all associated administration for licence applications, end-user certificates and classification requests—ensuring complete, accurate and audit-ready documentation

- Main entry point into the legal team for export license applications

- Liaise with national export-control authorities, customs, and internal Legal and Compliance to resolve queries and keep applications moving

- Advise commercial colleagues on licensing implications early in each pursuit and maintain the export-control knowledge base

Demonstration Team Liaison (Commercial Linking Pin)

- Ensure demonstration activity is prioritised against the pipeline and that outcomes and lessons learned feed back into the commercial plan

- Act as the single commercial point of contact for the demonstration teams, translating customer and campaign requirements into clear demonstration briefs

- Plan and coordinate the commercial aspects of demonstrations—scheduling, attendee management, and the approvals and export licences required

Factory Site-Visit Coordination

- Coordinate, on behalf of Commercial, all customer and partner visits to our sites & facilities

- Work with Manufacturing, Security and Programme teams to ensure visits are well prepared, compliant, and aligned with commercial objectives

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Partner with Business Development, Manufacturing, Legal and Programme Management to keep commercial plans aligned with contractual, financial and delivery realities

- Support commercial teams during major pursuits by maintaining planning discipline under time pressure

- Serve as a point of contact for internal and external audits relating to export-control administration

Requirements

What You’ll Need

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, International Trade, Law, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, or a related discipline

- 5–7 years of professional experience in commercial planning, sales operations, or commercial project management;

- Experience in the defense or aerospace industry, as well as working knowledge of export-control regimes and hands-on experience with licence applications is a strong advantage

- Strong planning skills and operate with high level of accuracy

- Excellent coordination and stakeholder-management skills

- Fluent in English.
- Dutch, German or Spanish will be a plus

Who You Are

You are a structured, highly organised professional who creates clarity where there is ambiguity and keeps many moving parts on track at once. You combine a planner’s discipline with a hands-on, pragmatic approach, and you are comfortable being the connective tissue between various internal and external stakeholders. You understand the seriousness of export controls and treat compliance as non-negotiable. You are diplomatic enough to bring people along, yet firm enough to hold the line on deadlines and process. As Commercial Planning Manager, you will be the orchestrator who ensures Destinus’ commercial ambitions can be fast tracked and realised. You will drive the coordination of the activities that win and deliver business. Crucially, you will be the linking pin to a.o. our Business Development, Programme Management, Legal and Operational teams. You are a critical spider in the web to ensure the lead up to a commercial deal is validated, streamlined, and successful. This is a high-impact, cross-functional role for someone who brings order to fast-moving environments, is accurate and understands the rigour and trade-compliance discipline required when selling into government and defense customers.

What You’ll Do

Commercial Planning

- Maintain a rolling commercial calendar of bids, milestones, demonstrations and deliveries, proactively flagging conflicts, capacity constraints and resourcing risks

- Serve as the link between various teams within the organisation, ensuring commitments made during the sales process are handed over cleanly into delivery

- Align commercial plans with programme schedules, milestones and resource plans, surfacing risks and dependencies in both directions

Export Licensing & Trade-Compliance Administration

- Own all associated administration for licence applications, end-user certificates and classification requests—ensuring complete, accurate and audit-ready documentation

- Main entry point into the legal team for export license applications

- Liaise with national export-control authorities, customs, and internal Legal and Compliance to resolve queries and keep applications moving

- Advise commercial colleagues on licensing implications early in each pursuit and maintain the export-control knowledge base

- Act as the single commercial point of contact for the demonstration teams, translating customer and campaign requirements into clear demonstration briefs

- Plan and coordinate the commercial aspects of demonstrations—scheduling, attendee management, and the approvals and export licences required

Factory Site-Visit Coordination

- Coordinate, on behalf of Commercial, all customer and partner visits to our sites & facilities

- Work with Manufacturing, Security and Programme teams to ensure visits are well prepared, compliant, and aligned with commercial objectives

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Partner with Business Development, Manufacturing, Legal and Programme Management to keep commercial plans aligned with contractual, financial and delivery realities

- Support commercial teams during major pursuits by maintaining planning discipline under time pressure

- Serve as a point of contact for internal and external audits relating to export-control administration

Requirements

What You’ll Need

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, International Trade, Law, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, or a related discipline

- 5–7 years of professional experience in commercial planning, sales operations, or commercial project management;

- Experience in the defense or aerospace industry, as well as working knowledge of export-control regimes and hands-on experience with licence applications is a strong advantage

- Strong planning skills and operate with high level of accuracy

- Excellent coordination and stakeholder-management skills

- Fluent in English.
- Dutch, German or Spanish will be a plus

Who You Are

You are a structured, highly organised professional who creates clarity where there is ambiguity and keeps many moving parts on track at once. You combine a planner’s discipline with a hands-on, pragmatic approach, and you are comfortable being the connective tissue between various internal and external stakeholders. You understand the seriousness of export controls and treat compliance as non-negotiable. You are diplomatic enough to bring people along, yet firm enough to hold the line on deadlines and process. Above all, you are motivated by the mission, ensuring Destinus can compete and win in the global defense market through commercial excellence.

postings.title: Computer Vision Engineer
postings.description:
About the role

Imagine pushing the boundaries of what machines can perceive and decide, refining the intelligence behind autonomous flight systems that operate in the real world. You'll work directly improves the accuracy, reliability, and adaptability of cutting-edge AI products, while also opening the door to entirely new capabilities and applications. You will evolve existing algorithms and models, and design new ones that allow our systems to perform in increasingly complex and demanding environments.

At Destinus, we are shaping the future of defense through high-speed, autonomous flight technologies. We develop next-generation unmanned aerial systems that deliver greater speed, precision, and efficiency, supporting governments and defense organizations in mission-critical operations worldwide.
Daedalean AG, the AI and autonomy hub of the Destinus Group, plays a key role in this vision. Developing safety-critical AI systems at the intersection of advanced research and real-world aviation. Enabling machines to perceive, understand, and make decisions in real time.Together, we combine aerospace engineering and artificial intelligence to build the next generation of autonomous flight systems, driving innovation where it matters most.

What You´ll Do

- Develop and implement computer vision algorithms and deep learning models for localization and mapping, object detection and tracking, classification, general image processing, and related functions - as well as analyze, extend, and improve the existing code base and models.
- Collaborate with other engineering teams (such as flight testing, hardware, sensor fusion) to integrate computer vision solutions into prototypes and products.
- Test and evaluate the performance, robustness, and reliability of computer vision systems in diverse conditions, to ensure accuracy, reliability, and efficiency. This may involve both simulated and real-world environments.

Requirements

What You’ll Need

- Excellent programming skills in C++; experience with Rust is a plus.
- Experience with computer vision systems, ideally including both classical techniques and deep learning methods.
- Hands-on experience with tools like OpenCV, PyTorch, TensorFlow.
- Master’s or PhD degree in Computer Vision, Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.

Who You Are

You thrive in complex, high-stakes environments where precision matters, driven by curiosity to make systems smarter and more reliable. You experiment, iterate, and solve without waiting for direction, balancing deep technical thinking with real-world impact. Ownership comes naturally, collaboration is seamless, and there is a constant drive to push for excellence.

postings.title: Defense Program Manager
postings.description:
About the role

Imagine this. You are leading complex defence programmes where advanced aerospace and defence systems move from engineering development into testing, qualification, certification and operational delivery. You bring structure to complexity, connect technical teams with customer requirements, and make sure critical programmes keep moving forward.

At Destinus, we are developing and delivering advanced interceptors and strike systems designed for the evolving demands of modern defence operations. Our technologies combine speed, autonomy, precision and advanced engineering to deliver mission-critical capabilities for defence customers worldwide. We work at the edge of what is technically possible, turning ambitious concepts into systems built to perform in demanding operational environments.

As our Defense Program Manager, you will take ownership of strategic defence programmes in the Netherlands, coordinating closely with customers, engineering, operations, testing and leadership teams.

This role sits at the intersection of defence, engineering and programme delivery. We are looking for someone who understands complex military programmes and can successfully lead advanced defence systems through development, testing, qualification, certification and delivery.

Requirements

What You’ll Do

- Lead complex defence programmes, taking ownership of execution, planning and delivery

- Build trusted relationships with customers and key external stakeholders, acting as a strong interface between their requirements and our internal teams

- Coordinate multidisciplinary teams across engineering, operations, testing, production and other programme functions

- Translate customer and operational requirements into clear priorities and deliverables for technical teams

- Manage programme scope, milestones, dependencies, risks, budgets and deliverables

- Drive programmes through development, testing, qualification and certification activities

- Ensure alignment between customer expectations, operational requirements and engineering development

- Identify programme risks early and drive practical solutions across technical, operational and stakeholder challenges

- Represent Destinus in meetings with government, military, industry and other relevant stakeholders

- Contribute to strengthening Destinus' long-term position within the European defence ecosystem

What You’ll Need

- Significant experience managing complex defence, military, aerospace or advanced technology programmes

- Experience working with interceptors, strike systems, weapons systems, missiles, military platforms or comparable complex defence technologies

- Demonstrated experience taking military or defence systems through development, testing, qualification and certification

- Strong understanding of defence programme environments, including the technical, regulatory and operational requirements involved in delivering military systems

- Good technical understanding and the ability to work effectively with engineering and product development teams

- Strong programme management capabilities across planning, risk management, stakeholder management and cross-functional coordination

- Ability to communicate effectively with senior customer stakeholders and highly technical engineering teams

- Strong relationship-building skills and the credibility to represent Destinus with senior external stakeholders

- Professional fluency in Dutch and English

Who You Are

You are comfortable taking ownership of complex, high-stakes programmes where technical performance, customer expectations and delivery timelines all need to come together. You bring structure without creating unnecessary bureaucracy and know how to keep multidisciplinary teams moving toward a common goal.

You combine a pragmatic, hands-on mindset with enough technical depth to challenge assumptions, understand engineering constraints and make informed decisions. You thrive in fast-moving environments where there is still plenty to build, define and solve.

Security screening is an integral component of the selection process, ensuring that candidates meet the organization's security standards and safeguarding against potential risks.

Providing a Certificate of Conduct (VOG) is a standard part of the application process at Destinus.

postings.title: Demonstration Operations Specialist
postings.description:
Imagine this, you are the face of Destinus in the field, delivering world-class UAV demonstrations that showcase the future of autonomous defense technology. As part of the Demonstration Team, your primary mission is to execute safe, reliable, and highly professional flight demonstrations for military customers, government stakeholders, and strategic partners across multiple countries.

Every demonstration is an opportunity to prove the performance, reliability, and operational value of our systems. That means being fully prepared, technically sharp, and ready to support mission-critical activities whenever needed. You will work closely with engineering and flight operations teams to ensure every aircraft, system, and mission is thoroughly tested, mission-ready, and executed to the highest standards.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You’ll Do

- Serve as a key member of the Demonstration Team, supporting UAV demonstrations, deployments, and operational showcases across multiple countries

- Operate fixed-wing UAV systems during customer demonstrations, test flights, and field operations

- Maintain continuous demonstration readiness, ensuring aircraft, payloads, ground control stations, and support equipment are fully tested and mission-ready

- Support flight preparation activities including mission planning, airspace coordination, weather assessment, system validation, and operational risk analysis

- Perform launch, flight, and recovery operations in manual, assisted, and autonomous modes

- Operate ground control stations, telemetry systems, datalinks, and mission communication systems

- Support EO/IR and surveillance payload operations during demonstrations and operational missions

- Conduct troubleshooting, field maintenance, and technical support activities during deployments

- Work closely with engineering and flight test teams to support aircraft validation and continuous performance improvement

- Maintain accurate flight logs, operational reports, maintenance records, and technical documentation

- Ensure compliance with flight safety standards and applicable UAV regulations during VLOS and BVLOS operations

- Participate in advanced operational UAV training in Ukraine to continuously develop tactical, technical, and operational capabilities

- Support demonstration campaigns and operational deployments across multiple international locations, maintaining flexibility to operate wherever mission requirements demand

Requirements

What You’ll Need

- Minimum 5 years of experience operating fixed-wing UAV systems in military, aerospace, defense, or flight test environments

- Military background is required, preferably within aviation, reconnaissance, UAV operations, artillery, intelligence, special operations, or other operational military environments

- Strong engineering understanding with the ability to work effectively alongside aerospace and technical teams

- Hands-on experience operating ground control stations, telemetry systems, mission software, and UAV communication architectures

- Strong understanding of UAV avionics, electronics, datalinks, and flight systems

- Experience operating UAVs in both manual and autonomous flight modes

- Experience supporting military exercises, operational deployments, or mission-critical activities is highly valued

- Strong understanding of military operational procedures, mission planning, risk assessment, and field operations

- Ability to troubleshoot technical issues and maintain operational effectiveness in demanding field environments

- Valid UAV certifications A1, A2, A3, and Specific

- Strong situational awareness, communication skills, and safety-focused decision making

- Fluency in English is required; any other language is a plus

Who You Are

- You are a disciplined and dependable UAV operator with a strong military mindset

- You combine technical expertise with excellent operational execution

- You remain calm under pressure and make sound decisions in dynamic environments

- You understand that every demonstration represents the company and consistently maintain the highest standards of professionalism

- You take ownership of mission success and can be trusted to perform when it matters most

- You thrive in deployment environments where adaptability, teamwork, and precision are essential

- You are committed to continuous learning and operational excellence

Benefits

Why Join Us?

✨ The Thrill of the Future – Work on cutting-edge projects that redefine aerospace.
✨ Global Innovation Hub – Collaborate with top engineers from all over the world.
✨ Fast-Paced & High-Growth – Experience the rush of working in a rapidly expanding company.
✨ Real Impact – Your work won’t be theoretical—it will shape the future of flight.

Destinus is an equal-opportunity employer. We value diversity in our companies and our teams and do not discriminate based on age, race, religion, color, country of origin, gender, sexual orientation, or disability status.

🚀 Destinus – Challenge the limits of time, space, and human potential.

postings.title: Digital Signal Processing Engineer
postings.description:
About the Role

Imagine this. You are working on a precision inertial sensor built around a mechanically resonant sensing element, where measurement quality depends on keeping that element oscillating at exactly the right frequency and amplitude and extracting a clean, reliable signal from it.

As a Digital Signal Processing Engineer, you will own the algorithms that make this possible. You will define how the control loops behave, build the estimation and compensation methods behind the sensor output, and establish the mathematical models used to understand and validate performance. Other engineers will own the electronics and RTL implementation. You will own whether the maths, algorithms, and control strategy are right.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You’ll Do

- Design and simulate the control loops that keep the sensing element stable and locked, including frequency tracking through PLL, amplitude control through AGC, and quadrature nulling
- Define loop architectures, bandwidths, gains, stability margins, and other control parameters based on sensor physics and system-level performance requirements
- Develop the slower outer-loop algorithms responsible for bias estimation, thermal compensation, and state estimation, ideally implementing them in maintainable C/C++ for embedded targets
- Design and implement Kalman filtering approaches that transform the output of the locked sensing element into an accurate and usable rate measurement
- Own the co-simulation environment used to compare hardware implementation against the physics-based reference model and identify the source of discrepancies
- Build mathematical and simulation models in Python or MATLAB to explore sensor behaviour, test algorithms, and validate design decisions before implementation
- Establish and interpret sensor characterisation methods including Allan variance, bias instability, angular random walk, scale-factor linearity, and related performance metrics
- Work closely with electronics, FPGA, embedded software, physics, and systems engineers to translate mathematical models into robust real-world implementations
- Investigate unexpected sensor behaviour from first principles, connecting physical effects, measurements, models, and algorithms to find the underlying cause

Requirements

What You’ll Need

- B.Sc., M.Sc. or PhD in Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Applied Physics, Control Theory, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related technical field
- Strong foundation in control theory and digital signal processing, including closed-loop design, stability and phase margin, discrete-time filter design, demodulation, I/Q processing, and phase-locked loops
- Practical experience with state estimation and Kalman filtering, including linear, extended, or adaptive approaches applied to real physical systems
- Strong Python or MATLAB skills for mathematical modelling, simulation, data analysis, and algorithm development
- Ability to translate complex physical behaviour into clear mathematical models and scalable algorithmic solutions
- Confidence working from first principles, including reading technical literature, extracting the underlying model, challenging assumptions, and turning theory into a working simulation
- Ability to work effectively across disciplines and communicate complex mathematical concepts to engineers working on hardware, FPGA, embedded software, and system-level development
- Experience writing maintainable C/C++ for embedded targets is strongly preferred
- Previous experience with resonant sensors, MEMS inertial sensors, vibratory gyroscopes, or similar sensing technologies is a strong advantage
- Familiarity with inertial navigation, sensor fusion, or GNSS-denied navigation is an advantage
- Experience within aerospace, defence, robotics, or another high-performance engineering environment is a plus
- Bare-metal or RTOS embedded development experience is a plus

Who You Are

You enjoy problems where physics, mathematics, and real hardware meet. You are analytical without getting stuck in theory and comfortable going from a research paper or physical model to simulation, implementation, and experimental validation. When measurements do not match expectations, you want to understand why. You take ownership of the technical answer, challenge assumptions with data, and work naturally with specialists across hardware and software to turn complex sensor behaviour into reliable, high-performance algorithms.

postings.title: Director of Accounting & Controlling
postings.description:
Imagine this. You are building the accounting and controlling backbone behind a fast-growing aerospace and defence company operating across multiple countries, manufacturing sites, and legal entities. As Director of Accounting & Controlling, you will own the integrity of our group financial reporting, set the standard for IFRS and local GAAP compliance, and make sure our numbers are accurate, controlled, scalable, and audit-ready.

Reporting directly to the CFO, you will be the group's senior technical accounting authority and a key finance leader across the organization. This is not a role for someone who wants to manage accounting from a distance. You will set the agenda, challenge existing processes, solve complex accounting issues, and drive execution across a distributed international finance organization.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You'll Do

- Lead the monthly, quarterly, and annual group close across all consolidated entities, ensuring accurate, complete, and timely financial reporting
- Own the group close calendar and drive execution across Accounting, Controlling, FP&A, Tax, Treasury, and regional finance teams
- Act as the senior escalation point for complex accounting and close issues, driving them to resolution without compromising reporting quality or timelines
- Coordinate consolidation adjustments, intercompany eliminations, foreign currency translation, and other group-level accounting activities
- Own and continuously strengthen internal accounting controls, policies, and their consistent application across the group
- Drive improvements to our ERP and finance systems landscape, including Microsoft Dynamics environments, IFRS and local GAAP configurations, regional VAT setups, transfer pricing, intercompany eliminations, and consolidation processes
- Own group-wide cost accounting standards and methodologies across manufacturing entities, including standard and actual costing, absorption, WIP, and variance analysis
- Lead the Operations Finance function through the Operations Finance Lead and ensure disciplined capture and reporting of manufacturing costs including labor, overhead, scrap, absorption, and WIP
- Own the variance bridge process and ensure significant deviations are understood, explained, and assigned to the right accountable teams across Manufacturing, Program Management, Procurement, and Finance
- Connect Cost Accounting, Operations, Manufacturing, and Program Management so operational drivers such as volume, yield, labor mix, and capacity utilization are reflected in forecasts and budgets
- Partner closely with FP&A to ensure accounting actuals, forecasts, and budgets remain methodologically aligned as the business scales
- Own accounting judgments related to inventory, WIP, and program cost capitalization under IAS 2
- Govern the group chart of accounts and ensure it remains consistent, scalable, and aligned with consolidation and management reporting requirements
- Own balance sheet quality across the group, establishing clear standards for account ownership, reconciliations, substantiation, aging, suspense accounts, clearing accounts, and provisions
- Partner with FP&A and Treasury on working capital, provisions, capex accounting, and other balance sheet forecasting inputs
- Oversee AP and AR processes across the group, strengthening controls, segregation of duties, cash conversion, and sub-ledger reconciliation
- Drive DSO and DPO discipline and establish robust policies around credit control, payment terms, and dispute resolution
- Act as the primary management counterpart for external auditors across group and statutory audits
- Own audit timelines, PBC processes, technical accounting documentation, and the timely resolution of audit findings
- Ensure statutory financial statements are accurate and filed on time across jurisdictions in coordination with local teams and external advisors
- Support lender and investor diligence with accurate, audit-ready financial schedules and clear technical accounting narratives
- Standardize accounting processes and controls across entities and eliminate unnecessary manual workarounds as the organization grows
- Partner with IT and ERP teams to build scalable accounting, costing, consolidation, and reporting structures within systems such as Microsoft Dynamics 365
- Own group accounting policies, procedures, and SOPs, creating a consistent framework for control, onboarding, and training
- Build and develop a high-performing accounting and controlling organization across multiple European jurisdictions, setting clear expectations and creating accountability across direct and indirect teams
- Mentor Controllers and Accounting Managers across the group and act as the technical escalation point when complex accounting decisions need to be made

Requirements

What You'll Need

- 10+ years of progressive Accounting, Controlling, or Finance experience, including substantial responsibility within a multi-entity, multi-currency European environment
- Public company experience is required
- Deep technical knowledge of IFRS and strong familiarity with local GAAP requirements across European jurisdictions
- Demonstrated experience owning group accounting policies and making complex technical accounting judgments
- Proven experience leading group close and consolidation processes at significant scale, ideally within environments exceeding EUR 1 billion in revenue
- Strong manufacturing cost accounting experience, including standard and actual costing, variance analysis, absorption, inventory, and WIP
- Experience working closely with Manufacturing and Operations teams, with the ability to connect operational performance with financial outcomes
- Strong ERP experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365, SAP, Oracle, or an equivalent large-scale platform, including exposure to chart-of-accounts design, costing structures, consolidation, and finance transformation
- Experience leading geographically distributed finance teams and developing senior accounting and controlling professionals
- Excellent English communication skills, with additional European languages considered an advantage
- Experience within aerospace, defence, industrial manufacturing, or another regulated and program-driven environment is strongly preferred
- Experience with statutory reporting requirements across multiple European jurisdictions is a strong advantage
- Familiarity with program-based revenue recognition, government or institutional customers, and complex manufacturing environments is an advantage.

Who You Are

You combine technical accounting depth with the drive to get things done. You care about clean numbers, strong controls, and clear ownership, but you also understand that Finance needs to move at the speed of the business.

You are comfortable being the person people turn to when the accounting answer is not obvious. You challenge assumptions, translate complex IFRS topics into practical decisions, and know when to go deep and when to move quickly.

You think beyond the next close. You build processes, systems, and teams that can support a company as it grows across countries, manufacturing sites, and increasingly complex operations. You work naturally across Accounting, FP&A, Treasury, Tax, Manufacturing, Operations, and leadership, and you are persistent about getting decisions and open issues to closure.

Most importantly, you build capability around you. You develop strong teams, create accountability, and make sure critical accounting knowledge is embedded across the organization rather than concentrated in one person.

postings.title: Director of Accounting & Controlling
postings.description:
Imagine this. You are building the accounting and controlling backbone behind a fast-growing aerospace and defence company operating across multiple countries, manufacturing sites, and legal entities. As Director of Accounting & Controlling, you will own the integrity of our group financial reporting, set the standard for IFRS and local GAAP compliance, and make sure our numbers are accurate, controlled, scalable, and audit-ready.

Reporting directly to the CFO, you will be the group's senior technical accounting authority and a key finance leader across the organization. This is not a role for someone who wants to manage accounting from a distance. You will set the agenda, challenge existing processes, solve complex accounting issues, and drive execution across a distributed international finance organization.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

- Lead the monthly, quarterly, and annual group close across all consolidated entities, ensuring accurate, complete, and timely financial reporting
- Own the group close calendar and drive execution across Accounting, Controlling, FP&A, Tax, Treasury, and regional finance teams
- Act as the senior escalation point for complex accounting and close issues, driving them to resolution without compromising reporting quality or timelines
- Coordinate consolidation adjustments, intercompany eliminations, foreign currency translation, and other group-level accounting activities
- Own and continuously strengthen internal accounting controls, policies, and their consistent application across the group
- Drive improvements to our ERP and finance systems landscape, including Microsoft Dynamics environments, IFRS and local GAAP configurations, regional VAT setups, transfer pricing, intercompany eliminations, and consolidation processes
- Own group-wide cost accounting standards and methodologies across manufacturing entities, including standard and actual costing, absorption, WIP, and variance analysis
- Lead the Operations Finance function through the Operations Finance Lead and ensure disciplined capture and reporting of manufacturing costs including labor, overhead, scrap, absorption, and WIP
- Own the variance bridge process and ensure significant deviations are understood, explained, and assigned to the right accountable teams across Manufacturing, Program Management, Procurement, and Finance
- Connect Cost Accounting, Operations, Manufacturing, and Program Management so operational drivers such as volume, yield, labor mix, and capacity utilization are reflected in forecasts and budgets
- Partner closely with FP&A to ensure accounting actuals, forecasts, and budgets remain methodologically aligned as the business scales

- Experience with statutory reporting requirements across multiple European jurisdictions is a strong advantage
