postings.title: Electronic Technician
postings.description:
About the role

Imagine this. You’re the person who keeps critical electronic systems running at peak performance. From diagnosing complex circuit issues to bringing high precision electronic modules back to life, your work directly supports the next generation of aerospace and defense technology. As an Electronic Technician at Destinus in Sofia, you will work hands-on with advanced electronic systems in a fast-moving environment where precision, technical curiosity, and problem-solving matter every single day.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You´ll Do

- Diagnose, troubleshoot, and repair electronic devices, modules, and printed circuit boards
- Identify and eliminate faults in electronic circuits, components, and communication systems
- Perform replacement, adjustment, and calibration of electronic components including resistors, capacitors, transistors, and integrated circuits
- Work with specialized measuring equipment, calibration tools, and technical software
- Carry out preventive maintenance and technical servicing of electronic equipment
- Read and interpret electrical schematics, technical drawings, specifications, and documentation
- Assemble and disassemble electronic modules and systems with high attention to detail
- Perform SMD and THT soldering and support PCB repair activities
- Support installation and servicing activities both at the company facility and client locations when required
- Ensure compliance with occupational safety standards, electrical safety procedures, and internal technical regulations
- Contribute to maintaining high quality standards across all production and repair activities

Requirements

What You’ll Need

- Secondary technical or higher education in telecommunications, electronics, or information technology
- Good understanding of analog and digital communication technologies
- Hands-on experience with electronic equipment, diagnostics, and repair activities
- Experience working with measuring instruments and calibration equipment
- Ability to read and understand electronic diagrams and technical documentation
- SMD and THT soldering skills
- Strong attention to detail, precision, and problem-solving mindset
- Ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively with different teams
- Written and spoken English communication skills
- Understanding of occupational safety, fire protection, and technical supervision regulations
- Familiarity with technical maintenance and preventive servicing processes is considered a plus

Who You Are

You are someone who enjoys solving technical challenges and working hands-on with complex electronic systems. You stay focused under pressure, take pride in delivering reliable and precise work, and approach problems with a practical mindset. You thrive in fast-paced environments where innovation moves quickly and continuous improvement is part of everyday work. You value responsibility, teamwork, and professionalism, while also being confident working independently when needed. Most importantly, you take ownership of your work and understand the importance of quality, safety, and attention to detail in everything you do.

postings.title: Electronics Engineer
postings.description:
About the role

Imagine developing the avionics systems that enable advanced aerospace vehicles to fly, communicate, navigate, and perform critical missions. As an Electonics Engineer, you will design, integrate, and test flight-critical electronic systems, working closely with multidisciplinary teams to transform innovative concepts into reliable, high-performance products. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex technical challenges and contributing to the future of aerospace technology. And don't worry, we will teach you everything about aviation.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You´ll Do

- Hardware Design & Development - Design, develop, and test flight computer hardware, including schematic capture, PCB layout, and manufacturing files preparation.
- Requirement & Lifecycle Ownership -Own the full hardware development process - from gathering and tracking technical requirements with key stakeholders to early prototyping, hardware bring-up, and validation.
- Test Bench Software - Develop, maintain, and execute software scripts for automated hardware test benches running in a Linux environment to validate avionics devices functionality.
- Multidisciplinary Communication - Act as the primary technical point of contact for the hardware modules you own, communicating effectively with mechanical, GNC, and system teams to ensure seamless integration.
- System Integration & Diagnostics - Perform rigorous system integration, functional testing, fault handling, and diagnostics on both lab and field hardware.
- Process & Organization - Apply a highly structured and organized mindset to hardware design reviews, documentation, and continuous reliability improvements.
- Flight Operations - Support flight testing preparation, setup, telemetry monitoring, and field operations.

Requirements

What You’ll Need

- Education - Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent.
- Experience - 2+ years of hands-on experience developing avionics or complex hardware systems.
- PCB Design - Strong proficiency in PCB design and layout using Altium.
- Test Bench & Linux - Proven experience writing software/scripts (e.g., Python, C/C++, or Bash) for hardware testing and validation within a Linux environment.
- Embedded Systems - Working knowledge of embedded C/C++ programming and microcontrollers (e.g., STM32) to support hardware validation and integration.
- Debugging & Lab Tools - Highly comfortable with system-level troubleshooting and using standard lab equipment (oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, electronic loads, JTAG).
- Interfaces - Solid understanding of serial protocols and hardware interfaces (e.g., SPI, I2C, CAN, UART).
- Mindset & Soft Skills - Highly structured, organized, and detail-oriented. Excellent communication skills with a proven ability to manage technical requirements and thrive in a fast-paced, cross-disciplinary environment.

Who You Are

You are an engineer who is passionate about aviation technology and enjoys turning complex challenges into practical solutions. You thrive in multidisciplinary environments where hardware, software, and systems come together, and you are comfortable collaborating with experts across engineering disciplines. With a strong attention to detail and a hands-on mindset, you take ownership of your work and approach problems with curiosity, creativity, and analytical thinking. You communicate clearly, adapt quickly to evolving priorities, and are motivated by seeing your designs move from concept to flight-ready reality. Most importantly, you are driven by innovation and excited to contribute to the development of cutting-edge aerospace systems.

postings.title: EM and Antenna Engineer
postings.description:
Imagine this You are designing the electromagnetic foundation behind next generation autonomous aerospace systems. As an EM and Antenna Engineer, you will develop, simulate, and optimize advanced RF and mmWave technologies that enable reliable communications, navigation, sensing, and radar performance across Destinus platforms. From antenna integration to radar cross section analysis, your work will directly influence the performance and survivability of our UAVs in demanding operational environments.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You'll Do

- Perform electromagnetic simulations of RF and mmWave designs using industry leading simulation tools
- Analyze complex electromagnetic structures and present simulation results with clear technical recommendations to the engineering team
- Identify opportunities to improve RF performance through simulation driven design optimization
- Conduct Radar Cross Section simulations for both Destinus platforms and external airborne vehicles to support threat assessment and signature reduction activities
- Design and optimize radomes that balance electromagnetic performance with structural and environmental requirements
- Lead the integration of antenna systems across UAV platforms, ensuring reliable performance of navigation, communication, radar, and other wireless subsystems
- Optimize the coexistence of multiple antenna systems by evaluating placement, coupling, and electromagnetic interactions
- Design and evaluate antenna elements and arrays for aerospace applications
- Support antenna validation through laboratory, field, and anechoic chamber measurements, including radiation patterns, reflection coefficients, and other key performance metrics
- Collaborate closely with multidisciplinary teams across RF, avionics, systems engineering, mechanical design, and flight testing to deliver fully integrated solutions

Requirements

What You'll Need

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electromagnetics, Telecommunications, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field
- Strong experience with electromagnetic simulation using Ansys HFSS
- Familiarity with HFSS 3D Layout, PyAEDT, or Microwave Office AWR is considered an advantage
- Programming experience in Python and or MATLAB for automation, simulation, and data analysis
- Experience performing Radar Cross Section simulations of airborne vehicles and complex subsystems
- Strong understanding of radome design and electromagnetic materials
- Knowledge of frequency selective surfaces and metamaterials is a plus
- Experience designing and simulating complex multiport electromagnetic structures
- Experience with antenna element and antenna array design
- Knowledge of conformal antenna design is an advantage
- Strong understanding of antenna selection, placement, and performance optimization for UAV applications
- Experience integrating multiple antenna systems while minimizing electromagnetic interference and maximizing subsystem coexistence
- Knowledge of antenna measurement techniques in both field and anechoic chamber environments
- Professional proficiency in English

Who You Are

You are passionate about solving complex electromagnetic challenges and enjoy transforming simulation results into practical engineering solutions. You combine analytical thinking with a hands on engineering mindset and thrive when collaborating across multidisciplinary teams. You take ownership of your work, communicate technical concepts clearly, and continuously look for opportunities to improve system performance. Fast paced development environments motivate you, and you are excited by the opportunity to contribute to the next generation of autonomous aerospace technologies.

Security screening is an integral component of the selection process, ensuring that candidates meet the organization's security standards and safeguarding against potential risks.

Providing a Certificate of Conduct (VOG) is a standard part of the application process at Destinus.

postings.title: Energetics Safety & Assurance Officer
postings.description:
About the Role

Imagine this. You are the person ensuring that some of the most safety-critical aerospace and defense systems can move from design to production, integration, testing, and ultimately operation with the right level of assurance behind them. As our Energetics Safety & Assurance Officer, you will take ownership of the safety, quality, and regulatory assurance framework across missile and unmanned aerial system platforms, working closely with engineering, manufacturing, testing, and compliance teams.

This is a highly technical role where your expertise will directly influence how munitions, propulsion systems, warheads, guidance electronics, and other safety-critical systems are designed, handled, tested, and certified. You will have the authority and responsibility to identify risks early, challenge designs where needed, and make sure safety remains embedded throughout the entire product lifecycle.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You'll Do

- Develop, implement, and maintain the System Safety Program Plan SSPP in line with MIL-STD-882E and relevant regional or customer-specific standards

- Conduct and lead hazard analyses including PHA, SSHA and O&SHA, as well as Failure Mode and Effects Analysis FMEA and fault tree analysis across weapon and aerospace subsystems

- Own and maintain the hazard tracking process, driving identified risks through assessment, mitigation, verification, and closure

- Lead investigations into safety incidents, near misses, test anomalies, and other safety-critical events, defining and following through on corrective and preventive actions CAPA

- Oversee compliance with applicable explosives safety requirements covering siting, storage, handling, transportation, insensitive munitions, and quantity-distance criteria

- Work directly with range safety officers and internal teams to support live-fire and flight test campaigns

- Ensure energetic materials, warheads, propulsion systems, and other safety-critical components meet the necessary certification requirements before integration and testing

- Coordinate export control and end-use compliance documentation with legal and compliance teams in accordance with applicable arms export and dual-use regulations

- Interface with certifying authorities, government representatives, and customer quality teams throughout qualification and acceptance activities

- Maintain configuration control, documentation, and end-to-end traceability for safety-critical components and systems

- Act as the safety authority within Integrated Product Teams IPTs and provide safety input during key design and readiness reviews including PDR, CDR and TRR

- Advise engineering teams on safety-critical design margins, fail-safe and fail-operational architectures, arming and fuzing logic, and risk mitigation strategies

- Train and support production, integration, and test personnel in the safe handling of live and inert ordnance

- Provide senior leadership and relevant government safety boards with clear visibility of safety status, outstanding hazards, mitigations, and overall risk posture

Requirements

What You'll Need

- Bachelor's degree in Systems Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or another relevant technical discipline

- At least 8 years of professional experience in defense systems safety, explosives safety engineering, system safety engineering, or a closely related field within a defense manufacturing environment

- Strong working knowledge of MIL-STD-882E or equivalent system safety frameworks

- Practical knowledge of insensitive munitions requirements such as STANAG 4439-type frameworks and relevant range safety practices

- Hands-on experience conducting hazard analyses, FMEA, fault tree analysis, and developing safety case documentation

- Experience working with safety-critical hardware and complex multidisciplinary engineering systems

- Familiarity with export control regimes applicable to munitions, defense products, and dual-use technologies

- Strong technical documentation skills with the ability to turn complex safety assessments into clear actions and decisions

- Professional working proficiency in English

- A Master's degree in a relevant engineering discipline is a plus

- Certified Safety Professional CSP or an equivalent system safety qualification is a plus

- Direct experience with missile propulsion, energetic materials, warhead integration, arming and fuzing systems, or UAS flight test safety is highly valued

- Previous experience working with military airworthiness, range safety, ordnance certification, or other relevant government authorities is a strong advantage

Who You Are

You are rigorous without becoming bureaucratic. You understand that in safety-critical aerospace and defense systems, details matter, but you also know how to keep complex programmes moving. You are comfortable challenging assumptions, asking difficult technical questions, and standing behind your assessments when safety is on the line. You work naturally across engineering, manufacturing, testing, quality, and compliance teams, bringing structure to complex problems and turning risk into clear, actionable decisions. You take ownership, communicate with confidence, and thrive in an environment where technology moves fast and the standards remain exceptionally high.

- Work directly with range safety officers and internal teams to support live-fire and flight test campaigns

- Ensure energetic materials, warheads, propulsion systems, and other safety-critical components meet the necessary certification requirements before integration and testing

- Coordinate export control and end-use compliance documentation with legal and compliance teams in accordance with applicable arms export and dual-use regulations

- Interface with certifying authorities, government representatives, and customer quality teams throughout qualification and acceptance activities

- Maintain configuration control, documentation, and end-to-end traceability for safety-critical components and systems

- Act as the safety authority within Integrated Product Teams IPTs and provide safety input during key design and readiness reviews including PDR, CDR and TRR

- Advise engineering teams on safety-critical design margins, fail-safe and fail-operational architectures, arming and fuzing logic, and risk mitigation strategies

- Train and support production, integration, and test personnel in the safe handling of live and inert ordnance

- Provide senior leadership and relevant government safety boards with clear visibility of safety status, outstanding hazards, mitigations, and overall risk posture

Requirements

What You'll Need

- Bachelor's degree in Systems Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or another relevant technical discipline

- At least 8 years of professional experience in defense systems safety, explosives safety engineering, system safety engineering, or a closely related field within a defense manufacturing environment

- Strong working knowledge of MIL-STD-882E or equivalent system safety frameworks

- Practical knowledge of insensitive munitions requirements such as STANAG 4439-type frameworks and relevant range safety practices

- Hands-on experience conducting hazard analyses, FMEA, fault tree analysis, and developing safety case documentation

- Experience working with safety-critical hardware and complex multidisciplinary engineering systems

- Familiarity with export control regimes applicable to munitions, defense products, and dual-use technologies

- Strong technical documentation skills with the ability to turn complex safety assessments into clear actions and decisions

- Professional working proficiency in English

- A Master's degree in a relevant engineering discipline is a plus

- Certified Safety Professional CSP or an equivalent system safety qualification is a plus

- Direct experience with missile propulsion, energetic materials, warhead integration, arming and fuzing systems, or UAS flight test safety is highly valued

- Previous experience working with military airworthiness, range safety, ordnance certification, or other relevant government authorities is a strong advantage

Who You Are

You are rigorous without becoming bureaucratic. You understand that in safety-critical aerospace and defense systems, details matter, but you also know how to keep complex programmes moving. You are comfortable challenging assumptions, asking difficult technical questions, and standing behind your assessments when safety is on the line. You work naturally across engineering, manufacturing, testing, quality, and compliance teams, bringing structure to complex problems and turning risk into clear, actionable decisions. You take ownership, communicate with confidence, and thrive in an environment where technology moves fast and the standards remain exceptionally high.

postings.title: Energetics Systems Integration Lead
postings.description:
About the Role

Imagine this. You are leading the integration of complex aerospace and defense systems where mechanical, electrical, propulsion, guidance, and energetic components all need to work together safely and reliably. As our Energetics Systems Integration Lead, you will take technical ownership of the integration of missile systems, warheads, fuzes, and payloads for unmanned aerial platforms, from initial assembly through testing and acceptance.

This is a senior, hands-on engineering role for someone who understands both the technical complexity and the responsibility that comes with working around energetic materials. You will work across engineering, safety, quality, manufacturing, and testing teams to solve integration challenges, manage technical risks, and ensure every system meets demanding safety, quality, and performance requirements.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You'll Do

- Lead end-to-end technical integration of missile subsystems including airframe, propulsion, guidance, warhead, and fuzing components, ensuring alignment with programme specifications, interfaces, and safety requirements
- Oversee warhead and fuze integration activities, working closely with design, safety, manufacturing, and quality teams to ensure functional requirements and safety interlocks are correctly implemented and verified
- Lead the integration of payloads onto unmanned aerial systems, ensuring compatibility across mechanical, electrical, software, and system-level interfaces
- Develop and maintain integration test plans, procedures, acceptance criteria, and verification activities together with systems engineering and test teams
- Ensure explosive handling, storage, transportation, and integration activities are performed in accordance with applicable regulations and site-specific Explosive Safety Standard Operating Procedures ESSOPs
- Act as the technical point of contact for integration activities during internal and customer reviews, safety boards, and key programme milestones
- Identify integration risks, technical issues, interface conflicts, and safety hazards early and drive them through mitigation and closure
- Support programme design and readiness reviews including PDR and CDR, providing clear technical assessments of system integration maturity and outstanding risks
- Lead root cause analysis and corrective action activities following integration issues, test anomalies, or safety-related events
- Maintain accurate technical documentation supporting configuration control, system traceability, verification, and regulatory audits
- Provide technical guidance and mentorship to integration engineers and technicians, helping build strong engineering practices across the team

Requirements

What You'll Need

- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or equivalent relevant experience

- At least 10 years of professional experience in missile, UAS, defense systems integration and testing within defense manufacturing, R&D, or a similarly regulated technical environment

- Demonstrated hands-on experience with warhead and fuze integration processes and the associated safety protocols

- Practical experience integrating defense systems integration or payloads onto unmanned aerial platforms

- Extensive and verifiable experience with the safe handling, storage, transportation, and integration of explosives and energetic materials

- Working knowledge of relevant explosive and ordnance safety requirements such as MIL-STD-1316, MIL-STD-2105, or applicable regional equivalents

- Strong understanding of systems engineering principles, system integration methodologies, verification and validation, and configuration management

- Experience developing and executing integration test plans and working with complex multidisciplinary hardware systems

- Ability to confidently read and interpret engineering drawings, Interface Control Documents ICDs, technical specifications, and system requirements

- Strong technical documentation and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, manufacturing, safety, quality, and programme teams

- Professional working proficiency in English

- An advanced degree in a relevant engineering discipline is a plus

- Previous experience within the military, a defense contractor, or a government ordnance facility is highly valued

- Certification in explosive ordnance handling or safety, such as Qualified Explosives Handler status or an equivalent qualification, is a strong advantage

- Experience with PDR, CDR, safety case development, qualification, and regulatory certification processes is a plus

- Familiarity with aerospace quality management systems such as AS9100 is beneficial

Who You Are

You are a hands-on technical leader who is comfortable working where complex engineering meets strict safety requirements. You understand that successful integration is not simply about making components fit together, but about understanding how the complete system behaves, identifying risks before they become problems, and making technically sound decisions under pressure. You take ownership, challenge assumptions when necessary, and communicate clearly across different engineering disciplines. You enjoy being close to the hardware, solving difficult integration problems, and helping others raise the technical bar.

postings.title: Engineering Intern / Traineeship
postings.description:
Imagine this. You are helping build the electronic foundation behind advanced aerospace and defence systems, making sure every component, symbol, footprint, and schematic detail is accurate before it reaches hardware.

As an Engineering Intern, you will work hands-on with Altium Designer and support our electronics engineers in creating and maintaining high-quality PCB design data. This is an opportunity to move beyond university projects and work with real engineering hardware where precision and attention to detail matter.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You'll Do

- Create, review, and maintain electronic components, schematic symbols, footprints, and library data in Altium Designer
- Read schematics and component datasheets to ensure design data accurately reflects manufacturer specifications
- Support engineers with PCB design activities and help maintain clean, consistent, and reliable component libraries
- Check existing components for errors, inconsistencies, and missing information before they make their way into hardware
- Help improve library management, component validation, and engineering workflows
- Use scripting and automation where useful to make repetitive checks faster and more reliable

Requirements

- Currently studying toward a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, or a related field, or recently graduated
- Hands-on experience with Altium Designer through university projects, personal PCB designs, or previous internships
- Comfortable with schematic capture, library editors, and creating your own symbols and footprints
- Ability to read schematics and datasheets, with a solid understanding of packages, pinouts, passive components, and common ICs
- Strong attention to detail and a structured approach to technical work
- Good written and spoken English
- Experience with Altium 365 or another managed library environment is a plus
- Familiarity with IPC-7351 footprint standards is an advantage
- Basic Python or similar scripting experience for automation and bulk checks is a plus
- Exposure to component lifecycle or obsolescence management is an advantage

Who You Are

You are curious, precise, and hands-on. You enjoy getting into the details and understand that a tiny mistake in a component library can become a very real hardware problem later. You work methodically, ask questions when something does not look right, and are excited to learn from experienced engineers while taking real ownership from day one.

Important considerations

All technical interview stages will be led on-prem at Destinus in Zurich.

postings.title: Flight Physics & Performance Engineer
postings.description:
We are looking for a highly capable Flight Physics & Performance Engineer to support the development, implementation, and validation of high-fidelity simulation environments for missile system performance analysis. In this role, you will design and maintain 6-degree-of-freedom (6-DoF) simulation frameworks, implement flight physics and guidance models, and ensure simulation tools are robust, scalable, and aligned with system requirements. You will work closely with multidisciplinary teams to enable accurate performance predictions and support broader system design activities.

This position is ideal for an engineer with strong analytical skills, hands-on experience in simulation toolchains, and a passion for advancing the modelling capabilities behind next-generation missile systems.

Responsibilities

· Develop, maintain, and extend 6-DoF simulation environments for missile performance assessment, system trade studies, and design validation.

· Implement and refine flight physics models, including aerodynamics, propulsion behavior, actuator dynamics, sensor models, and environmental effects.

· Build and integrate simulation tools and analysis utilities to support SIL, CIL, and HIL test configurations.

· Define, decompose, and manage system and simulation requirements using DOORS NG or similar systems engineering tools.

· Generate clear, structured, and technically rigorous documentation, covering modelling assumptions, equations of motion, validation results, and verification.

· Produce and execute test cases for requirement verification across multiple simulation levels (SIL, CIL, HIL).

· Work cross-functionally with Guidance, Navigation & Control (GNC), Systems Engineering, Software, and Flight Dynamics teams to ensure model fidelity and alignment with system needs.

· Participate in design and technical reviews, presenting simulation methodologies, performance outcomes, and model limitations.

· Support algorithm development teams by providing simulation environments, interfaces, and validation scenarios.

· Actively contribute to continuous improvement of internal simulation capabilities, toolchains, and workflows.

· Represent the simulation domain in external collaborations, technical meetings, or strategic advisory groups when required.

Requirements

· Proven experience developing and managing 6-DoF simulations for aerospace or missile systems.

· Strong understanding of flight mechanics, aerodynamics, propulsion models, rigid-body dynamics, and related numerical methods.

· Hands-on experience with simulation tool development, including model integration, scenario generation, and test automation.

· Proven coding experience preferred: Python, C/C++, Rust.

· Experience with SIL, CIL, and HIL simulations and verification processes.

· Strong technical writing skills and experience in producing advanced engineering documentation.

· Proficiency with MATLAB/Simulink or equivalent modelling environments; experience with MathWorks tools is highly valued.

· Ability to work collaboratively in multidisciplinary teams and communicate complex technical topics clearly.

· Proactive attitude, good problem-solving skills, and willingness to take ownership of simulation tasks and toolchain development.

MSc in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or related fields.

· Fluency in English is a must.

postings.title: GNC Engineer
postings.description:
About the role

Imagine designing the intelligence that guides a system through extreme conditions with precision and reliability. As a Guidance, Navigation and Control Engineer at Destinus, you will build and refine the algorithms that make autonomous flight systems think, adapt, and perform in real time. From shaping guidance laws to developing navigation filters and control architectures, your work directly impacts how advanced aerospace systems behave in mission critical scenarios.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You´ll Do

- Drive the development of GNC algorithms, including guidance laws, navigation filters, and control architectures with a high level of autonomy.
- Develop, maintain, and extend GNC software solutions for safety-critical applications, from early prototyping through to flight-ready implementation.
- Implement and refine GNC models and algorithms, including inertial navigation, target tracking, autopilot control loops, seeker processing, and environmental compensation.
- Build and integrate simulation and test utilities to support SIL and HIL test configurations, enabling rigorous validation of GNC functionality across integration levels.
- Define, decompose, and manage GNC-specific system and software requirements, ensuring full traceability from concept through verification.
- Generate clear, structured, and technically rigorous documentation, covering algorithm design, modelling assumptions, validation results, and verification evidence.
- Work cross-functionally with Systems Engineering, Simulation & Modelling, Flight Dynamics, Software, and Hardware teams to ensure GNC algorithm performance and alignment with overall system needs.
- Participate in design and technical reviews, presenting GNC methodologies, performance outcomes, and known limitations.
- Support Simulation-Modelling and Software teams by providing algorithm specifications, interface definitions, and GNC validation scenarios.
- Actively contribute to continuous improvement of internal GNC capabilities, tool chains, and algorithm development workflows.

Requirements

What You’ll Need

- MSc in Aerospace Engineering, Automation & Control Engineering, or a related field.
- 3-5 years of experience as GNC Engineer on flying systems (UAVs, rockets, missiles).
- Proven experience with GNC algorithm development.
- Proven coding experience, preferred: Python, Rust or C/C++.
- Experience with SIL and HIL simulations and verification processes.
- Strong technical writing skills and experience producing advanced engineering documentation.
- Ability to work collaboratively in multidisciplinary teams and communicate complex technical topics clearly.
- Proactive attitude, good problem-solving skills, and willingness to take ownership of GNC tasks and development.
- Fluency in English is a must.

Who You Are

You thrive in environments where precision meets speed and complexity is part of the daily game. You enjoy turning mathematical models into real-world performance and you are not afraid to dive deep into both theory and code to make things work under pressure. You think analytically but act pragmatically, balancing innovation with reliability when it matters most. You take ownership of your work, pushing solutions until they are not just functional but robust and ready for real-world deployment.

postings.title: Guidance, Navigation & Control Engineer
postings.description:
Imagine this, you own the guidance, navigation, and control behind an exo-atmospheric interceptor, including the final seconds where precision determines whether the engagement succeeds.

Bliksem Exo is a four-nation European consortium developing an anti-ballistic missile system at operational pace. Destinus is the programme prime and responsible for the exo-atmospheric interceptor, engineered for affordability and production at scale.

In this role, you will own the flight simulation, navigation, guidance, and control algorithms that take the interceptor from flight to terminal engagement. You will work hands-on with the models and analysis, translating performance results directly into vehicle requirements and engineering decisions.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You'll Do

- Build and own the six-degree-of-freedom flight simulation used as the reference model for vehicle performance and analysis
- Develop navigation and estimation throughout the flight, manage the error budget through handover, and develop terminal guidance for the final engagement
- Own the terminal miss budget, quantifying how sensing noise, timing, disturbances, and other uncertainties affect end-to-end accuracy
- Design and tune control algorithms across the phases of flight, assessing stability and robustness throughout the operating envelope
- Run analysis and simulation campaigns across nominal and stressing conditions, translating findings into vehicle and subsystem requirements
- Work closely with the wider engineering team to integrate GNC performance into the overall interceptor design

Who You Are

- You are comfortable owning complex GNC problems from mathematical models through implementation and validation
- You think in terms of complete system performance rather than isolated algorithms
- You challenge models, assumptions, and results until you understand what drives performance
- You thrive in a small technical team where ownership, speed, and engineering judgement matter

Requirements

- BSc, MSc, or PhD in Aerospace Engineering, Control Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related field
- 10+ years of GNC experience on missiles, interceptors, spacecraft, launch vehicles, or comparable high-performance systems
- Strong expertise in at least two areas across guidance, navigation and estimation, and control, with solid understanding across the complete GNC loop
- Experience developing and implementing flight-proven systems for hypersonic and/or space applications, including qualified hardware and software
- Strong MATLAB, Simulink and/or Python skills
- Nice to have: Experience taking GNC systems through hardware-in-the-loop testing and/or flight testing

Bliksem Exo is a four-nation European consortium developing an anti-ballistic missile system at operational pace. Destinus is the programme prime and responsible for the exo-atmospheric interceptor, engineered for affordability and production at scale.

In this role, you will own the flight simulation, navigation, guidance, and control algorithms that take the interceptor from flight to terminal engagement. You will work hands-on with the models and analysis, translating performance results directly into vehicle requirements and engineering decisions.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You'll Do

- Build and own the six-degree-of-freedom flight simulation used as the reference model for vehicle performance and analysis
- Develop navigation and estimation throughout the flight, manage the error budget through handover, and develop terminal guidance for the final engagement
- Own the terminal miss budget, quantifying how sensing noise, timing, disturbances, and other uncertainties affect end-to-end accuracy
- Design and tune control algorithms across the phases of flight, assessing stability and robustness throughout the operating envelope
- Run analysis and simulation campaigns across nominal and stressing conditions, translating findings into vehicle and subsystem requirements
- Work closely with the wider engineering team to integrate GNC performance into the overall interceptor design

Who You Are

- You are comfortable owning complex GNC problems from mathematical models through implementation and validation
- You think in terms of complete system performance rather than isolated algorithms
- You challenge models, assumptions, and results until you understand what drives performance
- You thrive in a small technical team where ownership, speed, and engineering judgement matter

Requirements

- BSc, MSc, or PhD in Aerospace Engineering, Control Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related field
- 10+ years of GNC experience on missiles, interceptors, spacecraft, launch vehicles, or comparable high-performance systems
- Strong expertise in at least two areas across guidance, navigation and estimation, and control, with solid understanding across the complete GNC loop
- Experience developing and implementing flight-proven systems for hypersonic and/or space applications, including qualified hardware and software
- Strong MATLAB, Simulink and/or Python skills
- Nice to have: Experience taking GNC systems through hardware-in-the-loop testing and/or flight testing

postings.title: Head of Bid Management & Commercial Operations
postings.description:
About the Role

Imagine this. You are leading the team behind some of the most strategic defense bids at Destinus, turning complex technical capabilities and customer requirements into compelling, competitive proposals. As Head of Bid Management, you will own our end-to-end bid management approach, from opportunity qualification and bid strategy through submission, negotiation support, and post-bid analysis.

Reporting to the Head of Commercial Operations, you will build and lead a high-performing Bid Management team and work closely with Business Development, Sales, Engineering, Finance, Legal, Operations, and senior leadership. Your goal is clear - create a disciplined, scalable bid function that helps Destinus compete effectively and convert strategic opportunities into contracts.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You'll Do

- Own and continuously improve the bid management strategy, processes, governance, and tools across Destinus

- Lead the complete bid lifecycle from initial opportunity assessment and bid or no-bid decisions through proposal development, submission, clarification, negotiation support, and post-bid review

- Build, lead, and develop a growing Bid Management team, initially managing 2 to 3 team members with the potential to scale the function as the business grows

- Coordinate cross-functional bid teams across Business Development, Engineering, Finance, Legal, Operations, Supply Chain, and other relevant functions

- Translate customer requirements, tender documentation, and commercial priorities into clear bid strategies, responsibilities, timelines, and deliverables

- Ensure proposals are compelling, accurate, compliant, commercially sound, and aligned with both customer requirements and Destinus objectives

- Establish strong quality control across all submissions, ensuring consistency of technical, commercial, contractual, and supporting documentation

- Manage resources across multiple concurrent bids, prioritizing critical opportunities and ensuring teams have the information and support needed to deliver under demanding timelines

- Prepare bids for internal review and bidding committee approval, ensuring decision-makers have complete and reliable information

- Develop reporting and performance models to understand bid costs, resource requirements, conversion rates, timelines, and overall effectiveness of the bid function

- Provide regular bid pipeline and performance updates to the Head of Commercial Operations, CCO, and relevant senior stakeholders

- Lead structured reviews of unsuccessful tenders to identify lessons learned and translate findings into concrete improvements for future submissions

- Analyze competitor positioning and tender outcomes to identify opportunities to strengthen Destinus proposals, commercial positioning, and overall competitiveness

- Manage relevant external suppliers and partners supporting proposal development while maintaining control over the bid management budget

- Create scalable processes, templates, documentation standards, and best practices that allow the bid organization to grow without slowing down

Requirements

What You'll Need

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Aerospace, or a related field. A Master's degree or MBA is a plus

- 10+ years of relevant experience in bid management, proposal management, business development, commercial operations, or similar roles within defense, aerospace, or another highly regulated technical industry

- Significant experience leading complex, high-value bids and tenders involving multiple technical and commercial stakeholders

- Strong understanding of defense procurement processes and tender frameworks, including RFPs, RFQs, RFIs, and government procurement procedures

- Proven experience building, managing, and developing bid or proposal teams

- Ability to understand complex technical products and translate technical capabilities into clear and persuasive customer value propositions

- Strong commercial awareness, including experience working with pricing, contractual requirements, risk assessments, and bid economics

- Experience coordinating cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders under demanding deadlines

- Strong analytical skills and the ability to use bid data, competitor intelligence, and tender outcomes to improve future performance

- Experience with UAVs, autonomous systems, aerospace platforms, or mission-critical defense technologies is a strong advantage

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills. Additional European languages are a plus

- Experience engaging with government agencies, defense organizations, prime contractors, or other institutional customers is highly valued

- Willingness to travel when required to support strategic bids, customers, and internal teams

Who You Are

You know how to bring structure to complexity without creating bureaucracy. You are comfortable taking ownership of high-stakes bids, challenging assumptions, and making decisions when timelines are tight. You combine commercial thinking with enough technical curiosity to understand what makes a solution competitive. You set a high bar for quality, communicate clearly, and know how to get different teams moving toward the same deadline. Most importantly, you are ready to build, improve, and scale rather than simply maintain an existing process.

postings.title: Head of Commercial Programs
postings.description:
About the Role

As Head of Commercial Programs, you will act as senior chief of staff to the Commercial leadership, driving the programmatic backbone that connects strategy to execution across Destinus's commercial organisation. Reporting to the CCO, you will orchestrate the cadence, governance, and cross-functional coordination that keep major pursuits, partnerships, and commercial initiatives on track — partnering closely with Business Development, Commercial Operations, Programme Management, Legal, and Finance. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role with C-level exposure, for a structured operator who can translate leadership priorities into disciplined programme plans, hold workstreams accountable to milestones, and bring order and momentum to a fast-moving, high-stakes commercial environment.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations

What You'll Do

Chief of Staff to Commercial Leadership

- Act as a trusted right hand to the CCO, managing priorities, follow-through, and decision tracking across the commercial leadership agenda

- Own the leadership rhythm: prepare board and executive materials, run leadership reviews, and ensure decisions are documented, assigned, and closed out

- Filter signal from noise across the commercial organisation, surfacing the issues that need leadership attention before they become critical and push the correct prioritisation

Commercial Programme Management

- Own the end-to-end programme management of major commercial pursuits and cross-functional initiatives, from kickoff through milestone tracking to closeout

Governance & Process

- Establish and maintain the governance framework that connects commercial programmes to corporate reporting, budget cycles, and defense-sector compliance requirements

- Design and enforce escalation paths so risks and blockers reach the right decision-maker at the right time

- Partner with Commercial Strategy on process design and continuous improvement, ensuring programme management practices scale with the business

Cross-Functional Coordination

- Serve as the central coordination point across Business Development, Programme Management, Legal, Finance, and Manufacturing, aligning timelines and dependencies for major pursuits and strategic partnerships

- Represent Commercial in cross-functional steering committees, ensuring commercial priorities and constraints are properly reflected in wider programme decisions

Reporting & Communication

- Produce concise, decision-ready reporting for executive and board audiences, translating programme detail into clear strategic narrative

Requirements

What You'll Need

- Master's degree in Business Administration, Programme/Project Management, Engineering, or a related discipline

- 8–12 years of professional experience spanning programme management, chief-of-staff or business-management roles, and commercial or business development functions; experience in the defense or aerospace industry is an advantage

- Proven track record running complex, multi-stakeholder programmes end to end,

- Demonstrated experience operating as a chief of staff or senior business-management partner to executive leadership

- Strong command of programme management tools and methods (RAID logs, stage-gate governance, KPI/dashboard reporting)

- Excellent judgement and discretion in handling sensitive, leadership-level information

- Fluent in English

- Eligibility to obtain or hold a security clearance in an EU member state

Who You Are

You are a structured, high-judgement operator who is equally comfortable running a leadership agenda and driving a complex programme plan. You bring calm, rigorous execution to ambiguous, fast-moving situations, and you know how to turn strategic intent into a disciplined plan with clear owners and dates. You are trusted with sensitive information and know when to escalate and when to resolve things yourself. You are diplomatic enough to align senior stakeholders across functions, yet direct enough to hold people accountable to commitments. Above all, you are motivated by enabling Destinus's commercial leadership to move fast without losing control — ensuring the organisation can compete and win in the global defense market.

postings.title: Head of Kinetics
postings.description:
About the Role

You are at the heart of where precision meets production, turning complex kinetic designs into reliable, high performance reality. As Head of Kinetics , you step into a mission critical role where safety, quality, and execution must move in perfect sync.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You’ll do

- You will lead the entire kinetics production operations from strategy to execution, ensuring every product meets the highest safety and performance standards.
- You’ll collaborate closely with engineering, R&D, and quality teams to transform concepts into operational capabilities.
- You will oversee manufacturing processes, implement robust safety protocols, drive efficiency improvements, and mentor a team of specialists in energetic materials.
- You’ll be the decision-maker in production priorities, resource allocation, and compliance, making sure every deliverable leaves our facility ready for the most demanding missions.

Requirements

- Extensive experience in explosives, pyrotechnics, or energetic materials production in aerospace, defense, or similar high-regulation industries.
- Strong leadership skills with a proven track record of managing technical teams in a high-stakes environment.
- Deep understanding of safety, compliance, and quality standards for energetic materials.
- Hands-on expertise in process optimization and problem-solving under pressure.
- A strategic mindset with the ability to translate long-term objectives into actionable production plans.

Who You Are
You thrive in a fast-paced environment where innovation moves at lightning speed. When others see obstacles, you see opportunities. You are decisive, adaptable, and unshakably calm under pressure. You inspire confidence in your team, not just by directing, but by rolling up your sleeves when it counts. You have a passion for precision, an obsession with safety, and the drive to lead your team to achieve operational excellence in one of the most critical areas of our work.

postings.title: HR intern
postings.description:
Imagine this. You are starting your HR career inside a fast-moving aerospace and defense company, working directly alongside our HR Business Partners and gaining hands-on exposure to the challenges of supporting and growing international teams. As an HR Intern in Madrid, you will support our HRBPs across the employee lifecycle, HR operations, people data, and internal projects. You will learn quickly, take real ownership, and contribute to the everyday employee experience at Destinus.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You'll Do

- Support our HR Business Partners with day-to-day HR activities and employee-related topics
- Assist throughout the employee lifecycle, including onboarding, contract changes, internal moves, documentation, and offboarding
- Prepare HR documentation and help ensure employee records and HR systems remain accurate and up to date
- Support the preparation of HR reports, presentations, and people data for HRBP activities and internal decision-making
- Coordinate onboarding activities and help create a smooth experience for new employees from day one
- Be a first point of support for general employee HR questions and connect employees with the right person when needed
- Assist HRBPs with recurring people processes, meetings, documentation, and follow-up actions
- Contribute to HR projects aimed at improving processes, employee experience, and the way we work
- Support internal events, employee initiatives, and activities that help bring our teams together
- Collaborate with the wider international People team and gain exposure to different areas of HR

Requirements

What You'll Need

- Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Human Resources, Psychology, Business Administration, Labor Relations, Law or a related field
- Strong interest in developing your career in HR and learning how an HR Business Partner function operates
- Strong organizational skills with excellent attention to detail
- Good communication and interpersonal skills
- Ability to work with confidential and sensitive information responsibly
- Comfortable working with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint
- Professional working proficiency in both Spanish and English, as English is our main working language across Destinus
- Previous HR, administrative, or people-related internship experience is a plus, but not essential
- Eligibility to complete an internship in Spain

Who You Are

You are curious about people and how organizations work, but you also enjoy getting things done. You are organized, approachable, and comfortable moving between employee questions, documentation, data, and new projects. You learn quickly, ask the right questions, and take ownership of the details. You are looking for an internship where you can contribute to real HR work rather than simply observe it.

postings.description:

Imagine this. You are starting your HR career in an international aerospace and defense environment where engineering, technology, and people come together every day. As our HR Intern in Switzerland, you will work closely with our HR team and gain hands-on exposure to the employee lifecycle, HR operations, people data, and local HR activities.

This is a 12-month internship where you will take on real responsibilities from the start, help keep our HR processes and employee information running smoothly, and learn how HR operates inside a fast-growing international technology company.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). - Keep our employee database and HR systems organized, accurate, and up to date
- Support the employee lifecycle, including onboarding, contract changes, internal moves, documentation, and offboarding
- Help prepare and maintain employment documentation and employee records
- Support the preparation of HR reports, presentations, and people data for HR activities and decision-making
- Coordinate onboarding activities and help new employees navigate their first days and weeks at Destinus
- Assist the HR team with recurring people processes, meetings, documentation, and follow-up actions
- Contribute to local and international HR projects focused on improving processes and the employee experience
- Support internal events and employee initiatives that strengthen collaboration across our teams
- Work closely with our international People team and gain exposure to different HR practices across Destinus locations

Requirements

What You'll Need

- Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Human Resources, Psychology, Business Administration, Management, or a related field, or a commercial qualification such as a CFC or EFZ with an HRSE qualification
- Strong interest in developing your career in HR and gaining practical experience in an HR environment
- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
- Good communication and interpersonal skills, with confidence working in an international environment
- Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information responsibly
- Comfortable working with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint
- Professional working proficiency in English, as this is our main working language
- French language skills are highly valued for supporting our local team in Canton of Vaud
- Previous HR, administrative, or people-related internship experience is a plus
- Eligibility to work in Switzerland
- Availability to complete a 12-month internship

Who You Are

You are curious, proactive, and genuinely interested in building a career in HR. You enjoy bringing structure to moving pieces, keeping information organized, and making sure the details are right. You are comfortable working with people from different cultures and backgrounds and are ready to learn by doing.

You do not need to know everything yet. What matters is that you ask questions, learn quickly, take ownership of your responsibilities, and are ready to contribute to a fast-moving international HR team while developing your skills along the way.

postings.title: ILS Training & Training Support Engineer
postings.description:
About the Role

Imagine this You are shaping how operators and maintainers learn to use some of the world's most advanced aerospace systems. As an ILS Training & Training Support Engineer, you will design the training solutions that enable customers to safely operate, maintain, and support Destinus products throughout their lifecycle. Working alongside engineering and Integrated Logistics Support teams, you will transform complex technical information into structured learning experiences that improve operational readiness and long-term mission success.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You'll Do

- Conduct Training Needs Analysis activities to identify operator, maintainer, and support personnel training requirements
- Develop and maintain Training Support Plans aligned with program objectives and customer support requirements
- Design operator and maintainer training concepts, qualification frameworks, and training strategies
- Perform mission, job, and task analyses to define required knowledge, skills, and competencies
- Create learning objectives, course structures, training pathways, and curriculum frameworks
- Develop instructional strategies, assessment methods, and training media requirements
- Produce and maintain high quality training materials including lesson plans, presentations, student guides, practical exercises, and assessment content
- Define requirements for simulators, training aids, emulated systems, and digital learning technologies
- Support the development of classroom, simulator based, and digital learning solutions
- Ensure training products remain aligned with engineering designs, maintenance concepts, technical publications, and supportability requirements
- Maintain traceability between engineering data, maintenance requirements, and training deliverables
- Assess the impact of engineering changes and configuration updates on training materials and learning programs
- Support training effectiveness assessments and continuous improvement initiatives throughout the product lifecycle
- Provide technical guidance to internal teams responsible for training delivery and customer support
- Contribute to proposals, bids, and new programs by defining training requirements, estimates, and support concepts
- Collaborate closely with Engineering, Technical Publications, Supply Support, Logistics Support Analysis, and In-Service Support teams to deliver fully integrated support solutions
- Help improve training processes, standards, templates, and best practices across the organization while supporting the adoption of S6000T methodologies

Requirements

What You'll Need

- Bachelor's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Defense Technology, Human Factors, Education Technology, Instructional Design, or a related discipline
- 1 to 5 years of experience in training development, instructional systems design, Integrated Logistics Support, aerospace support engineering, military training systems, or a related field
- Understanding of Training Needs Analysis, curriculum development, and instructional design methodologies
- Knowledge of the ADDIE training lifecycle including analysis, design, development, implementation, and evaluation
- Familiarity with competency based training, learning objectives, and assessment strategies
- Ability to translate engineering, operational, and maintenance information into effective learning solutions
- Strong analytical and problem solving skills with excellent attention to detail
- Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary engineering teams
- Professional proficiency in English
- Experience within aerospace, defense, UAV, military training, or other high technology industries is highly desirable
- Familiarity with ASD S6000T and broader Integrated Logistics Support methodologies is an advantage
- Experience developing classroom, simulator based, computer based, or blended learning solutions is a plus
- Familiarity with Learning Management Systems and digital learning environments is beneficial
- Understanding of Logistics Support Analysis, maintenance concepts, and lifecycle support principles is considered an advantage

Who You Are

You enjoy turning complex technical concepts into clear, practical learning experiences that help people succeed. You combine analytical thinking with creativity, ensuring every training solution is accurate, engaging, and aligned with real operational needs. You work well with engineers, technical specialists, and cross functional teams, building strong relationships to deliver integrated support solutions. You are organized, proactive, and motivated by continuous improvement, taking ownership of your work while helping shape the future of training for advanced aerospace systems.

Security screening is an integral component of the selection process, ensuring that candidates meet the organization's security standards and safeguarding against potential risks.

Providing a Certificate of Conduct (VOG) is a standard part of the application process at Destinus.

postings.title: Intern - ML for Computational Fluid Dynamics
postings.description:
Are you interested in applying machine learning (ML) and numerical optimization to improve Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) for aerodynamic design? Always wondered how ML can be applied to engineering? If you can dedicate to us at least 5 months, then this is your chance to join a world-leading team at the forefront of UAV design and:

- Work at the intersection of the aerodynamics and ML teams to improve the design of our unmanned vehicles.
- Research and develop ML and numerical algorithms to guide the CFD exploration of aerodynamic design space.
- Evaluate your ideas on real-world test cases, assess the results, and present your findings and conclusions.
- Implement and deploy the algorithms in our design pipeline.

Requirements

Familiarity with Gaussian processes and Bayesian optimization.

- A desire to push the boundaries of ML for engineering and extend mathematical concepts with minimal supervision.
- Hands-on experience in developing Python code for shared repositories: git, code reviews, continuous integration.
- Knowledge of mathematical optimization concepts and algorithms, e.g., convex optimization, non-linear programming, etc.
- Mindset to take ownership of your work and follow it from concept to final implementation. (Experience in research is a plus.)
- Experience with CFD, large-scale simulations, and other ML is a plus.

postings.title: International Compensation & Benefits Specialist
postings.description:
Imagine this, you are building the compensation and benefits framework behind a fast-growing international engineering organization, in every country where we operate. As Compensation & Benefits Specialist, you will join our HR team and support the development and management of our compensation and benefits strategy across the organization.

You will work across multiple countries and collaborate closely with HRBP, Finance, Payroll, Legal, and business leaders to ensure our compensation and benefits practices are competitive, consistent, compliant, and scalable. This is a hands-on role, combining strong analytical capabilities with practical expertise in compensation, benefits, benchmarking, and international HR practices. You will play an important role in building and evolving compensation frameworks that support our growth, while taking into account different local market practices and regulatory requirements.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You’ll Do

- Manage and continuously improve compensation and benefits programs across multiple countries
- Support the design and implementation of international salary structures, job levels, compensation bands, and reward frameworks
- Conduct salary benchmarking and market analysis across different geographies, using external compensation surveys and relevant market data
- Coordinate annual compensation processes, including salary reviews, promotions, bonus cycles, and variable compensation programs
- Provide data-driven compensation recommendations for new hires, promotions, internal mobility, and other employee changes
- Analyze internal pay practices across countries and identify market gaps, inconsistencies, and opportunities to improve internal equity
- Review and develop employee benefit programs across different locations, balancing market competitiveness, employee needs, cost effectiveness, and local requirements
- Manage relationships with external benefits providers, brokers, and compensation partners
- Work closely with HR, Payroll, Finance, and Legal to ensure the accurate and compliant implementation of compensation and benefits programs
- Monitor compensation-related regulatory developments across the countries in which we operate, including pay transparency and equal-pay requirements
- Support the implementation of the EU Pay Transparency Directive and other relevant compensation and reporting requirements
- Participate in international compensation surveys and maintain accurate and reliable compensation and benefits data
- Prepare compensation analyses, dashboards, and recommendations for HR leadership and business stakeholders
- Develop clear compensation and benefits guidelines and communications for HR, managers, and employees
- Contribute to broader international HR initiatives and help build scalable processes as the organization continues to grow

Requirements

What You’ll Need

- 5+ years of relevant experience in Compensation & Benefits, Total Rewards, HR Analytics, or a related HR specialization
- Experience working in an international, multi-country environment
- Strong understanding of compensation benchmarking, salary structures, variable compensation, and employee benefits
- Experience working with different compensation markets and adapting global frameworks to local requirements
- Strong analytical and numerical skills, with the ability to work confidently with large datasets
- Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills; experience with HRIS and compensation tools is an advantage
- Ability to translate complex compensation data into clear and practical recommendations for HR and business stakeholders
- Strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy
- Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively across countries, functions, and stakeholders
- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
- Professional fluency in English
- Experience in a fast-growing, international engineering, technology, aerospace, or industrial organization is highly valuable
- Experience designing or implementing job architecture, salary bands, grading structures, or career frameworks is highly valuable
- Knowledge of European compensation practices and the EU Pay Transparency Directive is highly valuable
- Experience conducting pay-equity or gender pay-gap analysis is highly valuable
- Experience with bonus schemes, equity, or long-term incentive programs is highly valuable
- Experience designing or harmonizing benefits across multiple countries is highly valuable
- Experience managing international benefits providers, brokers, or compensation survey providers is highly valuable
- Spanish, Dutch, or other European language skills are highly valuable

Who You Are

You are analytical and detail-driven, and you enjoy turning complex compensation data into clear, practical recommendations. You are comfortable working across countries, functions, and stakeholders, and you know how to adapt a global framework to local market practice and regulation. You want to help build an international compensation and benefits framework that is competitive, data-driven, consistent, compliant, and scalable, while allowing for the local differences our markets require. Above all, you become a trusted compensation partner to HR and business leaders, bringing structure, reliable market insights, and practical solutions to compensation and benefits decisions across the organization.

Benefits

Why Join Us?

✨ The Thrill of the Future - Work on cutting-edge projects that redefine aerospace.
✨ Global Innovation Hub - Collaborate with top engineers from all over the world.
✨ Fast-Paced & High-Growth - Experience the rush of working in a rapidly expanding company.
✨ Real Impact - Your work won’t be theoretical, it will shape the future of flight.

Destinus is an equal-opportunity employer. We value diversity in our companies and our teams and do not discriminate based on age, race, religion, color, country of origin, gender, sexual orientation, or disability status.

🚀 Destinus — Advanced defense. Built to scale.
