postings.title: Junior Business Development Manager (Eastern Europe)
postings.description:
About the Role

Imagine this - you are helping Destinus expand across one of the most strategically important and fast-moving defense markets in Europe. As a Junior Business Development Manager for Eastern Europe, you will support the identification, development, and execution of new business opportunities across the region, working closely with senior commercial leaders, customers, government stakeholders, and internal technical teams.

This is a hands-on opportunity for someone early in their career who wants to build strong commercial expertise in aerospace and defense. You will gain direct exposure to complex sales cycles, public procurement, tenders, customer engagement, and market development while contributing to Destinus' growth across Eastern Europe.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You'll Do

- Support the development of new business opportunities across Eastern Europe, with a particular focus on defense, aerospace, UAVs, and government customers

- Research regional markets, defense priorities, procurement programs, competitors, and potential partners to identify new opportunities

- Assist senior Business Development colleagues throughout the full commercial cycle, from initial opportunity identification to proposal and contract stages

- Build and maintain relationships with customers, government stakeholders, local partners, and other key players across the region

- Support the preparation of proposals, tenders, presentations, commercial offers, and other customer-facing materials

- Track public tenders, procurement opportunities, defense programs, and relevant regulatory developments across Eastern European markets

- Coordinate with engineering, product, legal, finance, and operations teams to ensure commercial opportunities are supported by solid technical and business cases

- Help organize customer meetings, demonstrations, industry events, and trade shows across the region

- Maintain accurate information on opportunities, customer interactions, next steps, and commercial priorities

- Travel across Eastern Europe when required to meet customers, partners, and stakeholders

Requirements

What You'll Need

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, International Relations, Economics, Engineering, Aerospace, Defense Studies, or a related field

- Initial experience in business development, sales, consulting, defense, aerospace, government affairs, or a similar environment through employment, internships, or relevant projects

- Strong interest in the defense and aerospace industries and motivation to develop a career in an international commercial role

- Understanding of Eastern European markets and their business environment

- Strong research and analytical skills with the ability to turn market information into clear commercial insights

- Confidence communicating with different stakeholders in an international environment

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Romanian or another Eastern European language is highly valued

- Ability and willingness to travel regularly across the region

- Experience with government procurement, tenders, UAVs, aerospace, or defense technology is a plus but not essential

Who You Are

You are ambitious, curious, and commercially minded. You enjoy getting close to customers, understanding what drives a market, and turning information into opportunities. You take ownership without waiting to be told every next step, learn quickly, and are comfortable working in a fast-moving international environment. You are ready to build your network, develop your commercial instincts, and grow alongside a company that is pushing aerospace and defense technology forward.

postings.title: Junior Buyer
postings.description:
Destinus is at the forefront of European aerospace and defense technologies, developing AI-driven autonomous flight systems and advanced turbine engines. Our cutting-edge technologies deliver superior efficiency and performance, pushing the boundaries of supersonic and hypersonic flight. We're pioneering the next wave of combat-proven defense innovations and breakthrough propulsion systems combining turbojet and ramjet technologies for future hypersonic vehicles with hydrogen propulsion.

Role

This role is the transactional engine of the procurement team. Its purpose is to execute the day-to-day purchasing process with speed, accuracy, and compliance. This individual is responsible for converting approved purchase requisitions into purchase orders and ensuring the timely delivery of goods and services to support our operations.

The Purchasers core mission is to efficiently and accurately execute the operational Procure-to-Pay (P2P) process. They are mandated to process purchase requisitions, create and manage purchase orders (POs), track deliveries, and resolve routine operational issues with suppliers, all in strict adherence to established contracts and policies.

Key Responsibilities

- Purchase Order Management:

- Process approved purchase requisitions and MRP proposes into accurate Purchase Orders (POs) in MS Dynamics, ensuring adherence to negotiated contracts and terms.
- Obtain timely PO confirmations from suppliers and maintain accurate data in the ERP system.

- Delivery Assurance:

- Monitor open order status, track deliveries against need dates, and proactively expedite orders as required.
- Serve as the first point of contact for suppliers regarding routine operational matters (delivery schedules, quantities, shipping documentation).

- Operational Issue Resolution:

- Resolve basic operational issues, such as invoice discrepancies (matching PO/Receipt/Invoice), minor delivery delays, or documentation queries.
- Escalate complex or recurring issues to the Procurement Specialist.

Requirements

- Degree in a related field.
- Experience of 1-3 years in a procurement or purchasing role, preferably in the aerospace or manufacturing industry.
- High proficiency and accuracy in using ERP systems (MS Dynamics essential);
- A detail-oriented "Executor" who thrives on process, accuracy, and ensuring tasks are completed correctly and on time. Be able to follow instruction from the Procurement Country lead.
- strong attention to detail and organizational skills;
- good communication skills.
- Fluent English speaker.

Destinus is an equal-opportunity employer - we value diversity in our companies and our teams. We do not discriminate based on age, race, religion, color, country of origin, gender, sexual orientation, or disability status

postings.title: Junior Electronics Engineer
postings.description:
About the Role
Imagine starting the line of your aerospace career, working side by side with senior engineers and learning how complex systems come together in real flight hardware. This role is designed for junior electronics engineers who want to grow fast, learn by doing, and evolve into full system engineers while contributing to real defense programs from day one.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You´ll Do

- Support senior and lead engineers in day-to-day electronic and system engineering activities across multiple programs.
- Assist in the integration of electronic subsystems into larger aerospace systems.
- Participating actively in test preparation including setup of hardware, instrumentation, and test configurations.
- Provide hands-on support during testing activities, including execution, monitoring, and basic troubleshooting.
- Collect, organize, and analyze test data to support engineering evaluations and design improvements.
- Help identify issues during testing and collaborate with senior engineers to investigate root causes.
- Contribute to the creation, update, and maintenance of technical documentation and test reports.
- Support continuous improvement initiatives within the engineering and testing processes.
- Coordinate with multidisciplinary teams such as software, mechanical, and test engineers to ensure smooth system integration.
- Gradually take ownership of defined tasks and subsystems as technical knowledge and confidence grows.
- Learn system engineering principles through real project exposure with a clear path toward becoming a system engineer.

Requirements

What You’ll Need

- Academic background in Electronics Engineering or a closely related field.
- Fluency in both Spanish and English with the ability to work confidently in technical environments.
- A proactive attitude, mindset and strong desire to learn in a fast-moving engineering environment.

Would be a plus

- Familiar with avionics and systems such as autopilot, radar altimeter, air data units, magnetometers, AHRS, GPS, anti jamming and anti spoofing solutions, and servos.
- Availability to support Ground and Flight-testing activities.
- Experienced in updating firmware in avionics and system components.
- Able to create electrical drawings to support engineering upgrades using tools such as AutoCAD Electrical, Zuken E3, or similar CAD software.
- Familiar with version control systems.
- Knowledge of networking concepts including TCP and UDP.
- Basic experience with Python scripting and Linux Ubuntu commands.
- Familiar with serial communication protocols such as RS232, RS422, RS485, and Ethernet.
- Hands on experience with ground support equipment including multimeter, megohmmeter, oscilloscope, spectrum analyzer, power meter, and data loggers.
- Experience with radio control or FPV drones as a personal hobby.

Who You Are

You are at the beginning of your engineering journey and hungry to learn. You enjoy working alongside experienced engineers, asking questions, and getting your hands dirty with real hardware. You are adaptable, curious, and comfortable switching between theory and practice. When faced with something new, you lean in instead of stepping back.

postings.title: Junior HR
postings.description:
Imagine this. You are building your HR career in an international aerospace and defense company where you get exposure to much more than one part of HR. From helping us find and hire great people to preparing contracts, supporting employee administration, and making sure everything is ready when a new colleague joins, you will be involved across the employee journey.

As our Junior HR in Hengelo, you will work closely with both the Talent Acquisition team and the HR Business Partner in the Netherlands. This is a hands-on role for someone with initial HR experience who is ready to take the next step, build broader expertise, and become a reliable part of our People team.

- Keep employee information, personnel files, and HR systems accurate and up to date

- Help employees with general HR questions and make sure more complex topics reach the right person within the team

- Support HR processes related to leave, absence, employee changes, and other operational HR topics

- Coordinate with managers, employees, and other teams to collect information and keep HR processes moving

- Support the HR team with ongoing projects and help improve the way we work as Destinus continues to grow

Requirements

What You’ll Need

You already have your first HR experience behind you and are ready for more. postings.title: Kinetics Specialist
postings.description:
About the Role

You are at the heart of where precision meets production, turning complex kinetic designs into reliable, high performance reality. As Kinetics Specialist for Production, you step into a mission critical role where safety, quality, and execution must move in perfect sync. Reporting directly to the Head of Kinetics you become the technical anchor that keeps propulsion and energetic systems moving smoothly from design intent to industrial scale production.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You´ll Do

Production Support & Technical Oversight
• Technical support for production of kinetic defense items including projectiles, warheads, rocket motors, and explosive components
• Monitoring, optimizing, and troubleshooting manufacturing processes to ensure quality, efficiency, and performance
• Coordination with engineering and production teams to implement design updates, process improvements, and corrective actions
• Root cause and failure analysis for defects, non-conformances, and test results
• Technical ownership of kinetic systems including munitions, energetics, rocket motors, fuses, and guided systems
• Support system integration activities and validation testing of prototypes and production units
• Oversight of handling, storage, transport, and disposal of energetic materials
• Development of SOPs, hazard analyses, risk assessments, and compliance with explosive safety standards
• Design and setup of production and handling sites for energetic materials
• Management of ammunition tracking, serialization, and lifecycle documentation

Safety, Security & Compliance
• Technical authority for explosive safety and occupational health risks
• Execution of safety audits, inspections, and regulatory compliance activities
• Leadership of incident investigations when required
• Safety analysis and site design aligned with local and international regulations

Quality Assurance & Process Control
• Analysis of process control data and implementation of continuous improvement actions
• Support product qualification, certification, and manufacturing change approvals
• Maintenance of production records, test documentation, and configuration control

Organizational & Administrative Support
• Scheduling, resource coordination, and project tracking support for the Kinetics team
• Preparation of technical reports, presentations, and documentation
• Coordination with procurement, supply chain, and logistics teams
• Support budgeting, cost estimation, customer interactions, and program reviews
• Mentoring junior engineers and technicians

Requirements

What You’ll Need

- Bachelor’s degree in a relevant engineering discipline with 5+ years of experience in munitions, defense manufacturing, or energetic materials.
- Proven hands-on expertise in kinetic weapons systems and explosive production within regulated defense environments.
- Strong technical knowledge of propellants, explosives, energetic manufacturing processes, and materials science.
- Experience with quality systems, statistical process control, CAD tools, and technical documentation.
- In-depth understanding of explosive safety standards, military regulations, and defense trade compliance.
- Exposure to advanced and emerging defense production technologies and kinetic systems.
- Demonstrated technical leadership, structured problem-solving, and a strong safety-first mindset.
- High attention to detail, clear communication skills, and effective cross-functional collaboration.
- Adaptable, proactive, and driven by continuous improvement.
- In-depth knowledge of explosive safety standards ( NATO AASTP-1, MIL-SPEC and other regulations).
- Understanding of ITAR, EAR, and defense trade compliance requirements.
- There will be traveling

Who You Are

You’re a hands-on technical expert who feels at home where precision, safety, and performance matter most. You thrive in highly regulated environments and stay calm when the stakes are high, bringing structure and clarity to complex kinetic and energetic systems. You don’t just follow processes, you understand them deeply and know how to improve them.

Benefits

Why Join Us?

✨ The Thrill of the Future – Work on cutting-edge projects that redefine aerospace.
✨ Global Innovation Hub – Collaborate with top engineers from all over the world.
✨ Fast-Paced & High-Growth – Experience the rush of working in a rapidly expanding company.
✨ Real Impact – Your work won’t be theoretical—it will shape the future of flight.

Destinus is an equal-opportunity employer. We value diversity in our companies and our teams and do not discriminate based on age, race, religion, color, country of origin, gender, sexual orientation, or disability status.

🚀 Destinus – Challenge the limits of time, space, and human potential.

postings.title: Lead Industrialization Engineer
postings.description:
About the Role

Imagine this. As we scale production in Hengelo, manual, repetitive work on the floor needs to become automated, connected, and data-driven. As Lead Industrialization Engineer, you will lead the team responsible for bringing automation, robotics, and digital tooling into our production and test lines — designing the systems that let us build more, with fewer manual steps and better data at every station.

This is a hands-on leadership role at the intersection of hardware and software. You will lead a team of industrialization engineers, drive the selection and integration of automated equipment and PLC/robotic systems, and connect the floor to the digital systems (MES, data pipelines, station-level software) that make it run smarter.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You'll Do

- Lead industrialization engineering activities and provide technical direction to industrialization engineers, with a strong focus on automation and digitalization of production and test processes

- Identify manual, repetitive, or error-prone steps across subassembly and main production lines and lead the design and rollout of automated solutions to replace them

- Specify, select, and integrate automated equipment, robotics, PLCs, and sensor-based systems for production and test cells

- Own the architecture connecting shop-floor equipment to digital systems - MES, data pipelines, and station-level software — so line and station data flows automatically

- Lead the industrialization of new products and engineering changes into production, working closely with NPI, Design Engineering, and Data & Validation Engineering

- Apply lean manufacturing and Theory of Constraints principles to identify bottlenecks and target automation and digitalization where they create the most value

- Define and maintain routing documentation and station-level work content, ensuring automated and manual steps are correctly represented

- Partner with software, controls, and electrical engineering functions to bring automation projects from concept to validated, running equipment on the floor

- Use production and equipment data to identify improvement opportunities and drive measurable results in throughput, quality, and labor efficiency

- Mentor industrialization engineers and help build automation and digitalization capability across the team

- Collaborate closely with Production, Production Engineering, Data & Validation Engineering, Quality, and Supply Chain to keep automation initiatives on track

Requirements

What You'll Need

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechatronics, Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field

- Strong experience in industrialization, automation engineering, or manufacturing engineering within aerospace, defense, automotive, or another complex hardware environment

- Proven experience specifying, integrating, or programming automated equipment, robotics, or PLC-based systems in a production or test environment

- Understanding of how shop-floor equipment connects to digital systems (MES, SCADA, data pipelines) and what it takes to make that connection reliable

- Strong understanding of lean manufacturing principles, line balancing, and Theory of Constraints / bottleneck management

- Experience with routing documentation, MBOM structures, and translating process design into production-ready documentation

- Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, electrical/controls schematics, and technical specifications

- Experience leading technical projects or teams and coordinating across engineering, controls, and production functions

- Strong hands-on problem-solving skills and willingness to spend time directly on the production floor

- Professional working proficiency in English. Dutch is a plus.

Who You Are

You are a hands-on technical leader who sees automation and digitalization as the path to a better production line, not just a project. You are equally comfortable discussing a robot cell's motion program and the data pipeline that reports on it, and you take ownership of automation initiatives from concept through to a running, trusted system on the floor.

postings.title: Legal Counsel
postings.description:
About The Role

Imagine an opportunity to step into a role where law meets innovation, strategy, and global impact. As part of our legal team, you will work on high-impact commercial and corporate matters in a fast-moving, international environment at the intersection of defence and advanced technology. Your work will directly support the company’s expansion, helping navigate complex legal landscapes while enabling bold ideas to become reality. In this role, you will play a key part in supporting the company’s growth, strategic transactions, and corporate governance as Destinus continues to scale internationally. Working across multiple jurisdictions, you will collaborate closely with internal stakeholders and leadership to ensure our operations move forward with confidence, clarity, and strong legal foundations.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You’ll Do

- Draft, negotiate, and manage commercial contracts across procurement (e.g. supply of goods and services, contract manufacturing) and sales (e.g. tenders, consultancy, agency and distributor agreements) .
- Negotiate and structure Joint Development Agreements (JDAs) with technical partners, aligning legal terms with business objectives while protecting the company’s intellectual property, commercial interests, and collaborative development goals.
- Draft, review, and negotiate a wide range of legal documentation.
- Collaborate closely with senior leadership, finance, strategy, and external counsel on strategic projects.
- Contribute to the continuous improvement of legal processes, templates, and policy frameworks, including the use of legal tech and automation tools to enable self-service.
- Provide pragmatic, business-oriented legal advice in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

Requirements

What You’ll Need

- 5-10 years of post-qualification experience at a reputable international law firm and/or in-house legal department.
- Strong experience in commercial law.
- A strong foundation in Dutch law, combined with an interest in comparative legal systems. International experience or exposure is considered a plus.
- In-house experience in an industrial startup, scale-up, or international environment is advantageous
- You see legal as a business accelerator. You are proactive, hands-on, and capable of managing the "Buy-side," and "Sell-side," simultaneously.
- Affinity with legal technology and process automation. Experience with contract lifecycle management tools is considered a plus.
- Strong drafting and negotiation skills with attention to detail.
- Commercial, pragmatic mindset with the ability to balance business objectives and legal risks.
- Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills.
- Fluent in English.

Who You Are

You are a driven legal professional who thrives in dynamic, international environments where complexity is the norm and impact is real. Comfortable navigating cross-border legal matters, you enjoy working at the intersection of commercial strategy, corporate governance, and innovation while supporting high impact commercial and corporate initiatives. With a proactive mindset and strong sense of ownership, you help the business scale globally by balancing legal precision with practical solutions that move the company forward.

postings.title: LSA Engineer
postings.description:
About the Role

Imagine this. You are helping build the supportability foundation behind next generation aerospace and defense systems. As an LSA Engineer, you will develop the maintenance concepts, supportability analyses and logistics engineering data that ensure our products remain reliable, maintainable and mission ready throughout their entire lifecycle. Working alongside engineering, programme management and Integrated Logistics Support teams, you will contribute to creating structured, traceable and effective support solutions that directly influence the operational success of our platforms.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

As our Integrated Logistics Support capability continues to grow, you will help establish Logistics Support Analysis processes aligned with S3000L and S4000P principles while gaining broad exposure to maintenance engineering, reliability, maintainability and lifecycle support within a fast growing aerospace and defense environment.

What You’ll Do

- Conduct Logistics Support Analysis activities in accordance with S3000L principles and programme requirements
- Support the development and maintenance of maintenance concepts for supported systems and products
- Define and maintain Operator-Level Maintenance (OLM), Intermediate-Level Maintenance (ILM) and Depot-Level Maintenance (DLM) boundaries
- Perform and support Failure Modes, Effects and Criticality Analysis (FMECA), Reliability-Centred Maintenance (RCM) and other supportability analyses
- Develop and maintain Maintenance Task Analysis (MTA)
- Develop and maintain Level of Repair Analysis (LORA) outputs
- Support Reliability, Availability, Maintainability and Supportability (RAMS) assessments including MTBF, MTTR and Operational Availability analyses
- Develop maintenance plans and maintenance task requirements to support operational objectives
- Support the identification of support equipment, tooling, facilities and personnel requirements
- Develop supportability requirements for new products and programmes
- Provide maintenance planning and supportability data to Technical Publications, Training, Supply Support and In-Service Support teams
- Support the assessment of engineering changes and design modifications to determine their impact on maintenance concepts and support solutions
- Participate in design reviews to ensure supportability requirements are incorporated throughout product development
- Develop and maintain LSA records, supportability databases and analysis outputs
- Help maintain relationships between engineering data, maintenance requirements, training requirements and provisioning information.

Requirements

What You’ll Need

- Bachelor's degree in Systems Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Defence Technology, Logistics or a related discipline
- 1 to 5 years of experience in Logistics Support Analysis, Supportability Engineering, Maintenance Engineering, Systems Engineering or a related field
- Practical experience with Logistics Support Analysis methodologies and S3000L and S4000P principles
- Understanding of maintenance concept development and maintenance task determination processes
- Knowledge of FMECA, RCM, LORA and other supportability analysis techniques
- Familiarity with reliability and maintainability concepts including MTBF, MTTR and Operational Availability
- Strong analytical and problem solving skills
- Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate across multidisciplinary engineering teams
- Professional proficiency in English

Nice to have

- Experience within aerospace, defense, UAV or other high technology engineering environments
- Practical experience with ASD S-Series specifications, particularly S3000L and S4000P
- Exposure to supportability analysis techniques such as FMECA, RCM, LORA or RAMS assessments
- Experience with LSA databases, supportability tools or structured engineering data management
- Experience contributing to the development or improvement of engineering processes
- Knowledge of maintenance planning and lifecycle support methodologies
- Familiarity with military or aerospace maintenance environments
- Understanding of provisioning, training analysis and technical publications within an Integrated Logistics Support framework

Who You Are

You enjoy solving complex engineering challenges through structure, analysis and attention to detail. You are motivated by creating reliable systems that support products long after they leave the production line. You thrive in collaborative environments where you can work closely with multidisciplinary teams and contribute to meaningful engineering decisions. You are eager to learn, comfortable managing multiple priorities and enjoy taking ownership while continuously improving the way work is done. Your proactive mindset, strong organisational skills and commitment to quality make you a valuable contributor in a fast growing aerospace and defense environment.

postings.title: Machine Learning Engineer
postings.description:
About the role

Imagine building intelligent systems that don’t just work in perfect lab conditions, but perform reliably in the real world, where uncertainty is the norm and failure is not an option. As a Machine Learning Engineer, you will push the limits of computer vision by designing, training, and validating neural networks that operate in complex, safety-critical environments. Your work will directly influence how autonomous systems perceive and interact with the world, combining deep learning, simulation, and rigorous verification into one seamless pipeline.

At Destinus, we are shaping the future of defense through high-speed, autonomous flight technologies. We develop next-generation unmanned aerial systems that deliver greater speed, precision, and efficiency, supporting governments and defense organizations in mission-critical operations worldwide. Daedalean AG, the AI and autonomy hub of the Destinus Group, plays a key role in this vision. Developing safety-critical AI systems at the intersection of advanced research and real-world aviation. Enabling machines to perceive, understand, and make decisions in real time. Together, we combine aerospace engineering and artificial intelligence to build the next generation of autonomous flight systems, driving innovation where it matters most.

What You´ll Do

- Design, train, and optimize deep learning models for computer vision tasks in highly dynamic and safety-critical environments
- Own the full ML lifecycle, from data strategy and model architecture to deployment and performance monitoring
- Develop robust evaluation pipelines to ensure models meet strict reliability and safety requirements
- Work on ML certification activities, validating model behavior under defined regulatory frameworks
- Leverage transfer learning and simulation to scale training and testing beyond real-world data limitations
- Collaborate closely with software, systems, and flight teams to integrate ML models into real-world applications
- Continuously push model performance across edge cases, environmental variability, and operational constraints

Requirements

What You’ll Need

- Strong programming skills in C++ or Rust
- At least 5 years of hands-on experience in deep learning for computer vision
- Experience across the full ML stack, including model design, training pipelines, and evaluation systems
- Solid understanding of data-centric AI approaches, including dataset curation and augmentation strategies
- Experience with simulation environments or synthetic data generation is a strong plus
- Experience with sensors, specifically thermal is a strong plus
- Master’s or PhD in computer science, physics, mathematics, or a related technical field

Who You Are

You thrive in environments where problems are hard, ambiguous, and worth solving. You are not just training models, you are engineering systems that must work every time. You think long-term, validate everything, and take ownership of performance in the real world. When others stop at good enough, you keep pushing until it is reliable, scalable, and certifiable.

postings.title: Magazijn Medewerker
postings.description:
About the Role

Imagine being at the center of a high-performance operation where every movement matters and every detail counts. As a Warehouse Operator at Destinus, you keep the engine running behind the scenes, making sure materials, components, and products flow seamlessly through our facilities with precision and speed. Your role is hands-on, dynamic, and essential to keeping our aerospace operations on track.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You´ll Do

- Receive, organize, and store products efficiently, ensuring every item is in its designated location.
- Record all orders, deliveries, and stock movements in the ERP system, keeping inventory up to date.
- Work closely with purchasing, engineering, and production teams to optimize warehouse operations and stock control.

postings.title: Mechanical Design Engineer
postings.description:
About The Role

The Destinus R&D engineering team is looking for an experienced Mechanical Design Engineer with a passion for aerospace to join our team. The ideal candidate will have at least 8 years of experience as a Mechanical Design Engineer with strong applied engineering skills and an aptitude for leading small engineering teams and projects. In this role, you will support the propulsion and vehicle teams as the focal point for leading mechanical design projects (Airframe, Propulsion, Landing gear, flight controls) through the entire design life cycle.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You'll Do

- Lead design projects for aerospace components and systems from the conceptual phase through manufacturing to integration and testing
- Generate 3D CAD models, drawings, schematics, bills of material, and other related documentation required for manufacturing, integration and testing
- Deliver technical documentation including any engineering calculations, analysis and assumptions required to substantiate your design decisions and solutions
- Prepare and participate in design reviews
- Manage suppliers and manufacturers by addressing any technical questions and resolving any issues which may arise during the manufacturing process
- Select standard parts, fasteners, equipment and consumables following best practices and industry standards
- Contribute to the DMU and configuration management

Requirements

What You'll Need

- BSc., MSc. in mechanical or aerospace engineering. Technician qualifications with substantial experience would also be considered.
- +5 years of experience as a Mechanical Design Engineer in the aerospace industry.
- Strong knowledge of the manufacturing and assembly processes - machining, sheet metal forming, composites and additive manufacturing.
- Excellent CAD and PLM knowledge - Part design, DWGs, DMU management.
- Good engineering material properties knowledge.
- Strong engineering fundamentals and analytical skills - dimensioning calculations, load path definitions, basic stress calculations, energy and power.
- Seal and fastener design knowledge.
- Auxiliary component selection – general electro/mechanical components.
- ISO GD&T knowledge required.
- Fluent in English as working language.
- Proficiency in Siemens tool suite - NX, and TeamCenter PLM system, would be a plus.
- Experience with Metallic and composite structures design would be beneficial.
- Good to have experience with hydraulics, fuel systems and component design.

Destinus is an equal-opportunity employer - we value diversity in our companies and teams. We do not discriminate based on age, race, religion, color, country of origin, gender, sexual orientation, or disability status.

Benefits

postings.title: Mechanical Design Engineer - Turbojet Engines (Future Opportunities)
postings.description:
You stand at the forefront of gas turbine innovation, where your designs are the backbone of cutting-edge propulsion systems. We are seeking a highly skilled Mechanical Design Engineer to join our gas turbine development team. The successful candidate will play a key role in the design and optimization of advanced gas turbine engines, focusing on critical components such as mixed-flow compressor stages (centrifugal and axial), high-speed rotor shafts, and advanced bearing systems. Expertise in material behavior under high thermal and mechanical stresses, precision tolerancing for high-speed assemblies, and design for manufacturability is essential. The candidate should also possess the capability to perform stress analyses to evaluate and enhance component integrity, with knowledge of rotor dynamics considered advantageous.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You’ll Do

- Design & Development

- Design and optimize gas turbine components, including mixed centrifugal and axial compressor stages, rotor shafts, and bearing systems, ensuring high performance and reliability.
- Analyze and address the thermomechanical behavior of materials under extreme operating conditions to guide material selection and design decisions.
- Define and implement precise tolerances, fits, and clearances to ensure performance and manufacturability of high-speed assemblies.
- Incorporate design for manufacturability and assembly principles into all stages of the design process.

- Analysis & Validation

- Perform stress analyses to assess structural integrity and reliability of components under thermal and mechanical loads.
- Collaborate with testing teams to validate designs, interpret test results, and make iterative improvements.
- Use analytical tools such as FEA (Finite Element Analysis) to supplement design decisions when needed.

- Collaboration & Documentation

- Partner with aerodynamics, materials, and manufacturing teams to align designs with performance and production goals.
- Generate detailed technical documentation, including CAD models, engineering drawings, and design reports.
- Contribute to design reviews, presenting technical insights and rationale for engineering decisions.

Requirements

What You’ll Need

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field.
- 5+ years of experience in the design and development of gas turbines or high-performance rotating machinery.
- Strong understanding of material properties and behavior in high-temperature, high-stress environments.
- Proficiency in precision tolerancing, fits, and mechanical design principles for rotating assemblies.
- Experience performing stress analyses and interpreting results to inform design improvements.

- Knowledge of rotordynamics and high-speed bearing systems for turbomachinery is a plus.
- Proficiency in CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks, NX), use of FEA tools is highly desirable.
- Strong knowledge of manufacturing processes, materials, and assembly techniques for gas turbines.
- Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.
- Familiarity with industry standards and best practices in gas turbine design and validation.

Who You Are

You are a highly skilled Mechanical Design Engineer with a passion for precision and innovation in gas turbine technology. With a strong foundation in mechanical engineering, you have extensive experience designing and optimizing complex components such as mixed-flow compressors, high-speed rotor shafts, and advanced bearing systems. Your expertise in material behavior under extreme thermal and mechanical stresses ensures that your designs are not only high-performing but also reliable. You excel in precision tolerancing, design for manufacturability, and conducting detailed stress analyses. Analytical and detail-oriented, you are always looking for ways to enhance performance and efficiency. Your proactive approach and technical acumen make you an invaluable asset to any advanced engineering team.

Benefits

Why Join Us?

✨ The Thrill of the Future – Work on cutting-edge projects that redefine aerospace.
✨ Global Innovation Hub – Collaborate with top engineers from all over the world.
✨ Fast-Paced & High-Growth – Experience the rush of working in a rapidly expanding company.
✨ Real Impact – Your work won’t be theoretical—it will shape the future of flight.

postings.title: Mechanical Engineer - Radar
postings.description:
Mechanical engineering is such a broad topic. So many different things to design and build. You have decided to utilize your skills and knowledge in the domain of radars, high-frequency electronics, RF systems. If you feel concerned about European defense capabilities maybe you'd like to help us at Destinus? We're here to help European countries protect themselves from threats in the increasingly unstable world.

What's in it for you? Improving safety of us all here in Europe, that's for starts. And by the way: if you're not comfortable with military applications, we're not going to be a good match for you. But if you're still reading and what to know a bit more... You will be well financially, not worrying about making it to the 1st, and in the long term perspective, you will be able to participate in our stock options program to see your impact impacting your future too. There's also a gym that you can use for free and kitchen where you can have breakfast at company expense.

But most importantly you will have tons of impact. We're a new kid on the block, growing fast, and our employees grow with the company. If you can operate in an environment with a good fair of ambiguity, you're gonna like it. You will see your designs materialize fast and you will see how your work contributes to the big picture, directly. If you're ambitious and bored with the timelines in traditional aerospace, this is the place.

You can expect to work on enclosure & radome structural design, making sure it's lightweight, durable and RF-transparent on top of it all. You'll select materials based on their strength, weight, and corrosion resistance, performing structural analysis for vibration, shock, and wind loads. You will also make sure sealing, gasketing and coatings meet IP ratings, designing for operation in wide temperature ranges and harsh conditions.

Of course, radomes need to be attached to something, so you'll also look into mounting & integration, developing such solutions for vehicles, towers, UAVs, and stationary installations. With your experience you already know that your work is also about ensuring precise alignment and stability of radar during operation.

And while we're on the operation part - you're going to contribute to thermal management as well. This means designing the passive and active cooling systems but also thermal simulations and testing to ensure electronics stay within limits. You will also support electronic engineers with thermomechanical codesign of PCBs.

All of your work would go to waste though if it wouldn't be properly tested. You will be involved in prototyping & manufacturing support. After all, you most likely want to ensure manufacturability and quality of what you designed.

If this sounds like a good place to start the conversation, we're happy to hear from you!

Requirements

Here's what we expect in your resume as we think will help you be successful:

- Proficiency in Siemens NX and TC.
- Knowledge of mechanical FEA and thermal simulation tools.
- Understanding of material properties (metals, composites, polymers).
- Experience with environmental sealing (IP65/IP67 or MIL-STD).
- Familiarity with precision mechanical assemblies and tolerancing. (ISO-GPS is a plus).
- Experience with radar, RF systems, or high-frequency electronics packaging.
- Knowledge of MIL-STD-810 or similar environmental test standards.
- Proficiency with 3D-Printing technologies.
- Expertise in composites and sandwich structures is a plus.

postings.title: Operations Finance Lead
postings.description:
About the role

Imagine this. You are building the financial backbone behind a fast-scaling, multi-site manufacturing organization. As our Operations Finance Lead, you will take ownership of how we understand manufacturing costs, margins, inventory and operational performance across the group. This is not a role where you simply inherit established processes. You will build, standardize and improve them, creating the financial discipline and visibility needed to scale our operations.

You will lead operations controlling, cost accounting and FP&A across manufacturing and supply chain, while partnering closely with Operations, Supply Chain, Engineering and Finance leadership. From product costing and inventory economics to forecasting, MES implementation and site performance, you will connect what happens on the factory floor with the numbers driving business decisions.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You’ll Do

- Own operations cost accounting across multiple manufacturing sites, including inventory accounting, cost of goods produced and sold, capitalization of labor and manufacturing overhead, and manufacturing-related month-end close activities
- Take ownership of inventory economics, including variance capitalization, COGS release, excess and obsolete inventory and slow-moving stock exposure
- Ensure manufacturing and inventory accounting is consistent across sites and legal entities and aligned with group accounting policies, IFRS and applicable local GAAP requirements
- Own and continuously improve the product costing framework across products and sites, including BOMs, routings, labor and overhead rates
- Drive cost and margin performance through variance analysis across purchase price, usage, mix, yield, labor efficiency and overhead absorption, identifying root causes and translating them into clear actions
- Partner with Operations and Supply Chain to understand and optimize key cost drivers across materials, conversion, productivity, capacity and waste
- Lead budgeting, forecasting and long-range planning for manufacturing and supply chain, connecting volumes, pricing, efficiency, capacity, headcount and capex assumptions to financial outcomes
- Build rolling forecasts and analyze monthly performance, creating a clear bridge between operational results, margins, working capital and the P&L
- Own operational KPIs with financial impact, including OTIF, yield, efficiency, days on hand and forecast accuracy
- Build practical management reporting and dashboards that give operations and executive leadership clear visibility into cost, margin, inventory and working capital performance
- Turn complex operational and financial data into actionable insights that support decisions around sourcing, pricing, investment and capacity
- Design and standardize finance processes across sites for costing, forecasting, month-end close and reporting, replacing fragmented practices with scalable group-wide frameworks
- Support MES implementation and ensure reliable manufacturing data flows into financial systems, working closely with Operations and IT to strengthen standard costing, inventory valuation, cost centers and BOM structures
- Establish strong internal controls over inventory, cost accounting and manufacturing transactions, maintaining clear segregation of duties and audit-ready documentation
- Define and roll out group-wide operations finance policies, templates and reporting calendars to create consistency across sites and legal entities
- Lead and coordinate operations finance across multiple manufacturing locations, developing site controllers and cost accountants while building a strong and consistent finance capability across the group
- Act as a trusted finance partner to Operations, Supply Chain and Engineering leadership, balancing the realities of individual sites with the financial discipline required at group level
- Support external audits, lender and investor processes and relevant multi-jurisdiction compliance requirements

Requirements

What You’ll Need

- Solid experience in operations finance, manufacturing controlling, finance business partnering, cost accounting or FP&A within an industrial, engineering or manufacturing environment
- Proven experience owning or building product and standard costing frameworks, inventory accounting and manufacturing variance analysis
- Strong understanding of operational finance, budgeting, forecasting, margin analysis and performance management
- Experience building finance processes, controls and reporting structures rather than only operating within established frameworks
- Strong understanding of internal controls and financial compliance within multi-entity or multi-jurisdiction organizations
- Confidence working with large data sets, ERP systems such as Microsoft Dynamics and advanced Excel or equivalent financial tools
- Experience with ERP or MES implementation, redesign or integration is a strong advantage
- Ability to translate complex financial and operational information into clear recommendations for non-finance stakeholders
- Experience coordinating finance activities across multiple sites or legal entities and managing or mentoring finance professionals
- Strong communication skills and the ability to challenge, influence and collaborate effectively across Finance, Operations, Supply Chain and Engineering
- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Engineering or a related field
- CPA, ACCA, CIMA, CMA or equivalent professional qualification is a plus
- Fluency in English, with another European language considered an advantage
- Willingness to travel regularly between Destinus sites
- Experience in aerospace, defense, high-tech manufacturing or a fast-scaling industrial environment is a strong plus
- Experience supporting external audits, institutional lenders, investors or financial diligence processes is also an advantage

Who You Are

You are hands-on, analytical and comfortable building structure where it does not yet exist. You can move from detailed product costing and inventory analysis to a strategic conversation with senior leadership without losing sight of either. You challenge numbers when they do not reflect operational reality, take ownership instead of waiting for instructions and know how to bring different sites and teams behind a common way of working. You thrive in a fast-moving environment where finance is expected to help drive the business, not simply report what already happened.

postings.title: Procurement Lead
postings.description:
About This Role

Imagine this. You are leading procurement at one of Destinus' key European sites, turning global strategy into reliable, efficient local execution. As Procurement Lead, you will take ownership of operational procurement activities in the Netherlands, supporting our manufacturing and engineering teams while ensuring materials and services are available when and where they are needed.

You will lead a small team of Buyers, manage the local supplier base, and act as the key link between global procurement and local operations. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can develop people, solve supply challenges, negotiate effectively, and keep procurement moving in a fast-paced aerospace environment.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations

What You´ll Do

· Lead, mentor, and develop the local purchasing team, driving accountability, efficiency, and continuous improvement.

· Own day-to-day procurement operations for the Netherlands site and ensure an effective end-to-end Procure-to-Pay process aligned with global policies.

· Manage relationships and performance across the local supplier base, with a strong focus on delivery, quality, cost, and responsiveness.

· Act as the main escalation point for local supply issues, working closely with suppliers and internal teams to resolve problems quickly.

· Lead tactical sourcing activities and supplier negotiations for local spend, securing the right balance of cost, quality, delivery, and risk.

· Partner closely with Site, Operations, Manufacturing, Engineering, and R&D teams to understand requirements and translate them into effective procurement actions within the global procurement policies.

postings.description:

Imagine this...You’re on the test field, watching a UAV come to life powered by a system you engineered. Every component, every connection, every safety mechanism—built through your design and expertise—operating flawlessly under demanding conditions. You’re not just creating parts; you’re developing critical technologies that define the next generation of defense systems. At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). What You´ll Do

What You´ll Need

- Excellent project management skills.
- Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail.
- Proficiency in relevant software tools (e.g., CAD, ERP systems).

Who You Are

You thrive in a fast-paced production environment where precision and performance go hand in hand. You’re a natural leader who knows how to inspire teams, drive results, and keep operations running smoothly under pressure. Collaboration is your strength—you build trust, motivate others, and know how to turn strategy into action. Above all, you care about quality, safety, and efficiency, and you lead by example to make sure every product that leaves the line reflects excellence.

postings.title: Production Planner & Controller
postings.description:
Imagine this. You are the person who keeps production moving with precision. Every schedule you build, every material you coordinate, and every decision you make helps transform engineering innovation into reality. As a Production Planner at Destinus, you will ensure our manufacturing operations in Born (South Netherlands) run efficiently, balancing resources, materials, and production priorities to deliver high quality aerospace products on time.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. What You'll Do

• Develop, maintain, and optimize production schedules to ensure efficient workflow and on time delivery.

• Coordinate the flow of work orders, materials, and production priorities across manufacturing operations.

• Monitor inventory levels of raw materials, components, and finished goods to maintain the right balance between availability and stock optimization.

• Work closely with the Procurement team to ensure materials are available when needed and support material requirements planning.

What You'll Need

• Experience working with ERP or MRP systems for production scheduling and inventory management.

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to prioritize multiple production activities in a dynamic environment.

Who You Are

You enjoy bringing structure to complex operations and keeping multiple priorities moving at the same time. postings.title: Production Support Engineer
postings.description:
About the Role

Imagine this, you are the engineer who keeps advanced aerospace systems moving from design into production. As a Production Support Engineer, you will build the tools, infrastructure, and processes that enable our production teams to manufacture complex electronic systems efficiently, reliably, and at scale. Working at the intersection of software, hardware, and manufacturing, you will remove production bottlenecks, automate repetitive tasks, and continuously improve how we build next generation UAV technologies.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You'll Do

- Partner with production and engineering teams to identify bottlenecks, eliminate waste, and continuously improve manufacturing processes.
- Design, develop, and maintain production infrastructure, automated tools, and manufacturing support systems.
- Develop and implement calibration equipment, automated test systems, and custom hardware rigs for production.
- Troubleshoot production issues and implement robust, long-term engineering solutions.
- Create intuitive software interfaces that enable production technicians to perform tasks efficiently and consistently.
- Integrate production equipment, devices, and servers through reliable and secure network solutions.
- Support the introduction of new products into production by developing scalable manufacturing processes and tooling.
- Contribute to process documentation and standard operating procedures to ensure quality and repeatability.

What You'll Work With

- Real Hardware
Develop in-house fixtures, testing equipment, and production methodologies to manufacture complex aerospace systems while maintaining the highest quality standards.

Connect production equipment, embedded devices, and servers through reliable and secure network infrastructure.
- Software & User Interfaces
Build simple, intuitive applications and tools that streamline production workflows and improve operator efficiency.

Requirements

- Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Robotics, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
- 3+ years of experience in a production engineering, manufacturing engineering, test engineering, or similar role.
- Strong programming skills in at least one of C/C++, Go, or Python.
- Experience developing hardware test systems, automation tools, or production software.
- Understanding of manufacturing principles and continuous improvement methodologies such as Lean Manufacturing.
- Hands-on mindset with strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work across software and hardware.
- Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams.

- Experience working with UAVs, robotics, or other complex electromechanical systems.
- Knowledge of visual-inertial navigation systems or sensor integration.
- Background in electronics manufacturing or production testing.
- Understanding of physics, control systems, or embedded systems.

Who You Are

You enjoy solving practical engineering challenges and turning complex problems into simple, scalable solutions. You thrive in fast-moving environments where you can combine software, hardware, and manufacturing to make a real impact. You take ownership, work collaboratively, and are always looking for smarter ways to improve processes while maintaining quality.

postings.title: Program Manager
postings.description:
About the role

Imagine that you are leading some of the most complex and strategically important programs in the aerospace and defense industry, balancing customer expectations, business performance, operational execution, and long-term growth. As a Program Manager at Destinus, you will sit at the intersection of technology, production, finance, and customer success, ensuring that ambitious programs are delivered on time, on budget, and aligned with business objectives.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

This role goes beyond traditional project management. You will be responsible for driving program strategy, managing financial performance, mitigating risks, and building strong customer relationships while coordinating multidisciplinary teams across engineering, production, supply chain, and business functions. Your ability to translate complex challenges into actionable plans will directly impact the success of our products and the future growth of the company.

What You’ll Do

- Own the full lifecycle of strategic programs from contract award through delivery, ensuring alignment with business objectives, customer expectations, and operational capabilities

- Manage program financial performance, including P&L responsibility, forecasting, budgeting, cost control, margin optimization, and financial reporting

- Develop and execute program strategies that balance customer requirements, technical objectives, commercial goals, and operational constraints

- Build trusted relationships with customers, government stakeholders, partners, and internal leadership teams, acting as the primary point of contact for program-related matters

- Identify, assess, and proactively mitigate program risks across technical, operational, financial, contractual, and supply chain domains

- Lead cross-functional teams across engineering, production, procurement, quality, and operations to ensure successful program execution

- Monitor program performance through KPIs, milestones, and financial metrics, driving corrective actions when needed

- Support contract negotiations, change management activities, and commercial discussions throughout the program lifecycle

- Ensure compliance with contractual obligations, regulatory requirements, and company governance standards

- Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance program execution, operational efficiency, and customer satisfaction

Requirements

What You’ll Need

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Aerospace, Industrial Management, or a related field

- Minimum 15 years of experience in Program Management, Senior Project Management, or Business Management roles within aerospace, defense, manufacturing, or highly regulated industrial environments

- Strong P&L management experience with proven responsibility for program financial performance, budgeting, forecasting, and profitability

- Demonstrated experience managing large-scale, complex programs involving multiple stakeholders and international teams

- Deep understanding of risk management methodologies and program governance frameworks

- Strong customer-facing experience, including executive-level stakeholder management and contract execution

- Experience working within production and industrial environments, with a solid understanding of manufacturing processes and supply chain operations

- Aerospace and defense industry experience is mandatory

- Strong commercial acumen with the ability to balance technical, operational, and financial priorities

- Excellent communication, negotiation, and leadership skills

- Fluency in English is required. Additional European languages are considered an advantage

Who You Are

You are a strategic thinker who understands that successful programs are built on more than schedules and deliverables. You see the bigger picture, connecting financial performance, customer satisfaction, operational excellence, and business growth. You thrive in complex environments where priorities evolve quickly and decisions have real impact. You are comfortable challenging assumptions, managing risk, and navigating uncertainty while keeping teams aligned and focused on results. Most importantly, you take ownership, build trust with stakeholders, and consistently deliver outcomes that create value for both customers and the business.

Benefits

Why Join Us?

✨ The Thrill of the Future – Work on cutting-edge projects that redefine aerospace.
✨ Global Innovation Hub – Collaborate with top engineers from all over the world.
✨ Fast-Paced & High-Growth – Experience the rush of working in a rapidly expanding company.
✨ Real Impact – Your work won’t be theoretical—it will shape the future of flight.

Destinus is an equal-opportunity employer. We value diversity in our companies and our teams and do not discriminate based on age, race, religion, color, country of origin, gender, sexual orientation, or disability status.

🚀 Destinus – Challenge the limits of time, space, and human potential.

postings.title: Programme Manager
postings.description:
Imagine this, you are running the programme engine behind a four-nation European consortium developing an anti-ballistic missile system at operational pace. Destinus is the programme prime and responsible for the exo-atmospheric interceptor, engineered for affordability and production at scale.

As Programme Manager, you will turn technical direction into disciplined execution. You will own the schedule, budget, risks, actions, programme governance, and information flow across industrial partners and national stakeholders, keeping a small senior engineering team focused on delivery.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You'll Do

- Own the integrated programme schedule across Destinus and partner work packages, tracking critical paths, dependencies, milestones, and deliverables
- Run the programme operating rhythm, including technical boards, work-package reviews and partner meetings, ensuring decisions and actions are tracked to closure
- Own budget tracking, programme risks, issues, and escalation to programme leadership
- Manage export-control, security, releasability, document control, and controlled information flows across consortium partners
- Coordinate partner deliverables, interfaces, data exchanges, and review preparation
- Support governmental and customer milestones with clear programme status, documentation, and reporting

Requirements

- 10+ years of programme or project management experience in defence, aerospace, or another regulated technical environment
- Experience running complex multi-party or international programmes involving industrial and government stakeholders
- Hands-on experience with export-controlled and/or classified programmes, including security, releasability, and information-control procedures
- Strong experience with integrated scheduling, budgets, milestones, risk management, action tracking, and document control
- Technical literacy to confidently follow engineering reviews and translate decisions into clear actions
- Fluent professional English, with French, German, or Dutch considered a plus

Highly Desirable

- Experience with missile, aerospace, weapons, or other government defence programmes
- Experience establishing programme structures and processes for a new or early-phase development programme

postings.title: Project Manager - Integration & Transformation
postings.description:
Imagine this. Destinus has just signed its next acquisition. The deal is done, but the real work is just beginning. Different teams, systems, processes and priorities now need to come together without slowing down the business. That is where you come in.

As our Integration Project Manager, you will take ownership of post-acquisition integrations from signing through to steady state. You will not own Legal, Finance, HR, IT or Operations. You will own the plan that brings them all together. You will create structure, maintain momentum, identify risks early and make sure decisions turn into action.

This is a hands-on program management role for someone who can navigate complexity, challenge delays and keep multiple workstreams moving toward the same goal.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You’ll Do

- Build and own the master integration plan for each acquisition, connecting workstreams, milestones, dependencies and owners across the organization
- Drive integration governance through steering committee updates, RAID logs, decision tracking and clear reporting that gives stakeholders an accurate view of progress
- Coordinate workstream leads across Legal, Finance, HR, IT, Operations, Facilities, Security and Communications, keeping individual plans aligned with the overall integration roadmap
- Lead Day 1 readiness planning, ensuring people, systems, contracts, facilities and communications are ready when the deal closes
- Identify integration risks, blockers and dependencies early and drive resolution before they impact critical milestones
- Track the realization of cost and revenue synergies against the deal plan and clearly communicate deviations, risks and actions to leadership
- Act as the central coordination point for the acquired company throughout the integration, connecting teams and ensuring questions and dependencies reach the right owners
- Run structured integration close-out reviews, capturing lessons learned and translating them into practical improvements for future acquisitions
- Build and continuously improve the Destinus integration playbook, templates and governance model so every new integration becomes faster, clearer and more predictable

Requirements

What You’ll Need

- 5+ years of experience in program or project management, ideally with exposure to at least one full-cycle M&A integration
- Experience gained within consulting, PMO, operations, corporate development or another highly cross-functional environment
- Proven ability to manage complex, multi-workstream programs and drive accountability without relying on formal authority
- Strong project management discipline with experience managing milestones, dependencies, RAID logs, governance meetings and executive-level reporting
- Excellent stakeholder management skills and the confidence to work across different functions and levels of seniority
- Ability to operate effectively in ambiguous environments with changing priorities and compressed timelines
- Experience with cross-border integrations involving multiple legal entities or jurisdictions
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to turn complex information into clear actions and decisions
- Fluent English, with additional languages considered an advantage
- Experience within aerospace, defence or another regulated or high-security industry is an advantage
- PMP, PROSCI or an equivalent project or change management certification is an advantage

Who You Are

You bring order to complexity and momentum to situations where multiple teams and priorities collide. You are structured without being rigid, comfortable challenging stakeholders and quick to spot the dependencies others miss. You take ownership, communicate clearly and keep moving even when the full picture is still evolving. Most importantly, you know that successful integrations are not built through endless meetings. They happen because someone keeps the plan alive and makes sure things actually get done.

Benefits

What We Offer

- The opportunity to build and shape the integration playbook of a fast-growing aerospace and defence company
- A front-row role in acquisitions and strategic growth across an international organization
- The chance to work alongside multidisciplinary teams tackling complex engineering, operational and business challenges
- A fast-paced environment built around ownership, collaboration and meaningful impact

postings.description:
Shape the Future of Propulsion

Imagine this - you are driving the development of advanced turbojet engines from early concept through testing, qualification, and production. As Project Manager - Turbojet Engineering, you will bring structure, pace, and accountability to complex propulsion programs, ensuring engineering, manufacturing, suppliers, and stakeholders stay aligned around the same objectives.
