postings.title: Propellant Chemist
postings.description:
About the role

Imagine being at the core of propulsion innovation, shaping the very materials that power our high performance rocket systems. As a Propellant Engineer at Destinus, you will lead the formulation, development, and characterization of solid rocket propellants and thermal protection materials for high-performance rocket motor applications. This role is strongly hands-on and combines materials science, process development, and analytical rigor to deliver reliable, high-quality propulsion materials.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You´ll Do

- Develop and optimize solid rocket propellant formulations, balancing performance, mechanical properties, stability, and manufacturability.
- Lead laboratory-scale mixing, casting, curing, and post-processing activities in accordance with defined safety and quality standards.
- Define and implement characterization methodologies for propellant materials, including mechanical, thermal, rheological, ballistic, ablation and aging evaluations.
- Establish and document standard test procedures, acceptance criteria, and data analysis methods for propellant & TPS materials development and qualification.
- Support the definition of process parameters and quality control for propellant and TPS manufacturing, including mixing, degassing, casting, curing, and storage.
- Analyse formulation trade-offs and drive improvements in performance, robustness, and reproducibility.
- Support rocket motor development programs by correlating material properties to motor performance and structural behaviour and thermal environments.
- Lead or support investigation of material anomalies, aging effects, or performance deviations, driving root cause analysis and corrective actions.
- Prepare and maintain detailed technical documentation, including formulation records, process specifications, characterization reports, and development plans.
- Collaborate closely with propulsion, structures, manufacturing, and test teams to ensure seamless integration of propellant materials into motor designs.
- Contribute to long-term technology development roadmaps for advanced propellant systems.

Requirements

What You’ll Need

- BSc. or MSc. in Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Chemistry, Aerospace Engineering, or a related discipline.
- 5+ years of experience in solid rocket propellant development or closely related polymer/composite material systems.
- Experience with propellant formulation, mixing, casting, and curing processes.
- Strong understanding of polymer-bonded systems, composite materials, and viscoelastic behaviour.
- Experience defining and conducting material characterization programs, including mechanical, thermal, and aging testing.
- Familiarity with establishing standard operating procedures and structured development processes.
- Analytical mindset with the ability to translate material data into engineering decisions.
- Strong documentation discipline and ability to work in a safety-critical environment.
- Ability to work hands-on in laboratory and pilot-scale environments.
- Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across multidisciplinary teams.
- Fluency in English required; German is a plus.

Who You Are

You are a propulsion minded materials expert who feels at home in the lab and on the production floor. You understand polymer bonded propellants not just in theory but in practice, from formulation strategy to mixing, casting, curing, and final characterization. You are comfortable defining the technical path forward while also building the processes, documentation, and qualification methods that make materials flight ready and repeatable.

Benefits

Why Join Us?

✨ The Thrill of the Future – Work on cutting-edge projects that redefine aerospace.
✨ Global Innovation Hub – Collaborate with top engineers from all over the world.
✨ Fast-Paced & High-Growth – Experience the rush of working in a rapidly expanding company.
✨ Real Impact – Your work won’t be theoretical—it will shape the future of flight.

Destinus is an equal-opportunity employer. We value diversity in our companies and our teams and do not discriminate based on age, race, religion, color, country of origin, gender, sexual orientation, or disability status.

🚀 Destinus – Challenge the limits of time, space, and human potential.

postings.title: Propellant Production Technician
postings.description:
About the Role

The Destinus engineering team is seeking a Propellant Production Technician to support the serial manufacturing of solid rocket motor propellant at our Lucerne facility. The role is hands-on and process-focused, working directly with energetic and chemical materials in a tightly regulated, safety-critical production environment.

The ideal candidate is technically grounded, detail-oriented, and comfortable following precise procedures without shortcuts. They understand that in this environment, quality and safety are inseparable, and that meticulous documentation is as much a part of the job as the production work itself.

What You’ll Do

- Carry out propellant mixing, casting, and curing operations for solid rocket motor grains following validated batch records and SOPs

- Weigh, prepare, and handle energetic and chemical raw materials in accordance with applicable safety protocols, permits, and operating procedures

- Operate and monitor production equipment (mixers, casting stations, curing ovens) and record process parameters accurately throughout each batch

- Complete batch documentation fully and accurately; maintain traceability of materials, process parameters, and production records for every run

- Perform in-process quality checks and dimensional or visual inspections; identify and escalate non-conformances promptly

- Support the assembly & integration and packaging of the final product

- Support troubleshooting and corrective actions in collaboration with the Production Manager, engineering, and QA teams

- Keep the production area clean, organised, and compliant with housekeeping and safety standards at all times

- Contribute to the continuous improvement of production processes and safety practices

Requirements

What You’ll Need

- Background in chemistry, chemical production, or a related technical field, Chemielaborant EFZ qualification is a plus

- Hands-on experience in a chemical or process manufacturing environment, ideally batch production; experience with energetic, pyrotechnic, or otherwise hazardous materials is a strong advantage

- Familiarity with safety-critical production procedures, hazardous materials handling, and relevant Swiss regulations (SUVA, StFV)

- Ability to follow, and maintain SOPs and batch records with a high level of accuracy and discipline

- Experience with quality control and in-process inspection in a production or laboratory environment

- High attention to detail and a methodical, safety-first approach to all production activities

- Fluent in German or English is an advantage

Who You Are

You are hands-on, precise, and comfortable working in an environment where safety and quality leave no room for shortcuts. You take ownership of your work, follow processes with discipline, and stay focused even when production moves fast. You enjoy solving practical problems, working closely with others, and continuously improving how things are done. You are reliable, curious, and proud of delivering work that meets the highest standards every time.

postings.title: Propellant R&D Technician
postings.description:
About the Role

The Destinus engineering team is seeking a Propellant Technician to produce solid rocket motors for R&D programmes and test campaigns. This is a hands-on chemistry and production role operating in a tightly regulated, safety-critical environment – where process discipline, quality, and meticulous documentation are as important as the production work itself.

The ideal candidate is technically grounded, follows procedures exactly, and takes personal accountability for the quality of every motor that leaves their bench.

What You’ll Do

· Produce propellant mixes, cast grains, and manufacture solid rocket motors for R&D programmes and test campaigns, following validated batch records and SOPs

· Prepare and handle energetic and chemical raw materials – weighing, mixing, and processing in strict accordance with safety protocols and operating procedures

· Operate and monitor production equipment (mixers, casting stations, curing ovens); record all process parameters accurately throughout each batch

· Complete batch documentation fully and traceably for every run: materials, lot numbers, process parameters, deviations, and personnel

· Perform in-process quality checks and dimensional/visual inspection of finished motors; identify and escalate non-conformances immediately

· Write, maintain, and improve SOPs for propellant and motor production operations; ensure repeatability and safety at every step

· Support post-test teardown and failure investigation activities alongside propulsion engineers

· Maintain a clean, organized, and fully compliant production area at all times

Requirements

What You’ll Need

· Background in chemistry, chemical technology, or a related technical field – Chemietechnologe/in, process technician, or equivalent; Chemielaborant EFZ is a plus

· Hands-on experience in chemical or energetic materials production; experience with propellants, pyrotechnics, or explosives manufacturing is a strong advantage

· Exceptional process discipline – follows SOPs exactly, documents everything, and does not improvise in a safety-critical environment

· Experience with in-process quality control and inspection in a production or laboratory environment

· Comfortable working in a small R&D team where priorities shift and production runs vary in scale and complexity

· Fluent in English; German or French is an advantage

postings.title: Propulsion & Control Engineer
postings.description:
Imagine this. You own the propulsion and control system responsible for steering an interceptor during the most critical seconds of its mission. As Propulsion & Control Engineer, you will take ownership of the terminal control propulsion subsystem from architecture and sizing through actuation, integration, and qualification testing, turning design assumptions into proven hardware performance.

Bliksem Exo is a four-nation European consortium developing an anti-ballistic missile system at operational pace. Destinus is the programme prime and is responsible for the exo-atmospheric interceptor, designed for affordability, performance, and production at scale.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You’ll Do

- Own the terminal control propulsion subsystem end to end, including architecture, performance sizing, actuation, and thermal and structural integration
- Specify and develop fast-response actuation systems capable of meeting demanding response, thrust, and precision requirements
- Turn estimated performance into measured results through hardware testing and feed validated data back into the vehicle design
- Own technical relationships with propulsion and actuation suppliers, defining specifications, critically evaluating designs, and ensuring hardware meets vehicle requirements
- Plan and execute bench, environmental, and qualification test campaigns, including test rigs, instrumentation, data analysis, and verification against requirements
- Work closely with GNC, mechanical, systems, and other engineering teams to ensure the subsystem performs as part of the complete interceptor

Who You Are

You are a hands-on engineer who wants ownership of the hardware, not just the analysis behind it. You are comfortable making decisions where performance margins are tight, challenging assumptions with data, and following a subsystem from first principles through testing. You work naturally across disciplines, communicate clearly with suppliers and engineering teams, and thrive in an environment where speed, precision, and technical excellence matter.

Requirements

- BSc, MSc, or PhD in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field
- 10+ years of experience in rocket, spacecraft, missile propulsion, or a closely related field, with hands-on ownership of propulsion or reaction-control hardware through design, build, and test
- Direct experience with fast-response actuation systems such as valves, thrusters, or equivalent technologies and precise control of thrust or flow
- Strong hands-on testing experience, including designing, running, and interpreting propulsion or actuation test campaigns
- Strong understanding of propulsion physics, including thrust and flow sizing, thermal behavior, and material and durability limits in hot, high-pressure environments
- Experience with quantitative engineering, sizing, and data analysis using Python or MATLAB
- Experience with divert and attitude control systems, reaction-control systems, interceptors, or missile systems is highly valued
- Experience working across multi-company or multinational engineering programmes is an advantage

postings.title: Propulsion Test Technician
postings.description:
The Destinus engineering team is seeking a Propulsion Test Technician to support the preparation, assembly, operation, and maintenance of propulsion test activities at our Payerne test facility.

Working directly alongside propulsion test engineers, you will be responsible for the hands-on readiness of test benches, ground support equipment, and instrumentation – ensuring that every test is set up correctly, runs safely, and that the facility stays operational between campaigns.

What You’ll Do

· Prepare test benches, ground support equipment (GSE), and instrumentation for propulsion and pyrotechnic test campaigns – mechanical assembly, connections, and pre-test checks

· Assemble rocket motors and pyrotechnic devices onto test rigs following assembly procedures, travellers, and safety protocols

· Support test operations: monitor systems during test runs, operate ground support equipment, and assist test engineers throughout the campaign

· Perform post-test teardown, inspection, and data collection; document findings and flag anomalies

· Carry out scheduled and corrective maintenance of test benches, GSE, and facility equipment; maintain maintenance logs and flag items requiring engineering review

· Manage test bench operability: track the status of equipment, calibration, and facility systems; ensure readiness ahead of each test campaign

· Handle and store energetic test articles, propellants, and pyrotechnic devices in compliance with applicable safety protocols and site procedures

· Maintain a safe, organized test facility in line with regulations, site safety rules, and internal procedures

Requirements

What You’ll Need

· Vocational training as a Polymechaniker/in, mechanic, or equivalent hands-on technical qualification

· Several years of experience in a technical support, test operations, or maintenance role in an industrial, aerospace, or defence environment

· Comfortable with mechanical assembly, fluid systems, and instrumentation connections in a test environment

· Experience with test bench or GSE maintenance; familiarity with calibration and functional check procedures

· Ability to read and follow assembly procedures, test plans, and work instructions accurately

· Experience handling energetic, pyrotechnic, or otherwise hazardous materials is a strong advantage

· Methodical and safety-conscious – someone who does not take shortcuts in a safety-critical test environment

· Fluent in English; French and/or German is a strong advantage given the Payerne site

postings.title: Propulsion Test Traineeship/ Internship
postings.description:
The Destinus engineering team is seeking a highly motivated, operations-focused Propulsion Test Trainee/ Intern to support the safe planning, execution, and continuous improvement of solid rocket motor and igniter testing. This role is strongly hands-on and centered on test readiness, procedural rigor, and operational safety, ensuring reliable, repeatable, and compliant testing of energetic propulsion systems. The ideal candidate has first hands on experience owning test campaigns from student teams or similar.

What You’ll Do

· Support the planning, coordination, and execution of solid rocket motor and igniter test campaigns

· Support the test conductor during live firings, coordinating personnel, enforcing safety zones, making technical decisions to ensure test objectives are achieved, and responding to off-nominal or abort conditions

· Support the definition and validation of instrumentation and data acquisition requirements to ensure test objectives are met.

· Oversee test setup integration, inspection, dry runs, and functional verifications of motors, igniters, firing circuits, and safety interlocks.

· Support test anomaly, misfire, or incident investigations, including root cause analysis and implementation of corrective actions.

· Produce high-quality test documentation, including test plans, risk assessments, test reports, and lessons learned.

· Collaborate closely with propulsion, mechanical, electrical, software, and systems engineers to ensure alignment between test objectives, design maturity, and operational constraints.

· Support the development and improvement of test infrastructure, firing stands, remote operations, and safety systems for solid rocket motor testing.

Requirements

What You’ll Need

· BSc. or MSc. in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline.

· Ideally, you bring 1-2 years of experience in a student team working on rocket propulsion

· Strong understanding of rocket propulsion is required, with experience specifically in solid rocket motors considered a plus

· Experience in propulsion testing, such as static firing or ignition system validation, is a strong plus.

· First experience in test planning, procedural definition, and hands-on test execution.

· Familiarity with propulsion test instrumentation and data acquisition systems is a plus

· Ability to operate calmly and decisively during time-critical ignition and firing operations.

· Strong communication skills, with the ability to lead test activities and coordinate multidisciplinary teams.

· Proactive, ownership-driven mindset with strong problem-solving capabilities.

· Ability to work autonomously and as part of a fast-paced, multidisciplinary development team.

· Fluency in English is required; German is a plus.

postings.title: Quality Assurance Engineer
postings.description:
About the role

Imagine working at the final checkpoint between groundbreaking aerospace technology and real-world deployment. As a Quality Assurance Engineer, you will help ensure that advanced aerial vehicles meet the highest standards of quality, reliability, and compliance. Working closely with engineering, manufacturing, and program teams, you will drive quality throughout the entire product lifecycle, from development and testing to qualification and delivery. This is an opportunity to play a critical role in supporting mission-ready systems for defense applications while helping shape a culture of excellence across the organization.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You´ll Do

- Implement, maintain, and improve QA processes across hardware and software development in line with ARP4754A, DO-178C, DO-254, and DO-160G
- Perform process assurance activities: audits, stage-of-involvement reviews, and conformity checks throughout the development lifecycle
- Support certification and qualification campaigns, including environmental testing per DO-160G
- Interface with engineering teams, suppliers, certification authorities, and military customers on quality matters
- Support supplier quality assurance, including audits and incoming inspection criteria
- Contribute to the company QMS and its alignment with aerospace standards (e.g., AS/EN 9100)

Requirements

What You’ll Need

- Degree in aerospace, electrical, mechanical engineering, or a related field Proven track record of managing distributed Office Manager / Workplace teams and building consistent service standards across locations.
- 2–5 years of experience in quality or development assurance in aerospace or a similarly regulated industry
- Working knowledge of ARP4754A, DO-178C, DO-254, and DO-160G and their application across the development lifecycle
- Experience with military development processes and standards (e.g., MIL-STD-882, MIL-HDBK-516, AQAP 2110) highly preferred
- Hands-on experience with audits, reviews, and configuration/change management
- Strong documentation skills and attention to detail; able to challenge engineering teams constructively
- Willingness and ability to travel regularly to European sites
- Excellent communication and writing skills in English

Who You Are

You are detail-oriented, analytical, and passionate about building products that perform flawlessly in demanding environments. You enjoy working across teams, balancing technical rigor with practical problem-solving, and you are comfortable challenging assumptions when quality is at stake. You thrive in fast-paced, highly regulated environments where precision matters, and you take ownership of ensuring that processes, products, and documentation consistently meet the highest standards. Most importantly, you see quality not as a final inspection step, but as a mindset embedded in every stage of development.

postings.title: Quality Engineer
postings.description:
About the role

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

We seek a Quality Engineer to ensure the highest quality on our production floor and drive quality improvement initiatives throughout the manufacturing process. The ideal candidate will bring strong analytical skills and a keen eye for detail to identify defects early, facilitate corrective actions, and foster a quality organizational culture.

What You'll Do

- Quality Assurance Protocols: Develop, implement, and maintain quality assurance procedures and protocols that ensure compliance with industry standards and internal specifications.

- Defect Analysis: Investigate and analyze non-conformities, root causes, and corrective actions; document findings and provide recommendations for process improvements.

- Inspection and Testing: Oversee inspection activities and coordinate testing processes to verify product quality and adherence to specifications throughout production phases.

- Continuous Improvement: Lead initiatives to enhance product quality, reduce defects, and improve overall process performance using Six Sigma or Lean Manufacturing methodologies.

- Training & Development: Develop and deliver training for production staff on quality standards, inspection techniques, and the importance of quality in manufacturing processes.

- Data Management: Collect and analyze quality data to track performance metrics; prepare reports to communicate quality performance to management and stakeholders.

- Supplier Quality Management: Collaborate with suppliers to provide quality materials and components; conduct supplier audits and assessments as needed.

- Team Support: Provide day-to-day support to the quality inspection team (currently 4 FTEs), offering technical guidance.

- Documentation: Maintain effective documentation of quality control measures, inspection records, and quality management system documentation.

- Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with engineering, production, and design teams to ensure quality is integrated into the product development and manufacturing processes.

Requirements

What You'll Need

- Bachelor's degree in Quality Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.

- 4-6 years of experience in a quality engineering role, preferably in the aerospace, automotive, or manufacturing industries.

- Strong understanding of quality standards (ISO, AS9100) and experience with quality control tools and methodologies (e.g., FMEA, Control Plans, SPC, Six Sigma).

- Proven experience with inspection and testing methods and a solid understanding of manufacturing processes.

- Excellent analytical skills and attention to detail, with the ability to effectively identify issues and implement corrective actions.

- Strong communication and interpersonal skills to foster collaboration across teams and train staff on quality standards.

- Prior experience supporting or mentoring a small team (e.g., quality inspectors or technicians) is preferred.

- Proficient in quality management software and data analysis tools (e.g., Minitab, Excel, Power BI).

- Fluent in English and Spanish, with strong written and verbal communication skills.

Who You Are

You are a hands-on quality professional who feels at home close to production, where problems need to be understood and solved quickly. You combine a sharp eye for detail with a practical mindset and are comfortable challenging existing processes when there is a better way forward. You take ownership of quality issues from root cause to resolution, communicate clearly across engineering and production teams, and know how to turn data into concrete improvements. You thrive in a fast-paced environment, stay structured when priorities shift, and genuinely care about building a strong quality culture where excellence is everyone's responsibility.

postings.title: Quality Inspector
postings.description:
Imagine this - As a Quality Inspector, you’re on the production floor, surrounded by state-of-the-art defense aerospace technology — components built to dominate the skies, withstand extreme environments, and empower next-generation defense systems. You’re the last line of defense between cutting-edge innovation and uncompromising reliability. 🚀

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You’ll Do

- Find and Fix: Identify defects, troubleshoot root causes, and work hand-in-hand with production and engineering teams to solve problems before they take flight.

Requirements

What You’ll Need

Must-Have

- Proven experience as a Quality Inspector in aerospace, automotive, or high-tech manufacturing.
- Strong understanding of technical drawings, blueprints, and inspection methods.
- Sharp attention to detail — you spot imperfections others miss.
- Knowledge of ISO standards, quality systems, and reporting procedures.
- English and Dutch

Nice-to-Haves

- Experience with non-destructive testing (NDT).
- Familiarity with Lean Manufacturing or Six Sigma principles.
- Basic understanding of composite materials or advanced alloys.

Who You Are

You’re not just an inspector — you’re a perfectionist with purpose. You thrive in fast-paced, high-stakes environments where every detail matters, driven by curiosity to constantly question how things can be done better, faster, and smarter. You’re a problem solver who doesn’t just spot issues — you dive in, figure out what went wrong, and help make it right. Most importantly, you take ownership, knowing that when you’re part of a team reshaping aerospace defense, you don’t wait for someone else to lead the way — you set the standard.

postings.title: Radar System Engineer
postings.description:
About the role

Imagine shaping the future of radar technology by developing next generation digital radar systems built for high performance environments where every gram, watt, and millisecond matters. As a Radar System Engineer, you will work at the intersection of system architecture, advanced electronics, and mission-critical aerospace applications, collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to transform complex requirements into cutting-edge radar solutions. You will play a key role in defining system requirements, driving technical trade-offs, and selecting the right components to achieve demanding SWaP-C targets. This is a role for engineers who enjoy solving complex technical challenges, balancing performance with real-world constraints, and pushing advanced sensing systems to the next level.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You´ll Do

- Behavioral modelling of bistatic radar systems
- System level simulation to predict system performance based on key metrics (e.g. SNR, resolution parameters)
- Validation of the system model against measurements
- RX and TX architecture
- Writing requirements and specifications
- Lead system level studies across domains: HW, SW, signal processing, mechanical
- Collaborate with RF design, digital design, SW engineering and signal processing as well as mechanical engineering

Requirements

What You’ll Need

postings.title: Requirements Manager - Ammunition & Missile Systems
postings.description:
The Requirements Manager is the process and tooling architect behind our complex munition development projects. In this role, you do not write individual engineering requirements. Instead, you build, maintain, and govern the requirements management framework, tracing infrastructure, and workflows that directly feed into the formal S3 qualification and certification pipeline.

You will ensure that our Requirements Management (RM) toolset (Jama Connect) is custom-configured to map system requirements dynamically to the array of safety plans, risk analyses, component testing records, and formal reports required by Allied Ordnance Publications (AOP) and NATO Standardization Agreements (STANAGs). Furthermore, you will act as the organizational mentor, training multidisciplinary teams to ensure full digital traceability from the initial Concept of Operations (CONOPS) to the final In-Service Surveillance Test Plan.

Key Responsibilities

1. S3 Lifecycle Governance, Traceability, and V&V Mapping

· End-to-End Traceability Architecture: Establish and govern a robust requirements database structure that enforces 100% bidirectional traceability throughout the entire munition qualification lifecycle.

· Baseline and Safety Integration: Configure the Requirements Management (RM) tool to seamlessly integrate foundational system baselines (CONOPS, LCEP, SRD) and complex safety/hazard analyses (FHA, O&SHA, AOP-52, SAR), ensuring risk mitigations flow directly into verifiable design elements.

· V&V Mapping & Verification: Oversee the configuration of Verification Cross-Reference Matrices (VCRM) tailored to ammunition specifications, cleanly mapping system requirements to both component-level safety tests (STANAG 4170, 4187, 4368) and platform-level trials (STANAG 4758, 4439, E3/HERO).

· Audit-Ready Compliance: Ensure the requirements ecosystem dynamically populates and validates the comprehensive data points required for the final Munition Safety Data Package and formal S3 certification.

2. Tooling Administration & Defense Customization

· Own, configure, and maintain the enterprise RM toolset (Jama Connect).

· Design custom database schemas, attributes, and linking workflows specifically optimized for Whole Life Assessment (WLA), including links between initial development S3 data and In-Service Surveillance Test Plans (STANAG 4675 / STANAG 4629).

· Implement strict data segregation, version control, and access control models aligned with military security classifications and export control regulations (ITAR/EAR).

3. Training, Enablement & Auditing

· Develop and deliver continuous training programs for systems, software, hardware, and safety engineers on requirements engineering best practices within a NATO/S3 framework.

· Coach the engineering team on how to write verifiable, non-ambiguous requirements that comply with strict explosive safety design principles.

· Lead internal quality audits of the requirements database to guarantee total data integrity prior to formal milestone reviews, such as Systems Requirements Reviews (SRR), Preliminary Design Reviews (PDR), and Critical Design Reviews (CDR).

Requirements

Military S3 & STANAG Background (Mandatory)

· Experience: Minimum of 5+ years of experience in systems engineering environments, with a dedicated focus on requirements/process management for ammunition, missiles, rockets, or explosive weapon systems.

· STANAG & AOP Framework Expertise: Authoritative knowledge of the NATO S3 framework (STANAG 4297) and its dependent standardization protocols:

Technical & Tooling Proficiencies

· Advanced Tool Administration: Power-user or administrator-level mastery of Jama Connect. Experience deploying schemas across complex hardware/software systems is required.

· Systems Engineering Methodology: Master-level understanding of the V-Model, Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE / SysML), Configuration Management, and Verification & Validation (V&V) methodologies.

· Certifications: Professional certifications in Requirements Engineering (e.g., IREB CPRE) or Systems Engineering (e.g., INCOSE CSEP) are highly valued.

Leadership & Soft Skills

· Pedagogical Capability: Proven track record of training and upskilling multidisciplinary engineering teams on complex processes and tooling interfaces.

· Audit Resilience: Ability to confidently stand before national and international military certification authorities, defending the traceability and integrity of the requirements ecosystem during formal S3 audits.

postings.title: Revenue & Project Controller
postings.description:
We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Revenue & Project Controller to join the Finance team. The role sits at the intersection of contracts, operations, programme execution and accounting. You own the end-to-end order-to-cash process from sales order or project initiation through execution, delivery, formal customer acceptance, invoicing, revenue recognition and correct reflection of project costs in the books.

You translate complex delivery, acceptance and project execution processes, including under IFRS 15, into clean, auditable revenue recognition and reliable project financials. This is not a transactional processing role. It requires technical accounting judgement, contract interpretation, governance, controls and business partnering across Sales, Legal, Programme Management, Production, Planning, Finance, Accounting and Accounts Receivable.

What You’ll Do

- Own the end-to-end order-to-cash process: order intake, delivery tracking, formal acceptance, invoicing and revenue recognition.

- Ensure revenue recognition is compliant with IFRS 15, including assessment of performance obligations, milestones, acceptance criteria, variable consideration, contract assets and liabilities, and over-time versus point-in-time recognition.

- Interpret commercial contracts and determine appropriate revenue recognition treatment before, during and after contract execution.

- Assess large, complex and long-term contracts, including contract modifications, milestone-based arrangements and customer acceptance clauses.

- Maintain auditable documentation supporting revenue recognition decisions, including signed agreements, accounting memos, performance obligation assessments, revenue schedules, delivery proof, acceptance protocols, modification analysis and management approvals.

- Implement and operate internal controls around revenue recognition, including contract review controls, approval matrices, reconciliation controls and management review controls.

- Support statutory and internal audits on revenue-related topics and defend accounting conclusions with clear, evidence-based documentation.

- Support intercompany billing, including application of markups and alignment with transfer pricing policies.

- Work closely with Accounts Receivable to ensure accurate and timely invoicing, align on outstanding items and collection status, and improve the process.

Project Controlling

- Track costs for development and production programmes.

- Monitor project financial performance, including actuals versus budget, cost-to-complete, margin development and variance analysis.

- Partner with programme and project managers to translate technical, operational and contractual progress into financial insight.

- Track project milestones and their link to billing, revenue recognition and cash flow.

- Prepare project financial reporting for management, including risk flags on budget overruns, delays, margin pressure or acceptance issues.

- Support project cost estimation for budgets and forecasts.

Cross-functional process, reporting and controls

- Act as the link between Sales, Programme Management, Production, Planning, Finance and Accounting to ensure revenue recognition keeps pace with operational reality.

- Build and maintain reporting dashboards connecting project status, contract milestones, billing, cash flow and revenue recognition.

- Improve and standardise processes and controls around order-to-cash, revenue recognition and project financials as the company scales.

- Own and execute revenue- and project-related month-end and quarter-end close activities, including revenue and cost cut-off, accruals, WIP, contract assets and liabilities, revenue schedules, project reconciliations and supporting journal entries.

- Challenge assumptions where needed and escalate appropriately when commercial preferences conflict with IFRS requirements or control expectations.

Requirements

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Economics, Economics or a related field.

- Professional accounting qualification preferred, such as CPA, ACCA, CA, RA or equivalent.

- At least 5 years of experience in financial accounting, reporting, controlling, revenue controlling or project controlling. A lower threshold may be considered where project controlling depth and IFRS 15 exposure are strong.

- Strong hands-on experience with IFRS, particularly IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers.

- Experience with large, complex and long-term contracts, preferably in manufacturing, aerospace, engineering or another project-based industry.

- Experience with project cost tracking, project accounting and translating operational progress into financial reporting.

- Strong Excel and ERP skills, ideally Microsoft Dynamics; experience with SAP, Oracle, NetSuite or similar ERP systems is also relevant.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, professional judgement, attention to detail and a structured documentation mindset.

- Ability to communicate complex accounting concepts clearly to non-finance stakeholders.

- Confidence to challenge assumptions where needed while remaining pragmatic and commercially aware.

- Team-oriented, proactive, independent and comfortable in a fast-paced, evolving scale-up environment.

- Fluent in English, both written and spoken. Additional languages are a plus.

postings.title: Sales Operations Coordinator
postings.description:
About the Role

Imagine this. You are the engine behind a Business Development team competing in one of the fastest-moving and most demanding industries in the world. As our Indoor Sales Coordinator, you will bring structure, preparation, and momentum to the Commercial team, keeping our sales funnel accurate, our Business Developers prepared, and our commercial activity moving forward.

You will own the coordination behind meetings, events, CRM activity, sales materials, and reporting. From making sure the right meetings happen at major industry events to giving our BDs the information they need before walking into a customer conversation, your work will directly influence how effectively we compete and win.

At Destinus, we are shaping the future of defense through high-speed, autonomous flight systems designed for the demands of modern operations. We develop and deliver advanced interceptor and strike systems that combine speed, precision, autonomy, and efficiency. Working with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide, we are building next-generation technologies for mission-critical operations and redefining what is possible in defense aerospace.

What You’ll Do

Sales Funnel & CRM Management

- Own the day-to-day management of our sales funnel in the CRM, keeping opportunities, stages, contacts, and next actions accurate and up to date
- Keep CRM data clean and reliable, following up with BDs for updates, closing stale records, and making sure the funnel reflects commercial reality
- Produce funnel and pipeline reports and proactively flag stalled, slipping, or at-risk opportunities
- Maintain CRM views, pipelines, templates, and simple automations that make the sales process faster and more effective

Event & Meeting Planning

- Plan and coordinate BD meetings around trade shows, conferences, customer visits, and industry events, creating efficient and well-organised itineraries
- Maximise the impact of every event by pre-booking meetings with relevant contacts and making sure each engagement has a clear objective
- Own the coordination behind invitations, confirmations, scheduling, calendars, and follow-ups so nothing gets lost along the way
- Work ahead of the BD team, anticipating what needs to happen before, during, and after key commercial events

BD Readiness & Sales Enablement

- Make sure our BDs arrive at every customer conversation fully prepared with current pitch decks, one-pagers, product information, and relevant commercial materials
- Maintain a central and version-controlled library of sales materials and work with Marketing and Product to keep content accurate and current
- Prepare concise briefing packs covering account background, key contacts, previous interactions, and meeting objectives
- Help turn commercial information into practical tools that make our BD team more effective in the field

Sales Data & Analytical Support

- Provide practical data and analytical support by pulling reports, creating simple dashboards, and tracking pipeline and activity metrics
- Prepare account history, previous interactions, and relevant data before meetings and events to sharpen customer conversations
- Support forecasting and management reporting with clean and reliable commercial data
- Identify straightforward trends, gaps, and opportunities that help BDs understand where to focus their time

Team Coordination & Administration

- Be the reliable internal point of contact for the BD team, keeping communication moving between field teams, the office, and supporting functions
- Coordinate closely with Marketing, Product, and the wider Commercial organisation to keep sales activity connected
- Take ownership of the commercial administration that keeps the sales engine running smoothly
- Bring structure and follow-through to a fast-moving environment where priorities can change quickly

Requirements

What You’ll Need

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent, or a relevant vocational qualification combined with hands-on sales support experience
- Around 2 to 4 years of experience in sales support, sales coordination, inside sales, commercial administration, or a comparable role
- Experience working with CRM platforms and an interest in keeping commercial data accurate, structured, and useful
- Strong organisational and coordination skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, stakeholders, and deadlines
- Confidence working with data, including a good working knowledge of Excel and basic reporting or BI tools
- Strong communication skills and a proactive, service-minded approach to supporting a field-based sales team
- Fluent English, with another European language considered an advantage
- Eligibility to obtain or hold the required security clearance within an EU member state

Who You Are

You thrive when there are a lot of moving parts and you are the person bringing them together. You are organised, proactive, and dependable, and you take real satisfaction in helping others perform at their best.

You do not wait to be chased. You spot what is missing, follow through, and make sure the details are handled before they become problems. CRM data, schedules, briefing packs, sales materials, and event logistics are not just administration to you. They are what enable a commercial team to move faster and make better decisions.

You communicate clearly, enjoy working across different teams and cultures, and stay composed when priorities shift. Most importantly, you want your work to have an impact and you are excited by the challenge of helping Destinus compete and win in the global defense market.

Security screening is an integral component of the selection process, ensuring that candidates meet the organization's security standards and safeguarding against potential risks.

We develop and deliver advanced interceptor and strike systems that combine speed, precision, autonomy, and efficiency. Working with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide, we are building next-generation technologies for mission-critical operations and redefining what is possible in defense aerospace.

What You’ll Do

Sales Funnel & CRM Management

- Own the day-to-day management of our sales funnel in the CRM, keeping opportunities, stages, contacts, and next actions accurate and up to date
- Keep CRM data clean and reliable, following up with BDs for updates, closing stale records, and making sure the funnel reflects commercial reality
- Produce funnel and pipeline reports and proactively flag stalled, slipping, or at-risk opportunities
- Maintain CRM views, pipelines, templates, and simple automations that make the sales process faster and more effective

Event & Meeting Planning

- Plan and coordinate BD meetings around trade shows, conferences, customer visits, and industry events, creating efficient and well-organised itineraries
- Maximise the impact of every event by pre-booking meetings with relevant contacts and making sure each engagement has a clear objective
- Own the coordination behind invitations, confirmations, scheduling, calendars, and follow-ups so nothing gets lost along the way
- Work ahead of the BD team, anticipating what needs to happen before, during, and after key commercial events

BD Readiness & Sales Enablement

- Make sure our BDs arrive at every customer conversation fully prepared with current pitch decks, one-pagers, product information, and relevant commercial materials
- Maintain a central and version-controlled library of sales materials and work with Marketing and Product to keep content accurate and current
- Prepare concise briefing packs covering account background, key contacts, previous interactions, and meeting objectives
- Help turn commercial information into practical tools that make our BD team more effective in the field

Sales Data & Analytical Support

- Provide practical data and analytical support by pulling reports, creating simple dashboards, and tracking pipeline and activity metrics
- Prepare account history, previous interactions, and relevant data before meetings and events to sharpen customer conversations
- Support forecasting and management reporting with clean and reliable commercial data
- Identify straightforward trends, gaps, and opportunities that help BDs understand where to focus their time

Team Coordination & Administration

- Be the reliable internal point of contact for the BD team, keeping communication moving between field teams, the office, and supporting functions
- Coordinate closely with Marketing, Product, and the wider Commercial organisation to keep sales activity connected
- Take ownership of the commercial administration that keeps the sales engine running smoothly
- Bring structure and follow-through to a fast-moving environment where priorities can change quickly

Requirements

What You’ll Need

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent, or a relevant vocational qualification combined with hands-on sales support experience
- Around 2 to 4 years of experience in sales support, sales coordination, inside sales, commercial administration, or a comparable role
- Experience working with CRM platforms and an interest in keeping commercial data accurate, structured, and useful
- Strong organisational and coordination skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, stakeholders, and deadlines
- Confidence working with data, including a good working knowledge of Excel and basic reporting or BI tools
- Strong communication skills and a proactive, service-minded approach to supporting a field-based sales team
- Fluent English, with another European language considered an advantage
- Eligibility to obtain or hold the required security clearance within an EU member state

Who You Are

You thrive when there are a lot of moving parts and you are the person bringing them together. You are organised, proactive, and dependable, and you take real satisfaction in helping others perform at their best.

You do not wait to be chased. You spot what is missing, follow through, and make sure the details are handled before they become problems. CRM data, schedules, briefing packs, sales materials, and event logistics are not just administration to you. They are what enable a commercial team to move faster and make better decisions.

You communicate clearly, enjoy working across different teams and cultures, and stay composed when priorities shift. Most importantly, you want your work to have an impact and you are excited by the challenge of helping Destinus compete and win in the global defense market.

postings.title: Satellite Communication Systems Engineer
postings.description:
Imagine this... you're leading the charge on satellite communications for autonomous vehicles that defy the limits of speed, altitude, and connectivity. One day you’re deep into RF system modelling, the next you're fine-tuning link budgets that make the impossible feel like yesterday’s news. You're not just engineering; you're crafting the backbone of a new era in high-speed, high-altitude defense and aerospace operations.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. What You’ll Do

✔ Define and translate mission requirements into communication system capabilities that power the most advanced UAVs on the planet.

✔ Build, analyze, and optimize link budgets to squeeze out performance in the toughest environments.

✔ Model communication links and simulate system performance to support design decisions and risk mitigation.

✔ Design and implement signal processing and data algorithms that push performance boundaries.

✔ Architect end-to-end system solutions that scale, perform, and evolve with our tech.

✔ Lead validation campaigns and system-level tests to ensure mission-readiness.

✔ Integrate cutting-edge comms hardware—modems, antennas, waveguides—into our flight platforms.

✔ Create detailed technical documentation that tells a clear, compelling story to internal teams and external partners.

✔ Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams across software, avionics, flight systems, and defense programs.

✔ Engage with suppliers and partners to align on specs, drive quality, and ensure we deliver on time.

Requirements

What You’ll Need

✔ Deep knowledge of satellite communication systems, especially RF and mmWave Satcom payloads.

✔ Strong grasp of RF communication architectures, modulation techniques, and waveform design.

✔ Solid understanding of radio propagation—multipath, fading, link loss, and what to do about it.

✔ Hands-on skills with signal processing in Python or equivalent environments.

✔ Experience with system-level modelling and simulation to drive early-phase design.

✔ Familiarity with encryption and compression algorithms is a big plus.

✔ Knowledge of multi-beam antennas and beamforming/resource allocation algorithms is an advantage.

✔ Ability to document complex systems clearly and concisely.

Who You Are

You thrive in a fast-paced environment where innovation moves at lightning speed. When others see obstacles, you see opportunities. You love autonomy, figuring things out, and taking ownership of challenges. You’re not just a comms engineer—you’re a systems thinker, problem solver, and performance optimizer. You’re confident navigating discussions with suppliers and internal stakeholders alike

Benefits

postings.title: Security & Compliance Manager
postings.description:
Imagine this. You are responsible for creating the secure environment that allows advanced defense technologies to be developed, manufactured, and operated with confidence. As our Security & Compliance Manager for the Netherlands, you will protect our people, facilities, technologies, and operations while ensuring we meet the demanding security and regulatory requirements of the defense sector.

You will take ownership of physical security, security operations, regulatory compliance, classified information protection, and security awareness across our Dutch facilities. Working closely with our global Security, IT, Compliance, Operations, and leadership teams, you will turn complex security requirements into practical controls that work in a fast-moving engineering and production environment.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You'll Do

- Own and continuously improve physical security across our Dutch production, engineering, office, and storage facilities
- Conduct facility security risk assessments and translate identified risks into effective security measures
- Manage CCTV, intrusion detection, electronic access control, and other physical security systems
- Coordinate security monitoring activities and ensure incidents, alarms, and anomalies are handled effectively
- Develop and maintain incident response, emergency, and escalation procedures and lead investigations when security incidents occur
- Manage relationships and contracts with licensed security providers and define clear operational requirements for guarding services
- Ensure security personnel meet applicable Dutch requirements, including valid Beveiligingspas or legitimatiebewijs requirements, and monitor performance against agreed procedures
- Drive compliance with applicable Dutch defense security requirements, including ABDO 2019 and ABRO requirements covering governance, personnel, physical, and cyber security for classified and vital defense contracts
- Support compliance with requirements established by the MIVD and Bureau Industrieveiligheid, including facility authorisations, security reviews, and periodic audits
- Support processes related to the Wet veiligheidsonderzoeken, including vertrouwensfuncties and VGB security clearances through the relevant Dutch authorities
- Ensure appropriate handling and protection of NATO, EU, and other classified information in accordance with applicable requirements
- Support compliance with relevant cybersecurity, business continuity, data protection, and regulatory frameworks, including the Cyberbeveiligingswet, NIS2, ISO/IEC 27001, ISO 22301, and GDPR
- Support export control and other defense-related security obligations in collaboration with internal specialists
- Coordinate security audits, compliance reviews, regulatory inspections, and remediation actions and liaise with government and security authorities when required
- Strengthen supply chain and logistics security by establishing secure procedures for sensitive technologies, materials, equipment, and components
- Support supplier security requirements and ensure logistics processes align with applicable export control and defense security obligations
- Build a strong security culture across our Netherlands operations through awareness programs, practical training, security drills, and incident response exercises
- Make sure employees understand how to protect sensitive information, identify security risks, and report incidents quickly and correctly

Requirements

What You'll Need

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Security Management, Risk Management, Information Security, Engineering, or a related field
- At least 7 years of relevant experience in corporate, military, government, or industrial security
- Experience within defense, critical infrastructure, aerospace, or another highly regulated security environment
- Strong knowledge of Dutch defense security and classified information protection requirements
- Practical experience managing physical security operations, facility protection, and security service providers
- Hands-on knowledge of CCTV, access control, intrusion detection, and related physical security technologies
- Experience supporting security audits, regulatory inspections, risk assessments, and compliance programs
- Experience developing and delivering security awareness and training programs
- Understanding of information security, business continuity, data protection, and supply chain security frameworks
- Strong organizational and stakeholder management skills with the ability to translate complex regulatory requirements into practical actions
- Professional proficiency in Microsoft Office
- Fluency in Dutch and English is a mandatory requirement for this position

Who You Are

You combine a strong security mindset with a practical way of working. You are comfortable taking ownership, challenging weak processes, and making decisions when the stakes are high. You know that effective security is not just about rules and controls, but about creating a culture where people understand the risks and take responsibility for protecting the organization. You work with integrity, communicate clearly, and stay calm and structured when situations become complex.

postings.title: Senior Aerothermal Engineer
postings.description:
About The Role

The Senior Aerothermal Engineer at Destinus will perform and drive the aerothermal designs of our aero-engines and related components. You will use your experience and skills to design and analyse compressors, diffusers, turbines, intakes and exhaust nozzles within our product and technology development programs. The aim is to produce highly efficient, reliable and cost-effective turbomachinery solutions using a range of tools, from meanline design tools to advanced CFD simulations and optimization tools. An important part of the work is to build up and further developing of our design process and methods. You will also define, participate in and analyse R&D tests ranging from single components/systems to full scale engine.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You’ll Do

- Aero-design of aero-engine components using meanline design tools and CFD simulations
- Develop and implement automated optimization workflows including DOE and Multi-Objective Optimization
- Analyze test data and compare it to numerical simulation results
- Develop our turbomachinery design tools and methods
- Collaborate with other engineering teams (e.g. combustion, mechanical design, stress analysis) to align design goals and evaluate results
- Mentor less experienced engineers
- Participating and presenting in design reviews
- Document work in technical reports and specifications

Requirements

What You’ll Need

- MSc in Mechanical or Aerospace engineering or equivalent
- >7 years of work experience from flow path design and analysis of jet engines and/or gas turbines
- Experience using meanline design tools for compressors and turbines
- Proficient in performing and analyzing CFD simulations of turbomachinery components, preferably Star-CCM+
- Proficient in using optimization tools for compressor and/or turbine designs, e.g., Axstream, Turbodesign Optima
- Experience in heat transfer calculations and/or conjugate heat transfer simulations is an advantage
- Experience from product development processes incl. gate reviews
- English language and communication skills (verbal and in writing) on CEFR level C1
- Results-driven, problem solver and initiative-taker

Who You Are

You are curious, analytical, and driven by solving complex aerothermal challenges. You enjoy turning simulations into real engineering insight and working closely with experienced engineers to push designs further. In a fast moving R&D environment you stay proactive, detail oriented, and hands on, always looking for smarter ways to improve performance and understand how things really work.

Security screening is an integral component of the selection process, ensuring that candidates meet the organization's security standards and safeguarding against potential risks.

postings.title: Senior Insurance Specialist
postings.description:
As Senior Insurance Manager, you lead the Group Insurance framework end-to-end—strategy, governance, renewals, claims, broker management and risk-aligned program design. You ensure full compliance, operational excellence and resilient protection across the Group and act as the central insurance authority, steering internal and external stakeholders and driving continuous improvement across systems, processes and standards. You have a strong background in managing global insurance programmes in a multinational defense & manufacturing environment, including policy negotiations, claims handling, and insurance cost allocation. Knowledge of Dutch insurance regulations and a broad understanding of global insurance solutions, including captives and alternative risk transfer, are essential for this role.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

- Insurance Program Management: Own and continuously optimise Destinus's global insurance portfolio, including property, general and product liability, D&O, cyber, marine/aviation cargo, and other lines relevant to an aerospace and defence business.

- Renewals & Placement: Lead the annual renewal cycle end to end; coordinating underwriting submissions, market approaches, negotiations, and binding of coverage in partnership with brokers.

- Broker & Carrier Relationships: Act as the primary point of contact for insurance brokers and carriers, driving competitive tendering where appropriate and holding partners accountable for service quality.

- Claims Management: Manage the end-to-end claims process, coordinating between internal stakeholders, brokers, and insurers to ensure timely, fair settlement.

- Risk Assessment: Partner with Legal, Procurement, Program teams, and site leads to identify emerging and site-specific risks (e.g. new facilities, test campaigns, new contracts) and ensure appropriate coverage is in place before exposure arises.

- Coverage Adequacy & Gap Analysis: Regularly review policy limits, exclusions, and deductibles against the company's actual risk exposure, flagging gaps to ERM and Finance leadership.

- Budget & Cost Management: Manage the insurance budget, forecast premium spend, and report on cost trends and coverage changes to Finance leadership.

- Contract Support: Review insurance-related clauses in customer, supplier, and partner contracts, advising internal stakeholders on required coverage and certificates of insurance.

- Compliance & Documentation: Maintain accurate records of policies, certificates, and claims history; ensure compliance with regulatory and contractual insurance requirements across jurisdictions.

- ERM Integration: Contribute insurance-related risk data and insights into the broader Enterprise Risk Management framework, supporting risk registers and reporting to leadership.

- Stakeholder Communication: Act as the internal subject-matter expert on insurance matters, providing clear guidance to management and employees on coverage, incidents, and processes.

What You’ll Need

- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business, Risk Management, or a related field; professional insurance/risk certification (e.g. ARM, CPCU, or equivalent) is an advantage.

- 5+ years of experience in corporate insurance, risk management, or a broker/carrier role, ideally including exposure to industrial, aerospace, defence, or manufacturing environments.

- Strong working knowledge of commercial insurance lines: property, liability, D&O, cyber, and specialty/aviation coverage.

- Experience negotiating with brokers and carriers, with a track record of securing favourable terms.

- Familiarity with international insurance and regulatory requirements across multiple jurisdictions (EU, Switzerland; other regions a plus).

- Strong analytical skills, with the ability to translate operational risk into coverage requirements and budget impact.

- Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills; comfortable engaging with senior leadership.

- Knowledge of relevant laws, regulations, and industry standards related to risk management and insurance.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate complex data and provide actionable recommendations.

- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively collaborate with various stakeholders at all levels.

Benefits

- The opportunity to build and shape the insurance and risk function at a fast-growing aerospace and defence company.

- Gain direct access to senior leadership and take meaningful ownership of your role right from day one

- Experience the thrill of being part of one of Europe’s most groundbreaking aerospace and clean-flight initiatives

- Collaborate with a world-class team of engineers, scientists, and operators dedicated to solving the toughest challenges

- Join a dynamic, fast-paced culture that champions ownership, craftsmanship, and impactful work

postings.title: Senior Propulsion Engineer (SRM)
postings.description:
About the role

Imagine stepping into a role where propulsion systems are built to do more than ignite. They’re designed, tested, and certified to perform under the most demanding aerospace and defense conditions. We’re looking for a Senior Propulsion Engineer who will take ownership of the design and development for our propulsion systems, ensuring full performance according to customer requirements. You´ll work at the intersection of design, analysis, and testing, driving the development of rocket motors from concept through certification. This role combines design, data analysis, and development.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You´ll Do

- Perform design, analysis, and development of rocket motor and pyrotechnic articles.
- Perform in depth data and performance analysis with focus on iterative design and improvement.
- Prepare technical reports, qualification matrices, and compliance documentation in line with military and aerospace standards.
- Develop tools and methodologies for the development, analysis or performance estimation of our rocket motors.
- Support the development of TPS, nozzle and rocket motor sizing tools.
- Support the design for qualification and certification of rocket motors in accordance with MIL-STD and STANAG standards.
- Work closely with design engineers on motor hardware design, insulation, and igniter integration to ensure certifiability from the start.
- Support failure investigations, root cause analyses, and updates to design or test procedures to maintain compliance.
- Collaborate with internal teams and external partners to align design validation and certification timelines.

Requirements

What You’ll Need

- Master’s degree in Aerospace, Mechanical, or Propulsion Engineering.
- Min. 4-5 years of experience in rocket motor development.
- In-depth knowledge of design and sizing of rocket motors and thermal protection systems.
- Previous experience with coding and tool development.
- Experience qualifying rocket motors or ignition safe and arm devices according to NATO standards is a plus.
- Hands-on experience with static firing tests, propellant handling, or motor integration.
- Familiarity with pressure vessel design and combustion analysis is a benefit.
- Strong analytical and documentation skills — able to interpret data, write clear test reports, and maintain compliance records.
- Comfortable working across disciplines — mechanical, thermal, materials, and systems engineering.
- Willingness to travel to different Destinus sites in Switzerland (max. 20%).

Who You Are

You thrive in a high-intensity engineering environment where performance, safety, and precision are non-negotiable. You take ownership naturally and feel comfortable making technical decisions that directly impact real hardware. When faced with complex propulsion challenges, you break them down analytically, test assumptions, and move fast without compromising quality.

Benefits

Why Join Us?

✨ The Thrill of the Future – Work on cutting-edge projects that redefine aerospace.
✨ Global Innovation Hub – Collaborate with top engineers from all over the world.
✨ Fast-Paced & High-Growth – Experience the rush of working in a rapidly expanding company.
✨ Real Impact – Your work won’t be theoretical—it will shape the future of flight.

Destinus is an equal-opportunity employer. We value diversity in our companies and our teams and do not discriminate based on age, race, religion, color, country of origin, gender, sexual orientation, or disability status.

postings.title: Service Engineer
postings.description:
· Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on Destinus OPRA generator sets.

· Diagnose and troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, electronic, and control-system faults.

· Carry out generator installation, testing, commissioning, and start-up activities.

· Inspect engines, alternators, control panels, fuel systems, cooling systems, exhaust systems, and associated equipment.

· Conduct load-bank testing and performance testing of generating sets.

· Service and repair engines, alternators, AVR systems, governors, batteries, starters, sensors, and control systems.

· Read and interpret electrical wiring diagrams, technical manuals, schematics, and engine documentation.

· Configure and troubleshoot generator controllers and monitoring systems.

· Identify root causes of equipment failures and recommend appropriate corrective actions.

· Respond to emergency breakdowns and provide on-site technical support when required.

· Prepare detailed service reports, maintenance records, inspection reports, and job completion documentation.

· Maintain accurate records of spare parts, tools, equipment condition, and service activities.

· Communicate effectively with customers regarding equipment condition, faults, repairs, and maintenance requirements.

· Provide technical guidance and basic operational training to customers and site personnel.

· Ensure all work is performed in accordance with safety procedures, manufacturer recommendations, and applicable regulations.

Requirements

· Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent qualification in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electromechanical Engineering, or a related field.

· Typically 2–5+ years of experience servicing, maintaining, or commissioning generator sets or industrial power equipment.

· Experience with rotating equipment, alternators, and automatic transfer systems is preferred.

· A valid driving license.

· Travel to customer sites on shore, offshore and work outside normal hours during emergency breakdowns when required.

Working Conditions

· Primarily field-based, working at customer sites, industrial facilities, oil and gas onshore offshore installations.

· May involve working in noisy, hot, dusty, or outdoor environments.

· May require travel, overtime, weekend work, and emergency call-outs depending on customer requirements.

postings.title: Shift leader
postings.description:
Imagine this. You are leading a production line where precision, coordination, and excellence are part of the daily routine. Your team relies on you to set the pace, solve problems as they arise, and ensure every component meets the highest aerospace industry standards. You are the key person who turns planning into action and targets into results, reporting directly to the Production Manager and acting as the operational point of reference throughout the shift.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You'll Do

- Lead, coordinate, and motivate an operational team of 25 to 30 FTEs, ensuring daily production, quality, and safety targets are achieved.
- Report directly to the Production Manager, maintaining clear communication on production line status, shift performance, and the team's operational needs.
