postings.title: Stress Engineer - Non-linear & Propellants
postings.description:
The Destinus engineering team is seeking a Stress Engineer to support structural sizing and simulation with a focus on non-linear and thermomechanical analysis of solid rocket motor structures.

A core part of this role is the structural simulation of propellant grains, liner bonds, thermal protection systems (TPS), and propellant–liner–casing interfaces – combining FEA with material characterization and test correlation to build substantiated models of energetic material assemblies.

What You’ll Do

· Conduct stress analysis using both classical hand-calculation methods and FEA – linear and non-linear, static and dynamic

· Simulate solid rocket motor structures: propellant grain stress and strain fields, bond integrity at propellant–liner and liner–casing interfaces, TPS thermomechanical response, and igniter/nozzle attachment loads

· Conduct non-linear simulations covering geometric non-linearity, material non-linearity (plasticity, hyperelasticity for propellant and elastomeric materials), and contact mechanics

· Perform thermomechanical analysis across metallic, composite, bonded, and polymeric structures under thermal cycling and operational loads

· Support experimental characterisation of propellant, liner, and bonded joint materials; feed test results (lap shear, peel, tensile, and DMA data) into material models and allowables

· Correlate FE predictions against strain gauge, load, and thermal test data; validate and update models accordingly

· Prepare stress reports, margin-of-safety calculations, and design justification documentation

Requirements

What You’ll Need

· Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field

· 3–5 years of industry experience in stress analysis of aerospace or mechanical structures

· Proficiency with FEA packages: NASTRAN (Femap or equivalent), Abaqus, or Optistruct/HyperWorks for both linear and non-linear analysis

· Strong classical stress analysis skills: beam theory, buckling, fastener and joint analysis, margin-of-safety calculations

· Experience with non-linear material modelling – plasticity, hyperelasticity, or viscoelasticity; familiarity with propellant or elastomeric material constitutive models is a strong advantage

· Experience with thermomechanical or thermal-structural analysis

· Experience correlating FE predictions with experimental test data

· Background in solid rocket motor, propulsion, or energetic structures is a strong advantage

· Fluent in English; German or French is an advantage

postings.title: Structural Design Engineer
postings.description:
The Destinus engineering team is seeking a Structural Design Engineer to own the CAD design of aeronautical structures from concept through production support. Working in Siemens NX, you will design flight structures as well as the test jigs, fixtures, and production equipment needed to build and qualify them.

You will work closely with Stress, Propulsion, and Avionics engineering, own design packages end to end, and contribute across the full development cycle – from early-stage R&D through detailed design, release, and production support.

What You’ll Do

· CAD design of aeronautical structures in Siemens NX – detailed part modelling, 2D drafting, and assembly modelling

· Design test jigs, fixtures, and production/support equipment for structural, functional, and qualification testing

· Deliver engineering calculations, analysis, and supporting documentation to substantiate design decisions

· Produce and maintain design documentation: drawings, specifications, bills of materials, and configuration records

· Integrate structural, mechanical, and interface requirements from Stress, Propulsion, and Avionics into the design

· Manage suppliers and manufacturers – address technical questions and resolve issues arising during the manufacturing process

· Participate in design reviews and technical discussions across all development phases

· Support junior engineers and interns in mechanical design, manufacturing, and CAD

· Own design packages end to end – from concept through detailed design, release, and production support

Requirements

What You’ll Need

· Bachelor’s degree in Aerospace or Mechanical Engineering; vocational training as a mechanical designer or drafter is a further advantage

· 3–5 years of industry experience in structural or mechanical CAD design

· Proficiency in Siemens NX for part modelling, drafting, and assembly design

· Solid working knowledge of GD&T and aerospace drawing standards

· Experience designing for manufacturability and assembly (DFM/DFA)

· Ideally, experience across multiple development phases: design, build, integration, test, and operation

· Familiarity with configuration management and design documentation practices

· Ability to work to tight timescales both as part of an integrated, multidisciplinary team and autonomously

· Background in aerospace, defence, or a similarly regulated hardware environment

· Willingness to travel between Destinus sites in Switzerland (max. 20%)

· Fluent in English; German or French is an advantage

postings.title: Structural Dynamics Engineer
postings.description:
The Destinus engineering team is seeking an Aeroelastic/Structural Dynamics Engineer to lead structural dynamic and aeroelastic simulation activities across our vehicle programmes, from model setup through test correlation.

The ideal candidate bridges analysis and test – ensuring dynamic behaviour is accurately predicted, verified, and substantiated against experimental data.

What You’ll Do

· Set up, execute, and post-process structural dynamics and aeroelastic simulations

· Create and maintain Global Finite Element Models (GFEM) representing vehicle-level dynamic behaviour, ensuring consistency and traceability with detailed local FE models

· Support structural dynamic qualification and verification of components, subsystems, and full vehicle assemblies

· Define, document, and oversee execution of vibration, modal survey, and ground vibration test (GVT) campaigns

· Correlate simulation predictions against experimental test data; interpret and communicate results clearly

· Prepare technical reports, analysis documentation, and design justification packages

Requirements

What You’ll Need

· Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field

· 3–5 years of industry experience in structural dynamics, aeroelasticity, or vibration engineering

· Proficiency with FEA packages: NASTRAN (Femap or equivalent), Abaqus, or Optistruct – for modal, transient, frequency response, and/or random vibration analysis

· Demonstrated experience defining and executing vibration and dynamic test plans

· Strong ability to correlate experimental test data against simulation predictions

· Solid grounding in structural dynamics fundamentals: SDOF/MDOF systems, modal analysis, damping, and forced response

Imagine being in a place where engineering meets procurement, shaping how high-performance aerospace hardware goes from drawing board to production floor. postings.title: System Integration Engineer (System Engineer - Effector Development)
postings.description:

This role sits at the centre of the development effort – bridging operational requirements and technical execution across propulsion, structures, avionics, and seeker.

The ideal candidate brings a defence systems background and understands the full development lifecycle of a guided effector – from ConOps and requirements through subsystem design, integration, and qualification. They are technically credible across multiple domains, rigorous in their systems thinking, and effective at driving alignment across disciplinary teams.

What You’ll Do

· Define and own system-level requirements for effector programmes – capturing operational needs, translating them into technical requirements, and maintaining traceability from ConOps through to subsystem specifications

· Develop and maintain ConOps and operational scenario definitions; work with the customer and programme stakeholders to ensure operational intent is correctly reflected in the system design

· Define and manage technical interfaces between subsystems (propulsion, warhead/pyrotechnics, structures, avionics, guidance, and GSE); own the ICD and IRS documentation

· Lead trade studies and make-or-buy analyses to identify the best technical and commercial solutions at system and subsystem level

· Identify and track critical components and subsystems; define mitigation strategies for technical risk and drive resolution through the engineering team

· Lead or support system design reviews (SRR, PDR, CDR) and prepare the associated technical baseline documentation

· Coordinate system integration activities across propulsion, structures, avionics, and external teams; ensure interfaces are closed and integration milestones are met

· Support verification and validation planning; define the V&V approach at system level and ensure it flows down to subsystem test plans

Requirements

What You’ll Need

· Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Aerospace, Systems, Mechanical, or Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field

· 5–8 years of systems engineering experience on defence or weapons system programmes – rockets, missiles, or guided weapons are a strong advantage; a background in aerospace or space launcher development is also suitable

· Proven experience defining and managing system requirements and interfaces across multi-disciplinary teams in a defence acquisition or development environment

· Hands-on experience with ConOps development, trade studies, and make-or-buy decision frameworks

postings.title: Systems Engineer (Solid Rocket Motors and SAFing)
postings.description:
About the Role

The Destinus engineering team is seeking a Systems Engineer to guide product design and drive qualification of energetic subsystems such as solid rocket motors, warheads, auxiliary pyrotechnics, and safety, arming and firing (SAF) devices. The role owns the qualification program end to end, from Mission Concept Review through to type qualification, production acceptance, and in-service surveillance.

The energetic sub-systems need to be developed and qualified to rigorous standards to support platform level efforts and qualification programs. Energetic sub-systems form a critical technology for the operation of Destinus Effectors.

The ideal candidate combines hands-on systems and test engineering with documentation discipline and broad-based systems understanding to build a defensible Engineering Qualification Program and Qualification file.

What You’ll Do

• Collaborate with energetics, propulsion, mechanical, electronics, and software discipline leads to integrate qualification overlays into a coherent system-level program.

• Drive product through the qualification process in line with certification frameworks and internal development processes.

• Develop and maintain the Qualification Data Pack — qualification plans, test plans and procedures, requirements, verification matrices, and qualification specifications and reports.

• Define test campaigns and acceptance criteria, and coordinate environmental, mechanical, safety, and performance test programs to NATO AECTP, STANAG, and AOP standards.

• Engage with the end user, lead engineers and customer to understand and document both system and sub-system requirements for tailoring qualification programs

• Help build and maintain requirements traceability and verification cross-references, ensuring every requirement is verified and traceable.

• Manage re-qualification / delta qualification: Assess change and failure triggers, classify them, and scope the re-qualification activity in line with the framework’s re-qualification criteria.

• Support hazard and safety assessments at system level and ensure the qualification evidence underpins the system safety case and Statement of Qualification.

• Help build an internal systems and qualification engineering discipline and structures to take our products to the next level

Requirements

• BSc. or MSc. in Aerospace, Mechanical, Systems, or a related engineering discipline.

• 3+ years of experience in systems engineering of energetic systems such as , propulsion, missile, or aerospace systems in a defense or aerospace environment.

• Working knowledge of a gate-driven, V-model qualification lifecycle and the deliverables and entry/exit criteria associated with formal design and qualification reviews.

• Extensive experience with NATO and equivalent qualification standards — STANAG, AECTP, and AOP munition safety principles, or equivalent national frameworks.

• Proven experience authoring qualification plans, test procedures, verification matrices, and qualification reports in a regulated, safety-critical environment.

• Experience with configuration management, requirements traceability, and document control on a complex hardware program.

• Strong documentation discipline and analytical mindset, with the ability to assemble and defend a complete evidence package under technical-authority review.

• Able to work hands-on across laboratory, integration, and test environments.

• Willingness to travel between production, R&D, and test sites in various locations.

• Fluency in English; German, French or Dutch is a plus.

postings.title: Technical Documentation / S1000D Specialist
postings.description:
About the role

Imagine this. You are building the technical documentation that keeps advanced aerospace systems operating safely, efficiently, and throughout their entire lifecycle. As our Technical Documentation / S1000D Specialist, you will become the reference point for technical publications across multiple defense and aerospace programs, ensuring that every manual, maintenance procedure, and technical publication meets the highest industry standards. From implementing S1000D methodologies to supporting Interactive Electronic Technical Manuals and technical data governance, your work will directly support engineers, operators, customers, and mission success.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

Working closely with Engineering, Configuration Management, Integrated Logistics Support, and Program teams, you will help establish and continuously improve our technical publications capability while contributing to the development of documentation processes that support products from design through operational service.

What You’ll Do

- Develop, maintain, and manage technical documentation following S1000D standards.
- Establish and continuously improve the company's technical publications capability.
- Create and maintain operator manuals, maintenance manuals, illustrated parts catalogues, and other technical publications.
- Manage documentation updates, revisions, and change control throughout the product lifecycle.
- Ensure consistency between engineering data, configuration baselines, and technical documentation.
- Support the implementation and management of Common Source Databases and technical authoring environments.
- Review, validate, and verify documentation produced by internal teams and external suppliers.
- Collaborate with Engineering, ILS, and Configuration Management teams to ensure technical accuracy.
- Support customer reviews, audits, qualification activities, and documentation acceptance processes.
- Contribute to engineering change management and configuration control activities.
- Develop and improve documentation standards, procedures, and best practices.
- Support proposal and bid activities by preparing technical publications and support documentation deliverables.

Requirements

What You’ll Need

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technical Communication, Aerospace, Defence, Logistics, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
- 2 to 4 years of experience developing technical documentation using S1000D standards.
- Experience working with Interactive Electronic Technical Manuals and documentation lifecycle management.
- Good understanding of configuration management principles.
- Experience working with technical publications in highly regulated industries.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
- Experience with Common Source Databases and XML based documentation environments is considered a strong advantage.
- Exposure to aerospace, UAV, defence, or military programs is highly desirable.
- Knowledge of Integrated Logistics Support principles is considered a plus.
- Additional European languages are an advantage.

Who You Are

You enjoy bringing structure to complex technical information and understand that accurate documentation is just as important as the engineering behind the product. You are naturally curious, eager to learn, and motivated by building processes that improve quality and consistency.

You take ownership of your work, communicate effectively across multidisciplinary teams, and pay close attention to detail without losing sight of the bigger picture. In a fast moving environment, you stay organized, adapt quickly to changing priorities, and enjoy helping establish new ways of working as the company continues to grow.

Providing a Certificate of Conduct (VOG) is a standard part of the application process at Destinus.

Security screening is an integral component of the selection process, ensuring that candidates meet the organization's security standards and safeguarding against potential risks.

Why Join Us?

✨ The Thrill of the Future – Work on cutting-edge projects that redefine aerospace.
✨ Global Innovation Hub – Collaborate with top engineers from all over the world.
✨ Fast-Paced & High-Growth – Experience the rush of working in a rapidly expanding company.
✨ Real Impact – Your work won’t be theoretical—it will shape the future of flight.

Destinus is an equal-opportunity employer. We value diversity in our companies and our teams and do not discriminate based on age, race, religion, color, country of origin, gender, sexual orientation, or disability status.

🚀 Destinus – Challenge the limits of time, space, and human potential.

postings.title: Technical Documentation Writer - Turbojet Engineering
postings.description:
About the Role

Imagine this. You are the person who transforms complex propulsion engineering into clear, accurate, and practical documentation that enables teams to build, test, operate, and maintain next generation turbojet engines with confidence. As a Technical Documentation Writer, you will work alongside multidisciplinary engineering teams to capture critical technical knowledge and create the documentation that supports every stage of the engine lifecycle. Your work will help ensure our propulsion technologies are understood, repeatable, and ready for deployment in demanding aerospace applications.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You'll Do

- Develop, maintain, and manage technical documentation for turbojet engines including operation manuals, installation guides, maintenance procedures, test instructions, engineering reports, and service documentation.
- Translate complex propulsion concepts, engineering data, and test results into structured, accurate, and user friendly documentation for technical audiences.
- Collaborate closely with propulsion, mechanical, electrical, manufacturing, and test engineers to ensure documentation remains technically accurate and up to date.
- Create documentation covering engine operation, inspection, handling, troubleshooting, maintenance, repair, and system integration.
- Build and maintain a structured technical knowledge base that supports engineering, production, operations, and customer teams.
- Review engineering drawings, specifications, test reports, and design documentation to ensure consistency, traceability, and completeness.
- Establish documentation standards, templates, and best practices that improve quality and efficiency across engineering teams.
- Support qualification activities by preparing technical documentation required for compliance, customer deliverables, and product releases.
- Manage document revisions, configuration control, and release processes throughout the product development lifecycle.

Requirements

What You'll Need

- Experience in technical writing within aerospace, aviation, automotive, defense, or another complex engineering industry.
- Ability to understand mechanical systems and convert technical information into clear, structured documentation.
- Experience creating technical manuals, maintenance procedures, operating instructions, and engineering documentation.
- Strong attention to detail with excellent organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple documentation projects simultaneously.
- Experience using documentation tools such as MadCap Flare, DITA, LaTeX, Markdown, XML, or similar platforms.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

Nice to have

- Educational background in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
- Experience working with gas turbines, turbojet engines, UAV platforms, or propulsion systems.
- Familiarity with aerospace standards, certification processes, and technical compliance documentation including EASA, SORA, or ITAR.
- Experience with engineering lifecycle tools and configuration management systems.

Who You Are

You are naturally curious and enjoy understanding how complex engineering systems work. You have the ability to communicate highly technical information with clarity, precision, and structure while maintaining exceptional attention to detail. You thrive in collaborative environments where you work closely with engineers and subject matter experts to create documentation that enables innovation to move forward. You take ownership of your work, enjoy solving problems, and understand that outstanding technical documentation is a critical part of delivering safe, reliable, and high performance aerospace products.

postings.title: Technical Project Manager (Efector Development)
postings.description:
As Destinus scales its vehicle programmes, we are looking for a dedicated Technical Project Manager to own execution across the full vehicle development stack – from propulsion and structures through avionics integration, ground support equipment, and qualification. This frees our engineers to focus on technical depth and our team leads on strategic leadership.

As one of the first hires in this group, you will manage a programme and help build the PM structure itself alongside team leads and fellow TPMs. You own execution – schedule, cross-disciplinary coordination, risk, and delivery. The engineers run the technical depth; you run the programme.

What You’ll Do

· Own end-to-end execution of vehicle-level and subsystem product development programmes – from kick-off through hardware build, test campaigns, qualification, and delivery

· Build and maintain programme plans spanning propulsion, structures, avionics, systems engineering, manufacturing, procurement, and regulatory dependencies; identify and resolve critical path risks early

· Run programme reviews and cross-functional coordination meetings; keep decisions documented and actions closed

· Work closely with engineering leads across disciplines to track technical progress and translate it into clear programme status

· Coordinate system integration activities – ensuring interfaces between subsystems (propulsion, structures, avionics, GSE) are managed, dependencies tracked, and integration milestones owned

· Manage external dependencies: supplier lead times, test facility scheduling, regulatory submissions, and customer milestones

· Proactively flag scope creep, resource conflicts, and schedule risk to leadership – with options, not just problems

· Contribute to building the PM structure, tools, and ways of working for the department alongside team leads and fellow TPMs

Requirements

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in aerospace, mechanical, systems, or a related engineering discipline

· 5–8 years in a hardware-heavy development environment; at least 2 in a project management, programme coordination, or technical lead role – career PMs without hardware exposure will not be considered

· Background in aerospace, defence, or a similarly regulated hardware domain; familiarity with vehicle-level or system-level development and qualification cycles is essential

· Experience managing cross-disciplinary programmes spanning multiple engineering domains (structures, propulsion, avionics, or similar) is a strong advantage

· Able to manage multiple concurrent projects across engineering, manufacturing, procurement, and testing

· Strong systems thinking – able to see the full picture, spot where the hard problems are likely to sit, and know when to dive into detail without losing the overall programme

· Strong planning skills – able to build a programme schedule from scratch, identify critical path, and keep it current

· Comfortable building structure in an ambiguous environment; pragmatic over bureaucratic

· Clear, direct communicator in English; German is an advantage

postings.title: Technical Support Specialist
postings.description:
About the role

Imagine stepping into the frontline of Destinus everyday operations where you become the go to person who keeps our teams connected, equipped, and running smoothly. As a Technical Support Specialist you will support users in the operation of corporate information systems while maintaining the full IT setup of the local office. From computers and software to communication tools office equipment and network infrastructure your work ensures everything functions reliably so the team can move fast without friction.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You´ll Do

- Providing support to users both online and offline for corporate hardware and software issues

- Performing initial diagnostics when hardware or software problems occur.

- Restoring devices and systems to working order, except for complex or major repairs.

- Setting up new computers (laptops and desktops) for users, whether on Windows, macOS and Linux.

- Installing and connecting office equipment like printers and scanners to the office computer networks.

- Checking, in some cases, configuring network equipment to ensure everything runs smoothly.

- Handling the transfer of faulty equipment for repairs and confirming it's back in working condition afterward.

- Assisting with the purchase of necessary equipment by helping to define requirements and accepting deliveries.

- Managing user accounts within our information systems.

- Setting up user access permissions for the company's IT resources.

- Keeping an eye on equipment performance, network operation, and user activity to ensure everything runs smoothly.

- Creating user guides to help staff effectively use equipment and software.

Requirements

What You’ll Need

- Degree in information technology or similar

- 3+ years of experience in a technical role required with a wide range of responsibilities.

- Proficiency in Linux and its installation and administration.

- Configuration and use of virtualization of computing resources.

- Experience in configuring and supporting engineering software (CAD, PLM, CFD, etc.)

- Knowledge and management of Microsoft 365 & Active directory (users, groups, etc.)

- Setting up network equipment including switches, firewalls.

- Organization of work with remote users (remote work and support tools, communication).

- Fluency in English.

Who You Are

You are a natural problem solver who enjoys helping people and keeping systems in top shape. You understand how users work what they need and how to translate issues into quick solutions. You take ownership of your environment ensuring that local IT infrastructure is stable secure and up to date. You stay calm under pressure communicate clearly and adapt quickly when priorities shift. You thrive in fast paced settings where no two days look the same and you take pride in making technology feel effortless for everyone who depends on it.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). - A practical approach to solving problems and the curiosity to understand why something does not look right

postings.title: Turbojet Mechanical Stress Engineer
postings.description:
About the Role

Imagine this. You are ensuring the structural integrity of the propulsion systems powering the next generation of high performance UAVs. Every analysis you perform helps guarantee that critical engine components can withstand extreme thermal and mechanical loads while delivering exceptional reliability and performance. From early concept development through testing and production, you will work alongside multidisciplinary engineering teams to solve complex challenges and help bring advanced turbojet engines from design to reality.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You'll Do

- Perform structural, thermal, and thermo mechanical analyses of turbojet engine components using analytical methods and Finite Element Analysis.
- Assess centrifugal, thermal, vibratory, and combined loading on rotating and stationary engine hardware.
- Evaluate the mechanical integrity and durability of compressor and turbine wheels, shafts, blisks, casings, bearing supports, combustor structures, and exhaust components.
- Predict thermal growth and hot to cold geometry changes to optimize running clearances and engine performance.
- Perform fatigue, creep, thermo mechanical fatigue, and durability assessments for high temperature engine components.
- Analyze bearings, shafts, interference fits, couplings, mechanical joints, and sealing systems under operational loading.
- Develop detailed FEA models and analytical calculations to support design decisions and component sizing.
- Define critical engine load cases and correlate analysis with rig, endurance, and flight testing results.
- Collaborate closely with design, manufacturing, aerodynamics, combustion, and test engineers to improve component performance and manufacturability.
- Prepare technical documentation and contribute to engine qualification and certification activities.

Requirements

What You'll Need

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
- Between 3 and 8 years of experience performing structural or mechanical integrity analysis for gas turbine or turbojet engines.
- Strong understanding of rotating machinery operating under high centrifugal and thermal loads.
- Hands on experience using ANSYS Mechanical, Abaqus, Nastran, or similar FEA software.
- Solid knowledge of classical stress calculations, structural sizing, fatigue analysis, and durability assessment.
- Experience evaluating thermal deformation, hot to cold geometry changes, and tip clearance optimization.
- Understanding of high temperature aerospace materials, creep, thermo mechanical fatigue, and material behaviour.
- Experience analyzing bearings, shafts, sealing systems, interference fits, and mechanical joints.
- Familiarity with aerospace manufacturing processes including machining, casting, additive manufacturing, and heat treatment.
- Strong communication skills with professional English proficiency.
- Experience with MATLAB or Python is considered an advantage.

Who You Are

You enjoy solving challenging engineering problems where structural integrity directly impacts engine performance, safety, and reliability. You combine analytical thinking with practical engineering judgement, making decisions that balance performance, manufacturability, and durability. You thrive in a fast moving development environment where testing, iteration, and collaboration are part of everyday work. You are naturally curious, hands on, and motivated by seeing your analyses validated on real hardware while taking ownership of complex engineering challenges from concept through production.

postings.title: Técnico de Producción Mecánico / Electrónico de UAV
postings.description:
En Destinus, estamos a la vanguardia del futuro de los sistemas de vuelo autónomos, combinando innovaciones en fuselajes, motores, software de vuelo e inteligencia artificial para redefinir la industria aeroespacial. Nuestra misión abarca desde velocidades subsónicas hasta hipersónicas, con aplicaciones en los sectores civil y de defensa. A medida que nos expandimos por Europa, nuestra búsqueda de la excelencia continúa.

Estamos buscando un/a Técnico/a de Producción Mecánico/Electrónico de UAV (Vehículos Aéreos No Tripulados) talentoso/a y motivado/a para unirse a nuestro equipo dinámico de producción. Como parte del equipo de fabricación y test de UAV, desempeñarás un papel clave en el ensamblaje, integración y validación de sistemas.

Tareas

- Fabricar y ensamblar diversos componentes de UAV utilizando materiales como metales en lámina, accesorios, compuestos, componentes electrónicos y plásticos. Esto puede incluir perforación, sellado, soldadura, cableado y conexionado según especificaciones técnicas.
- Montar, integrar e instalar componentes y sistemas de UAV de acuerdo con instrucciones de trabajo y planos de ingeniería, incluyendo sistemas mecánicos, eléctricos y electrónicos.
- Participar en la integración de sistemas electrónicos y de comunicación, colaborando con ingeniería y producción en estaciones de montaje y test.
- Realizar chequeos de calidad de forma autónoma siguiendo instrucciones de calidad en distintas fases de producción, asegurando que los componentes y subsistemas cumplan con las especificaciones.
- Ejecutar pruebas funcionales y procedimientos básicos de test y calibración, tanto en sistemas mecánicos como eléctricos/electrónicos.
- Apoyar en tareas de diagnóstico y resolución de incidencias mecánicas y electrónicas durante producción y test.
- Registrar y mantener documentación técnica relacionada con procesos de fabricación, test, inspecciones de calidad y reparaciones.
- Colaborar en la mejora continua de procesos productivos, especialmente en la integración de nuevos sistemas con mayor contenido electrónico.
- Cumplir con las normativas de seguridad, calidad y regulaciones aplicables durante el proceso de fabricación.

En general, un técnico de producción mecánica/electrónica de UAV desempeña un papel crítico en la producción, mantenimiento y garantía de calidad de los sistemas de UAV, contribuyendo a su fiabilidad, rendimiento y seguridad.

- Formación profesional en Electrónica, Telecomunicaciones, Mecatrónica, Electricidad, o ramas técnicas afines.
- Experiencia previa (2–5 años) en entornos de producción industrial, ensamblaje, mantenimiento o test, idealmente en sectores tecnológicos, aeroespaciales o industriales.
- Conocimientos básicos de sistemas eléctricos y electrónicos, cableado y lectura de esquemas.
- Interés y capacidad para trabajar con sistemas electrónicos y nuevos desarrollos tecnológicos.
- Familiaridad con procesos de calidad y trabajo bajo procedimientos.
- Atención al detalle y orientación a la precisión.
- Capacidad de comunicación y trabajo en equipo en entornos técnicos.
- Español como idioma de trabajo. Inglés técnico valorable.
- Posible requerimiento de autorización de seguridad según el proyecto.

Nice to have (muy valorable)

- Formación o experiencia como técnico/a en telecomunicaciones o electrónica.
- Experiencia participando en estaciones de test, validación o integración de sistemas.
- Conocimientos básicos de redes, direccionamiento IP o protocolos de comunicación.
- Familiaridad con herramientas de diagnóstico o análisis de sistemas, como software de test o herramientas tipo Wireshark.
- Experiencia en entornos donde convivan hardware, electrónica y software.
- Capacidad para adaptarse rápidamente a nuevos sistemas con mayor contenido electrónico.

Únete a nuestro equipo dinámico y contribuye al desarrollo de las capacidades de producción de vehículos aéreos de vanguardia. Tus ideas innovadoras y tu experiencia en fabricación jugarán un papel crucial en la formación del futuro de estas capacidades. ¡Aplica ahora y sé parte de esta emocionante aventura!

postings.title: UAV Avionics and Systems Engineer
postings.description:
Description

Imagine this... You’re standing in a hangar surrounded by tomorrow’s technology—hydrogen-powered UAVs that move faster than sound and operate just shy of space. As a UAV Avionics and Systems Engineer, you’re not here to follow the manual. You write the manual. You’re the mind behind the nervous system of the machine—making avionics, sensors, power systems, and flight controls talk to each other like a well-rehearsed orchestra. Every wire you route, every interface you configure, and every test you run brings us one step closer to redefining what “fast” means on a global scale. Your desk is a mix of code, cables, schematics, and mission goals—and your work ends with a UAV autonomously slicing through stratospheric altitudes with precision.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You will Do

Design and Development -

- Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to conceptualize and design UAV systems, including airframes, propulsion systems, avionics, and payloads.
- Utilize computer-aided design (CAD) software to create detailed designs and specifications.
- Conduct structural analysis, aerodynamic modelling, and system integration to optimize UAV performance.

Hardware (HW) and Systems Architecture

- Define the HW architecture of UAV systems, including airframes, propulsion systems, avionics, sensors, and communication systems.
- Develop system-level architecture to ensure seamless integration and interoperability of components.
- Collaborate with electrical, mechanical, and software engineers to establish design requirements and specifications.

System and Wiring Diagrams

- Create detailed system diagrams depicting the overall UAV architecture, subsystems, and interconnections.
- Develop wiring diagrams illustrating the electrical connections, power distribution, and signal routing within the UAV system.
- Ensure clarity and accuracy in diagrams to facilitate assembly, integration, and troubleshooting processes.

Regulatory Compliance

- Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and industry standards for UAV design, operation and safety.
- Stay updated on evolving regulations and incorporate regulatory considerations into UAV designs and operations.

Integration and Assembly Support

- Provide guidance and support to the assembly team during the integration of UAV components and subsystems.
- Verify compliance with design specifications and standards during the assembly process.
- Resolve technical issues related to component compatibility, wiring discrepancies, and system integration.

Work Instruction Preparation

- Prepare detailed work instructions for assembly, integration, and testing procedures based on design specifications and test plans.
- Document step-by-step procedures, tooling requirements, safety precautions, and quality checkpoints.
- Ensure work instructions are clear, concise, and easily understandable by assembly technicians.

Testing and Validation

- Develop test plans and procedures to validate UAV systems' performance, functionality, and safety.
- Conduct system-level testing, including functional testing, integration testing, and environmental testing.
- Analyse test results and provide recommendations for design improvements and optimizations.

Flight Approval Documentation

- Prepare comprehensive flight approval documentation in compliance with regulatory requirements and company policies.
- Liaise with regulatory authorities and stakeholders to obtain necessary flight clearances and permissions.
- Ensure adherence to airspace regulations and operational restrictions during flight planning and execution.

Documentation and Reporting

- Maintain detailed documentation of UAV designs, specifications, HW architecture, system diagrams, wiring diagrams, test plans and results.
- Prepare reports, presentations, and technical documentation to communicate design concepts, progress, and findings to stakeholders.

Collaborate with technical writers to create user manuals and technical guides for UAV systems.

- Collaboration and Communication
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including engineers, technicians, and project managers, to achieve project goals.
- Communicate effectively with team members and stakeholders to convey technical concepts, project status, and requirements.

Requirements

Requirements

What You´ll Need

- Bachelor's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field. Master's degree preferred.
- Proven experience in UAV systems engineering, focusing on H.W. and systems architecture definition, preferably in the aerospace or Defence industry.
- Proficiency in CAD software (Siemens NX) for 3D modeling and design and creating systems and wiring diagrams would be an asset.
- Strong understanding of aerodynamics, propulsion systems, avionics, electrical systems, signal routing, and power distribution for UAV subsystems.
- Experience with system integration, assembly, and testing processes.
- Knowledge of regulatory requirements and industry standards for UAV design and operation.
- Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
- Effective communication and collaboration skills to work within multidisciplinary teams.
- Experience with writing SORAs and past interaction with EASA is desired.
- Demonstrable experience in real UAV flight testing would be an asset.
- Demonstrable experience as a GCS Operator and External Pilot would be an asset.
- Drone pilot licenses for the civilian (A1, A2, and A3) and military (DUO) segments would be an asset.
- Fluent in English, ideally comfortable in Spanish as well

Who You Are

You’re a systems whisperer. Complex integration? That’s your playground. You instinctively know how avionics, sensors, electrical systems, and software should work together—and when they don’t, you troubleshoot like a pro. You're hands-on, always ready to dive into a test bench or fine-tune a wiring harness. You think in interfaces, power flows, data streams, and real-time diagnostics. You’re not intimidated by uncertainty; you love debugging the unknown. You’re collaborative by nature, fluent in both tech-speak and plain English, and you know how to bring mechanical, electrical, and software minds together to make magic happen. Most importantly, you want your work to fly—literally.

postings.title: UAV Flight Operator
postings.description:
About the role

Imagine being part of a flight operations team where every mission matters. From early-morning checks to last-light recoveries, you operate fixed-wing UAVs in demanding environments where precision, reliability, and technical judgment are non-negotiable. This role is not just about flying. It is about owning the aircraft, the ground control station, and the mission from preparation to post-flight analysis, with a strong flight test mentality and hands-on technical responsibility.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles UAVs. Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You´ll Do

• Operate and support fixed-wing UAV missions in operational and test environments, acting as pilot, technician, and ground control station operator
• Conduct pre-flight planning including airspace coordination, weather analysis, system checks, and risk assessment
• Perform launch, flight, and recovery of fixed-wing UAVs in manual, assisted, and autonomous modes
• Operate and manage ground control stations, datalinks, and communication systems during missions
• Fly with a strong flight test mindset, executing test points and adapting profiles throughout the day when conditions allow
• Operate EO/IR and visual payloads for surveillance, reconnaissance, mapping, and tracking
• Ensure flight safety and regulatory compliance in VLOS and BVLOS operations
• Maintain accurate flight logs, checklists, maintenance records, and system documentation
• Perform routine maintenance, troubleshooting, and field-level repairs on UAV systems
• Collaborate closely with engineers, mission planners, and data teams to improve aircraft performance and mission workflows
• Travel frequently for training, test flights, and demonstrations, including deployments to safe operational zones
• Operate from multiple bases including Spain, Netherlands, Portugal, Germany, Switzerland, and safe zones in Ukraine
• Remain abroad for extended periods when mission requirements demand it

Requirements

What You’ll Need

• At least 3 years of experience flying fixed-wing UAVs in manual and autonomous modes
• Hands-on experience operating ground control stations and mission systems
• Valid UAV flight certifications A1, A2, A3, and Specific
• Proven operational or flight test experience in reconnaissance, surveillance, or experimental flight environments
• Strong technical knowledge of UAV avionics, telemetry, electronics, datalinks, and communication architectures
• Experience working as a technician-operator hybrid in production or operational environments
• Familiarity with European airspace regulations and operational procedures
• Flexibility to conduct multiple flights per day depending on operational needs
• Ability to work in remote, offshore, or high-pressure environments
• Strong situational awareness, communication skills, and safety-driven decision making
• Experience with catapult systems and rocket engines for UAV launch is highly valued
• Fluency in English with Spanish, French, German or any other language are a plus

Who You Are

• You are a hands-on operator with a strong technical and flight test mindset
• You are comfortable flying fixed-wing UAVs manually and not multirotor platforms
• You feel at ease operating ground control stations and solving technical issues in real time
• You are adaptable, autonomous, and ready to fly whenever conditions allow
• You value discipline, safety, and precision in every mission
• You take ownership of both the aircraft and the mission outcome

postings.title: UAV Production Technician
postings.description:
About the role

Imagine this. You're on the shop floor, surrounded by the sleek contours of next-gen UAVs, tools in hand, and blueprints dancing in your mind. As UAV Production technician, you're not just assembling machines—you’re shaping the future of aerospace defense. Every connection you make, every wire you route, every system you calibrate, brings cutting-edge autonomous flight to life. This isn’t a job. It’s a mission.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. What You'll Do

- Fabricate components from metals, composites, plastics, and electronics that form the core of our UAV platforms

- Assemble, integrate, and install UAV systems—mechanical, electronic, electrical—with precision, following technical drawings and work instructions

- Perform quality checks like a pro to catch every glitch before it flies

- Run calibration and functional tests on entire systems to ensure peak performance

- Troubleshoot and repair systems—mechanical, electrical, or electronic—like a tech detective

- Keep rock-solid records of assembly, testing, and repairs so nothing slips through

- Spot inefficiencies and drive improvements that level up our production game

- Follow safety protocols and compliance rules like a guardian of quality and responsibility

Requirements

What You'll Need

- A background in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Mechatronics, Metalwork, or a related field—certifications and proven experience can substitute where formal education doesn't

- 2 to 5 years of hands-on work in aerospace, UAVs, or MRO (Maintenance, Repair, and Overhaul)

- Experience with UAVs, flight control systems, avionics, payloads, or communications hardware

- English fluency is key, and if you speak Ukrainian or German, that’s a huge plus

Who You Are

You're hands-on and detail-obsessed, the kind of person who gets satisfaction from building things that matter. postings.title: Warehouse Operator
postings.description:
About the Role

At Destinus, precision and efficiency drive everything we do. As a Warehouse Operator, you will play a crucial role in keeping our supply chain moving, ensuring every product and component is exactly where it needs to be. From receiving goods and preparing shipments to managing inventory, optimizing storage, and ensuring compliance with safety regulations, your work will be the foundation of our operational success. You will work closely with the Logistics Coordinator to keep the warehouse running efficiently and to help implement a standard way of working across our warehouse processes.

If you thrive in fast paced environments, have a keen eye for detail, and enjoy working with cutting edge logistics systems, this is your opportunity to be a key player in our mission!

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You’ll Do

- Keep the Flow Running: Receive, inspect, and store incoming goods, and prepare outgoing shipments, ensuring every item is in its designated location and ready for dispatch.
- Maintain Accurate Records: Record all orders, deliveries, and stock movements in the ERP system, keeping inventory in and out fully up to date.
- Collaborate Across Teams: Work closely with the Logistics Coordinator, purchasing, engineering, and production teams to optimize warehouse operations and stock control.
- Optimize and Organize the Warehouse: Continuously improve and tidy the warehouse, sort out and register items that currently lack a clear location or status, and help implement a standard way of working across warehouse processes.
- Ensure Smooth Deliveries: Identify and report potential delivery issues, such as pending tariff payments or missing documentation, to the Purchasing department.
- Prioritize Safety and Efficiency: Implement and uphold workplace health and safety practices, keeping the warehouse organized and compliant.

Requirements

What You’ll Need

Must-Have

- Strong organizational skills with a detail-oriented and methodical approach.

- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to coordinate across teams.

- Experience using ERP systems for warehouse management.

- Fluent in English—you’ll be working with international teams.

Nice-to-Have

- Experience with Microsoft Dynamics (MSD) warehouse modules.

- Previous experience in a warehouse, logistics, or supply chain role.

Who You Are

You’re not just a Warehouse Operator—you’re the backbone of an efficient supply chain. You take ownership of your work, ensuring that inventory is always accurate and organized. You communicate clearly, solve problems proactively, and thrive in a structured yet dynamic environment.

If you’re ready to step into a high-impact role and be part of a fast-growing, innovative company, we’d love to hear from you!!

postings.title: Windows Systems Administrator
postings.description:
About The Role

Imagine stepping into a place where every system you touch powers teams that are redefining aerospace and defence. As our Windows Systems Administrator, you will play a key role in managing, securing, and optimising a broad range of IT systems across the organisation. This role requires deep hands-on experience across Microsoft 365, Windows Server, Active Directory, and related infrastructure, while maintaining a proactive security mindset. We are looking for someone who can ensure the reliability, scalability, and security of all systems supporting business operations.

At Destinus, we are revolutionising the defence industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defence operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost-effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defence organisations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations. Join us in shaping the future of defence

What You´ll Do

- Administration, monitoring, and optimization of Microsoft 365 services (Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, Defender, Entra ID, Intune).
- Support and maintain Windows Server environments - Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, file services, system patching, and backups.
- Manage endpoint devices via Intune and Autopilot, including policy configuration, compliance baselines, and device lifecycle management.
- Administer and customise Atlassian Jira and Confluence, ensuring alignment with team workflows and integrations.
- Apply security best practices across systems, ensuring compliance, monitoring, and incident response readiness.
- Troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues across systems, cloud platforms, and applications.
- Provide consultation to IT support specialists on software and hardware configuration; assist in resolving complex incidents.
- Contribute to IT strategy discussions and propose improvements to enhance performance, security, and reliability of IT systems.
- Maintain accurate documentation of IT systems, configurations, and processes.

Requirements

What You’ll Need

- Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent experience.
- 5+ years in Windows systems administration with broad Microsoft platform exposure.
- Strong Windows Server and Active Directory skills (DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, DFS, replication).
- Strong Microsoft 365 administration skills, including identity, access control, automation, device management, monitoring, and incident resolution.
- Experience with automation and scripting using PowerShell.
- Understanding of virtualisation solutions (VMware / Hyper-V) and storage technologies.
- Deep understanding of OIDC, SAML 2.0, SCIM, and MFA flows; experience integrating SaaS platforms with Entra ID.
- Solid understanding of network fundamentals (TCP/IP, VLANs, routing, firewalls, VPNs).
- Familiarity with monitoring platforms (PRTG, SolarWinds, SIEM tools).
- Knowledge of Zero Trust principles and modern cybersecurity frameworks (ISO 27001, ABDO, NIS2).

Certifications (Advantageous)

- Microsoft Certified - Microsoft 365 Administrator Expert or Azure Administrator Associate.
- Security+ or equivalent security-focused credential.
- MCSA / MCSE (Windows Server) or equivalent demonstrated experience.

Who You Are

You move fast, think sharp, and stay steady when things get complex. You love diving into Windows and Microsoft environments and solving problems across systems without getting boxed in. Ownership motivates you, collaboration fuels you, and security is always on your mind. You communicate clearly, act with integrity, and bring a proactive, improvement-driven mindset to everything you touch. You want to make real impact in a place where innovation is the everyday baseline.

postings.title: Workplace Lead
postings.description:
About the Role

Imagine this. You are shaping the office environments where Destinus teams across Europe come together to build, collaborate, and grow. As Head of Workplace, you will lead our corporate office environments and Office Manager community across Europe, owning the strategy, standards, and day-to-day delivery of our office portfolio across several countries supporting employees in engineering, commercial, production, and corporate functions.

This role is distinct from our production and manufacturing Facilities function, which manages our industrial sites. Your focus is the corporate workplace, including the spaces, services, and experiences that enable our office-based teams to do their best work.

You will lead a team of currently 8 Office Managers, establish consistent standards across the company, and act as the single point of accountability for everything that touches our office environments, from office leases and vendors to employee experience, events, and general administrative support.

You will partner closely with HR, IT, Security, Finance, and senior leadership to ensure each site operates smoothly, scales as we grow, and reflects our culture and values.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You'll Do

- Define and own the workplace strategy for our office portfolio, aligned with company growth plans, hybrid working policies, and budget.
- Establish consistent service standards, processes, and KPIs across all sites, covering office services, vendor management, space utilization, and employee experience.
- Develop and maintain workplace playbooks, SLAs, and escalation procedures used by all Office Managers.
- Lead, coach, and develop the Office Manager team across European sites, setting clear objectives, running regular 1:1s, and conducting performance reviews.
- Build a strong and connected Office Manager community, sharing knowledge, standardizing approaches, and ensuring consistent quality across locations.
- Recruit and onboard new Office Managers as new sites open or existing sites grow.
- Ensure each site delivers a reliable, professional, and welcoming environment, including reception, mail and shipping, catering, cleaning, meeting room services, and visitor management.
- Oversee vendor selection, contract negotiation, and performance management for office-related services across the region, consolidating suppliers where it creates value.
- Implement and maintain workplace technology and tools, including desk and meeting room booking, visitor management, ticketing, and access control, in partnership with IT and Security.
- Partner with leadership on lease management, renewals, expansions, relocations, and new site openings.
- Manage office fit-outs, refurbishments, and moves from briefing through design, build, and handover, ensuring delivery on time and on budget.
- Partner with HR on onboarding logistics, town halls, internal events, and culture-building activities at each site.
- Ensure each office complies with local health and safety, fire, accessibility, and employment-related premises regulations across all sites.
- Coordinate with site H&S leads, building landlords, and authorities, maintaining risk assessments, emergency procedures, and required certifications.
- Support business continuity and crisis management for office sites in close coordination with Security and Operations.
- Partner with IT on connectivity, AV, meeting rooms, and on-site technical support, with Security on physical access and incident response, with Finance on budgets and procurement, and with HR on culture and employee experience.

What You'll Need

- 8+ years of experience in workplace, office operations, corporate real estate, or facilities, with at least 3 years leading multi-site teams across multiple European countries.
- Proven track record of managing distributed Office Manager or Workplace teams and building consistent service standards across locations.
- Experience managing significant operational budgets and complex vendor portfolios, with strong commercial and negotiation skills.
- Hands-on experience with at least one of the following areas, office openings, fit-outs, relocations, or major refurbishments in a European context.
- Solid understanding of health, safety, and premises-related compliance across multiple European jurisdictions.
- Excellent stakeholder management skills and confidence engaging with senior leaders, landlords, vendors, and employees alike.
- Fluent business English. An additional European language such as German, French, Italian, or Spanish is a strong plus.
- Willingness and ability to travel regularly to European sites.
- Experience in a high-growth, scaling, or international technology, engineering, or industrial environment is a plus.
- Experience working alongside, but distinct from, a manufacturing or industrial Facilities function is a plus.
- Familiarity with workplace technology platforms such as desk booking, IWMS, visitor management, or ticketing systems is a plus.
- IFMA, BIFM/IWFM, or an equivalent workplace or facilities certification is a plus.
- Experience implementing sustainability or ESG initiatives across office portfolios is a plus.

Requirements

Who You Are

You bring high integrity, resilience under pressure, and the adaptability to operate in a fast-paced, technology-driven environment. You know how to create structure and consistency across multiple locations without losing sight of what each local team needs. You are comfortable moving between strategy and hands-on execution, building strong relationships across functions, and taking ownership when challenges arise. Compliance and transparency are part of how you work, not an afterthought.

postings.title: Workshop Coordinator
postings.description:
About the role

The Destinus team at Payerne is looking for a hands-on Workshop Coordinator to keep the R&D workshop running smoothly across work preparation, warehouse and logistics, and workshop management. This is a broad operational role that touches everything between an incoming delivery and a finished part leaving the shop, suited to someone who is equally comfortable at a workbench, a stock shelf, or a planning board.

The ideal candidate has a machinist or polymechanic background and has since built solid experience across AVOR, warehousing, and production operations. They are organised, self-sufficient, and not afraid to get their hands dirty when needed.

What You’ll Do

- Manage the workshop stores and warehouse: receive incoming goods, maintain stock levels of materials, consumables, and tooling, and ensure accurate inventory records in the ERP system
- Handle logistics for the site: coordinate deliveries and shipments, manage supplier and carrier interactions, and ensure timely flow of materials between internal teams and external partners
- Keep the workshop organized and operational: manage tool inventories, coordinate equipment maintenance scheduling, and maintain a clean and efficient production environment
- Support manufacturing directly when needed, setting up machines, preparing workpieces, or assisting technicians on the floor
- Assess manufacturability of new parts coming from engineering; flag risks and support the transition of new components into production
- Maintain accurate production and logistics data in the ERP system; support reporting on stock, lead times, and workshop status
- Collaborate with engineering, procurement, and production teams to keep information flowing and bottlenecks from forming
- You don't need to be an expert in every area. We're looking for a strong manufacturing professional with experience in at least two of these areas and the willingness to develop across the others.

Requirements

What You’ll Need

- Completed vocational training as a Polymechaniker/in, machinist, or equivalent – EFZ or comparable
- 3+ years of broad operational experience spanning at least two of the following: AVOR / work preparation, warehouse and logistics management, workshop or production floor operations
- Hands-on attitude and willing and able to step in on the floor, not just coordinate from a desk
- Solid understanding of manufacturing processes, technical drawings, machining methods, and tolerances
- Experience with ERP systems for inventory, production orders, and logistics; comfortable maintaining accurate records
- Organized and self-sufficient – able to manage multiple workstreams without close supervision
- Experience in a high-mix, low-volume or R&D-adjacent manufacturing environment is an advantage
- Fluent in English (required); French and/or German is a strong advantage
